zh.title: 设置页里有“保存”“取消修改”“删除账号”和“重设密码”。哪些应该做成按钮？

options.label: 保存、取消修改、删除用按钮；重设密码用链接
options.feedback: 前三项会直接改变或放弃当前状态，应该触发动作；重设密码会前往另一页，适合用链接。删除还要在执行前确认。

options.label: 保存和删除用按钮；取消修改和重设密码都用链接
options.feedback: “取消修改”会直接放弃当前编辑，也是在执行动作；如果它不是离开页面，就不该用链接表达。

options.label: 四项都做成相同样式的按钮，并排放在一起
options.feedback: 都使用按钮不代表层级相同。删除账号需要降低视觉优先级并单独确认，不能和保存并列成同一种操作。

zh.tagline: 按钮是让用户在当前页面执行保存、提交、删除等操作的可点击控件
zh.visualHtml: <button class="btn btn-primary">保存</button><button class="btn btn-outline">取消</button><button class="btn btn-text">查看详情</button>

en.title: An account settings page has save profile, discard edits, delete account, and reset password. What is the clearest arrangement?

options.label: Use buttons for save, discard, and delete; keep reset password as a link and confirm deletion
options.feedback: Correct. The first three change or discard current state, while reset password navigates to another page. Deletion also needs confirmation.

options.label: Make save, discard, delete, and reset password all navigation links
options.feedback: Save, discard, and delete act on the current page; links do not express that behavior or handle submission state well.

options.label: Use one Confirm button for every operation and infer the intent afterward
options.feedback: Each action needs an explicit target; destructive account deletion cannot be mixed with routine saving.

en.tagline: Click to save, submit, delete, or run another action
en.visualHtml: <button class="btn btn-primary">Save</button><button class="btn btn-outline">Cancel</button><button class="btn btn-text">View details</button>

zh.title: 订单号点开后要进入独立详情页，网址可复制，也能用浏览器返回。怎样实现最合适？

options.label: 把订单号做成指向详情地址的链接
options.feedback: 链接会表达明确目的地，同时保留复制地址、浏览器返回和键盘访问能力。

options.label: 用按钮在当前列表下方展开详情
options.feedback: 按钮适合执行当前页动作，但展开内容不会形成可复制的独立详情地址。

options.label: 给普通文字绑定点击并替换当前内容
options.feedback: 普通文字缺少链接语义，也容易丢失地址、焦点和浏览器导航能力。

zh.tagline: 链接是带用户前往另一个页面、页内位置或资源地址的可点击文本或元素
zh.visualHtml:
还没有账号？立即注册
遇到问题了？看看帮助文档或官方社区 ↗

en.title: Clicking an order number should open its own detail page with a copyable URL and browser Back support. What fits best?

options.label: Make the order number a link to the detail URL
options.feedback: A link provides a real destination plus URL copying, browser history, and keyboard access.

options.label: Use a button to expand details below the current list
options.feedback: A button can reveal content, but it does not provide the independent, copyable destination requested.

options.label: Attach a click handler to plain text and replace the page content
options.feedback: Plain clickable text lacks link semantics and can lose URL, focus, and browser navigation behavior.

en.tagline: Click to open another page, location, or file
en.visualHtml:
No account yet? Sign up now
Running into issues? Check the help docs or the community ↗

zh.title: 设置页的标题、说明和权限警告几乎一样大，警告还是很浅的灰色。应该怎样调整？

options.label: 建立清楚的标题、正文和警告层级，并保证警告可读
options.feedback: 不同文字承担不同责任；稳定的字号、字重和对比度能让用户先看到重点，又不会漏掉警告。

options.label: 把页面所有文字一起加粗，让每一段都更醒目
options.feedback: 所有内容权重相同后，标题和警告反而失去区别，用户仍然找不到阅读顺序。

options.label: 继续缩小说明和警告，只把页面标题放大
options.feedback: 标题会更突出，但必须阅读的警告仍然难以看清；弱化辅助信息不能牺牲可读性。

zh.tagline: 排版是指页面中文字的字号、字重、行距与层级规范，帮助读者快速识别标题、正文与辅助信息。
zh.visualHtml:
2026 年产品规划
正文说清背景、目标和下一步安排。
林小hu 更新于 3 天前

en.title: A settings page gives its heading, descriptions, and permission warning nearly the same size, while the warning is very light gray. What should change?

options.label: Define clear heading, body, and warning roles and keep the warning readable
options.feedback: Each text role has a different job. Consistent size, weight, and contrast reveal the reading order without hiding the warning.

options.label: Bold every piece of text so that every paragraph becomes more prominent
options.feedback: When everything has equal emphasis, headings and warnings lose distinction and the reading order remains unclear.

options.label: Make descriptions and warnings smaller and enlarge only the page title
options.feedback: The title becomes clearer, but required warning text remains difficult to read. Supporting text still needs sufficient legibility.

en.tagline: Use text size and style to show what matters first
en.visualHtml:
2026 Product Roadmap
Body text covers the background, goals, and next steps.
Alex updated 3 days ago

zh.title: 设置页有“账号、安全、通知”三组内容，当前每一行都画了深色横线，页面像表格一样零碎。怎样调整？

options.label: 先用留白形成分组，只在组与组关系不清时使用克制分割线
options.feedback: 留白承担主要层级，少量分割线只补充分组变化，页面不会被切成许多小块。

options.label: 保留每行分割线，再用不同颜色区分账号、安全和通知
options.feedback: 更多更醒目的线条会继续强调每一行，而不是帮助用户识别三组主要关系。

options.label: 把组间横线改成粗黑线，依靠强边界建立层级
options.feedback: 粗线会抢过标题和内容，分组可以清楚但视觉权重明显过度。

zh.tagline: 分割线是用细线分开相邻内容分组的视觉元素
zh.visualHtml:
基本信息
偏好设置

en.title: A settings page has Account, Security, and Notifications groups, but every row uses a dark rule and the page feels fragmented. How should it change?

options.label: Build groups with whitespace first and use restrained dividers only where the boundary remains unclear
options.feedback: Whitespace carries the hierarchy and a few dividers clarify group changes without slicing the page into fragments.

options.label: Keep a divider on every row and color-code Account, Security, and Notifications
options.feedback: More prominent lines continue emphasizing individual rows rather than the three important groups.

options.label: Replace group dividers with thick black rules to create stronger hierarchy
options.feedback: Heavy rules compete with headings and content, giving the boundary more visual weight than it needs.

en.tagline: Use a line to separate two different groups of content
en.visualHtml:
Basic information
Preferences

zh.title: 资料表单里，标签离自己的输入框很远，却和下一组标签挤在一起。怎样调整最能表达分组？

options.label: 所有标签、输入框和分组之间统一使用同一个间距
options.feedback: 完全相同的距离无法说明谁属于一组，用户仍可能把标签看成下一项的说明。

options.label: 缩小标签与输入框的距离，增大不同字段组的距离
options.feedback: 较近表示关联，较远表示分组结束；复用固定档位后，同类关系也会保持一致。

options.label: 在文字里加入空格和空行，把当前画面推到合适位置
options.feedback: 文字内容和字体变化后，手工空格会失效；间距应由布局规则表达，而不是写进内容。

zh.tagline: 间距是用内容之间的留白表达关联和分组关系的布局规则
zh.visualHtml: 小 中 大

en.title: In a profile form, each label is far from its own field but crowded against the next label. Which adjustment best communicates grouping?

options.label: Use exactly the same gap between every label, field, and group
options.feedback: Equal distances do not reveal which label belongs to which field, so the grouping remains ambiguous.

options.label: Reduce label-to-field spacing and increase spacing between field groups
options.feedback: A smaller gap signals association, while a larger gap marks a new group. Reusable spacing steps keep this relationship consistent.

options.label: Insert spaces and blank lines into the text until the current view looks right
options.feedback: Manual whitespace breaks when copy or fonts change. Layout rules should express spacing relationships.

en.tagline: Use empty space to show which things belong together
en.visualHtml: Small medium Large

zh.title: 结算页要填写收件人姓名，内容通常很短，也不是从固定名单里选。哪种输入方式最合适？

options.label: 带常驻“收件人姓名”标签的单行输入框
options.feedback: 姓名是自由填写的短文本，单行输入框既直接，也能清楚关联字段标签。

options.label: 可拉高的多行文本框，方便输入完整信息
options.feedback: 多行文本框适合评论或描述；用来填姓名会放大控件却没有增加有效能力。

options.label: 只提供预设姓名的下拉选择器
options.feedback: 用户需要自由填写姓名，固定选项会阻止名单之外的有效输入。

zh.tagline: 输入框是让用户填写账号、搜索词等短文本的表单控件
zh.visualHtml: 🔍

en.title: Checkout needs a recipient name. It is usually short and is not chosen from a fixed list. What should the form use?

options.label: A single-line input with a persistent Recipient name label
options.feedback: A name is short free-form text, so a labeled single-line input matches both the value and the task.

options.label: A resizable textarea with room for complete information
options.feedback: A textarea suits comments or descriptions; its extra height adds no useful capability for a name.

options.label: A dropdown containing only a list of preset names
options.feedback: The value must be freely entered, so fixed options would block valid names outside the list.

en.tagline: Let the user enter one line of text
en.visualHtml: 🔍

zh.title: 客服表单要让用户描述故障经过，可能会写几段话，还要显示 500 字上限。哪种输入方式更合适？

options.label: 使用多行文本框，并在旁边显示剩余字数
options.feedback: 故障描述是较长的自由文本，多行空间和可见字数限制都直接服务这项任务。

options.label: 使用单行输入框，内容过长时左右滚动
options.feedback: 单行输入框会隐藏上下文，让用户难以检查和修改多段描述。

options.label: 使用带图片、字号和排版工具的富文本编辑器
options.feedback: 题目只需要纯文本描述，完整富文本工具会增加无关操作和界面负担。

zh.tagline: 多行文本框是让用户输入或编辑多段自由文本的表单控件
zh.visualHtml: <textarea class="demo-input ta-demo" rows="3" placeholder="写下你的想法…"></textarea>

en.title: A support form asks people to describe a failure in several paragraphs with a 500-character limit. How should it work?

options.label: Use a textarea and show the remaining character count nearby
options.feedback: The task needs longer free-form text, so multiline space and a visible limit directly support it.

options.label: Use a single-line input that scrolls sideways as text grows
options.feedback: A single line hides context and makes several paragraphs difficult to review and edit.

options.label: Use a rich editor with images, font sizes, and layout controls
options.feedback: The task only needs plain text, so rich formatting tools add unrelated choices and interface weight.

en.tagline: Let the user enter several lines of text
en.visualHtml: <textarea class="demo-input ta-demo" rows="3" placeholder="Write down your thoughts..."></textarea>

zh.title: 购物车数量必须是 1–20 的整数，用户常用加减调整，但实际库存可能随时变化。怎样实现更完整？

options.label: 提供可输入和步进的数字控件，限制范围，并在提交时再校验库存
options.feedback: 控件负责数值格式和基本范围，提交校验负责判断当时是否还有足够库存。

options.label: 使用带 20 个刻度的滑块，让用户拖到需要购买的数量
options.feedback: 滑块适合近似或连续调节，精确选择购物数量时输入和加减通常更直接。

options.label: 把最大值设置为 20，只要控件没有超出范围就直接创建订单
options.feedback: 1–20 只是允许填写的范围，并不能证明提交时仍有对应库存，订单仍可能超卖。

zh.tagline: 数字输入框是用于填写数值并按设定步长增减的表单控件

en.title: Cart quantity must be an integer from 1 to 20 and users often adjust it by one, but live stock can change. What is the complete approach?

options.label: Allow typing and step controls, constrain the range, and verify stock again on submit
options.feedback: The control handles numeric format and basic range, while submission checks whether enough stock exists at that moment.

options.label: Use a slider with 20 marks and let users drag to the quantity they want
options.feedback: Sliders fit approximate or continuous adjustment. Typing and step buttons are clearer for exact purchase quantities.

options.label: Set the maximum to 20 and create the order whenever the control stays in range
options.feedback: The allowed input range does not prove that the requested stock still exists when the order is submitted.

en.tagline: Enter a number with a defined range and step

zh.title: 预约取货时有 4 个时间段，只能选一个，并希望用户一眼看全后比较。怎样展示这些选项最合适？

options.label: 并排展示一组单选项，选新项会取消旧项
options.feedback: 少量互斥选项适合直接展示为单选组，用户能同时比较所有时间段。

options.label: 展示一组复选项，提交时再检查是否只选一个
options.feedback: 复选项表达可以多选，等提交时才纠错会让控件语义和真实规则冲突。

options.label: 收进下拉选择器，每次展开后查看一个列表
options.feedback: 下拉可以节省空间，但题目强调少量选项要一眼看全并直接比较。

zh.tagline: 单选框是一组只能选中其中一个选项的表单控件

en.title: Pickup offers four time slots. People must choose one and should compare every option at a glance. What fits best?

options.label: Show a radio group where a new choice clears the previous one
options.feedback: A small mutually exclusive set fits a visible radio group, letting people compare every slot.

options.label: Show checkboxes and reject multiple choices only on submit
options.feedback: Checkboxes communicate multiple selection, so their meaning would conflict with the actual rule.

options.label: Put the slots in a dropdown that opens into a list
options.feedback: A dropdown saves space, but it works against the stated need to see and compare all four options.

en.tagline: Choose exactly one option from a small set

zh.title: 订阅表单允许用户选择邮件、短信和应用通知，可以选多个，也可以一个不选，提交后才生效。怎样设计？

options.label: 每个通知渠道放一个独立复选框
options.feedback: 三个渠道彼此独立，复选框能准确表达可选一个、多个或完全不选。

options.label: 把三个渠道放进同一个单选组
options.feedback: 单选组只允许保留一个选项，会错误限制用户同时订阅多个渠道。

options.label: 放三个立即生效的开关，再保留提交按钮
options.feedback: 开关通常表示操作后立即改变状态，与题目中统一提交后生效的流程不一致。

zh.tagline: 复选框是让用户独立选中一个或多个选项的表单控件

en.title: A subscription form offers email, SMS, and app notifications. People may choose several or none, and changes apply on submit. What fits?

options.label: Give each notification channel its own checkbox
options.feedback: The channels are independent, and checkboxes express choosing one, several, or none accurately.

options.label: Put all three channels in one radio group
options.feedback: A radio group keeps only one choice, incorrectly preventing people from selecting several channels.

options.label: Use three immediate switches and still keep a Submit button
options.feedback: Switches normally signal immediate change, which conflicts with the form's apply-on-submit behavior.

en.tagline: Choose one, several, or none of the options

zh.title: 设置页有“新消息声音”，用户切换后应立刻开启或关闭，不需要再点保存。应该用什么？

options.label: 使用开关，并让状态在切换后立即生效
options.feedback: 这是一个明确的开关状态，而且操作后立即生效，符合开关的行为预期。

options.label: 使用复选框，修改后统一点击保存设置
options.feedback: 复选框配合提交可以成立，但不符合题目要求的即时反馈和即时生效。

options.label: 使用“开启声音”按钮，点击后把按钮隐藏
options.feedback: 一次性按钮不能持续显示当前是开还是关，也难以让用户随时反向切换。

zh.tagline: 在开启与关闭两种对立状态之间即时切换的开关控件。
zh.visualHtml: 消息通知 深色模式

en.title: Settings includes New message sounds. Toggling it should take effect immediately with no Save step. What should it use?

options.label: Use a switch and apply its state immediately after toggling
options.feedback: This is a persistent on-off setting with an immediate effect, which matches switch behavior.

options.label: Use a checkbox and apply all setting changes with Save
options.feedback: A submitted checkbox can work elsewhere, but it does not meet the requested immediate behavior.

options.label: Use an Enable sounds button and hide it after clicking
options.feedback: A one-time button does not keep the current state visible or make reversing the choice clear.

en.tagline: Turn a setting on or off immediately
en.visualHtml: Message notification Dark mode

zh.title: 播放器音量需要从 0 到 100 连续调整，拖动时立即听到变化，键盘用户也要能操作。怎样设计？

options.label: 使用显示当前值的滑块，拖动时预览，并支持方向键调整
options.feedback: 音量是连续范围；当前值、实时反馈和键盘操作共同覆盖了判断与操作需要。

options.label: 只放一个数字输入框，输入完成并失去焦点后才更新音量
options.feedback: 数字输入能精确填写，却削弱了连续调节和即时试听，不能满足当前任务的主要操作方式。

options.label: 把 0 到 100 的每个整数放进下拉选择，选中后更新音量
options.feedback: 大量固定选项会增加查找成本，也无法提供拖动过程中的连续反馈。

zh.tagline: 滑块是沿着一段连续或分级范围调整数值的表单控件
zh.visualHtml: 音量 亮度

en.title: Player volume runs continuously from 0 to 100, must update while dragging, and must work from a keyboard. How should it be designed?

options.label: Use a slider that shows its value, previews changes live, and responds to arrow keys
options.feedback: Volume is a continuous range. A visible value, live feedback, and keyboard controls cover both understanding and operation.

options.label: Provide only a number field and update volume after entry loses focus
options.feedback: A number field supports precision but removes the continuous adjustment and immediate listening required here.

options.label: Put every integer from 0 to 100 in a dropdown and update after selection
options.feedback: A long fixed list increases search effort and cannot provide feedback throughout a continuous drag.

en.tagline: Drag to adjust a value within a range
en.visualHtml: Volume Brightness

zh.title: 订单完成后要收集 1–5 分的满意程度，用户还要看懂自己当前选了几分。怎样设计？

options.label: 使用五级评分控件，并同步显示“已选 4 分”等可读文字
options.feedback: 评分控件表达有顺序的等级，文字分值让当前选择不只依赖星星数量或颜色。

options.label: 改成“满意”和“不满意”两个按钮，省去中间等级
options.feedback: 二选一只能收集正负态度，无法保留当前任务要求的五级满意程度。

options.label: 提供普通数字输入框，允许填写 1–5 之间的任意小数
options.feedback: 自由数字会超出评价规则，也缺少评分控件提供的固定等级和直观反馈。

zh.tagline: 评分控件是让用户在有顺序的等级中选择评价分值的表单控件

en.title: After an order, the product collects satisfaction from 1 to 5 and users must understand their current selection. How should it work?

options.label: Use a five-level rating control and also show readable text such as Selected 4 of 5
options.feedback: The control expresses ordered levels, while text makes the current value available without relying only on stars or color.

options.label: Replace it with Satisfied and Dissatisfied buttons and remove the middle levels
options.feedback: A binary choice captures positive or negative sentiment but loses the five degrees required by this task.

options.label: Use a regular number field and allow any decimal value from 1 to 5
options.feedback: Free numbers can exceed the rating rules and do not provide the fixed levels and immediate feedback of a rating control.

en.tagline: Express a rating with stars or ordered levels

zh.title: 用户需要从 4 个固定时区中选择一个。哪种选择方式最合适？

options.label: 放进下拉选择框，并显示当前选中的时区
options.feedback: 固定选项里只选一个时，选择器能节省空间并清楚表达当前值。

options.label: 使用带格式提示的输入框，让用户填写 UTC+8 之类的值
options.feedback: 自由文本容易产生无效或不一致的值。

options.label: 使用可搜索的下拉框，并允许创建列表外的新时区
options.feedback: 只有四个固定值时，不需要搜索和创建新值；额外能力会让用户误以为可以保存系统不支持的时区。

zh.tagline: 选择器是从固定选项列表中选择一个或多个值的表单控件

en.title: A form lets people choose one of four fixed, exclusive time zones. Which control fits?

options.label: Use a Select and show the current time zone
options.feedback: Correct. A selector saves space and clearly represents the current value for one option from a fixed set.

options.label: Use unrestricted text so people type a time zone
options.feedback: Free text easily creates invalid or inconsistent values.

options.label: Make the four peer values submit buttons
options.feedback: These are mutually exclusive values for one field, not four immediate actions.

en.tagline: Choose one value from a collapsed list

zh.title: 公司有几千名员工。邀请“王小明”时，怎样帮助用户找对人？

options.label: 输入名字后显示匹配的人，选中一位再邀请
options.feedback: 候选集很大且已有规范数据时，自动完成能帮助搜索并避免拼错。

options.label: 打开普通下拉框，再按姓名首字母缩小几千人的列表
options.feedback: 大量选项难以浏览，也不适合按名字快速缩小范围。

options.label: 输入完整姓名后，直接邀请搜索结果里的第一位同名员工
options.feedback: 同名员工可能不止一位。系统应展示部门、邮箱等可区分信息，让用户明确选中目标，而不是替用户猜。

en.title: To invite Wang Xiaoming among thousands of employees, which interaction fits?

options.label: Offer matching suggestions after typing, then select an existing employee
options.feedback: Correct. With a large, standardized candidate set, autocomplete supports search and avoids misspelling.

options.label: Put every employee in one long Select
options.feedback: Large option sets are hard to browse and not fast to narrow by name.

options.label: Accept arbitrary text and create a new employee with that name
options.feedback: The invitee must match an existing account; arbitrary creation makes duplicates or wrong targets.

en.tagline: Show matching suggestions while the user types

zh.title: 收货地址必须从省、市、区中选择一个最终地区，并让用户确认整条路径。哪种方案更合适？

options.label: 使用级联选择器逐级选择一条路径，关闭后显示完整路径，提交末级地区 ID
options.feedback: 任务只需要一条父子路径，级联选择能保留选择顺序和最终结果。

options.label: 使用多选树，同时勾选多个省市区，并把父级半选状态作为地址结果
options.feedback: 多选树适合跨分支选择多个范围，不适合只能提交一个最终收货地区的任务。

options.label: 使用三个互不关联的下拉框，让用户自由组合任意省、市和区
options.feedback: 三个独立选项无法保证父子关系正确，可能提交并不存在的省市区组合。

en.title: A shipping address must choose one final region through state, city, and district and let the user confirm the full path. Which approach fits?

options.label: Use a cascader to choose one path level by level, show the full path afterward, and submit the leaf-region ID
options.feedback: Correct. The task needs one parent-child path, and a cascader preserves both the sequence and final result.

options.label: Use a multi-select tree, choose several states and cities, and treat a partial parent as the address result
options.feedback: A multi-select tree fits several scopes across branches, not one final shipping region.

options.label: Use three unrelated dropdowns and let people combine any state, city, and district
options.feedback: Independent choices cannot preserve the hierarchy and may submit a region combination that does not exist.

options.label: 使用多选树选择器，明确父子联动规则，并让标签、半选状态和提交节点保持一致
options.feedback: 任务需要看见层级并跨分支多选，树选择器能同时表达父子关系和选择状态。

options.label: 使用级联选择器，每次只保留从公司到一个小组的一条路径
options.feedback: 级联选择适合一条路径，无法同时保留多个部门下的小组范围。

options.label: 把所有小组放进一个无层级的普通下拉框，父级范围由后端自行猜测
options.feedback: 扁平列表隐藏了部门关系，后端也不能从未表达的选择规则中可靠推断父级范围。

en.title: An access scope must select several groups across departments and show partially selected parents. Which control fits?

options.label: Use a multi-select tree, define parent-child selection rules, and keep labels, partial states, and submitted nodes consistent
options.feedback: Correct. The task needs visible hierarchy and cross-branch selection, which a tree selector can express together.

options.label: Use a cascader that keeps only one path from the company to a single group
options.feedback: A cascader fits one path and cannot preserve groups selected under several departments.

options.label: Put every group in one flat dropdown and let the backend infer parent scopes
options.feedback: A flat list hides department relationships, and the backend cannot reliably infer rules the interface never expressed.

zh.title: 酒店预订要选择入住和离店日期，已满日期不能选，离店还必须晚于入住。怎样组织输入？

options.label: 使用日期区间选择器，禁用不可订日期，并即时检查起止顺序
options.feedback: 同一个区间控件能统一格式、显示可选范围，并在选择过程中维护两个日期的关系。

options.label: 提供两个自由文本框，提交后再判断日期格式和先后关系
options.feedback: 自由文本会引入格式歧义，用户也会在完成提交前看不到哪些日期不可订。

options.label: 提供两个互不关联的日历，只分别检查每个日期是否可订
options.feedback: 单个日期都可订不代表区间有效；若不联动检查，离店可能早于入住。

en.title: A hotel booking needs check-in and check-out dates. Sold-out dates are unavailable and check-out must be later. How should input work?

options.label: Use a date-range picker, disable unavailable dates, and validate the order as users select
options.feedback: One range control keeps the format consistent, exposes availability, and maintains the relationship between both dates.

options.label: Use two free-text fields and validate formats and order only after submission
options.feedback: Free text introduces format ambiguity and hides unavailable dates until after the user finishes the form.

options.label: Use two unrelated calendars and only check whether each date is available
options.feedback: Two individually available dates do not guarantee a valid range; check-out could still precede check-in.

zh.title: 用户要预约纽约团队的会议，时段按 30 分钟开放，部分时间已满。怎样让时间选择不产生歧义？

options.label: 提供半小时步长的时间选择器，禁用已满时段，并明确显示纽约时区
options.feedback: 结构化时段控制格式和可用范围，时区说明让不同地区用户理解选择对应的真实时刻。

options.label: 提供文本框，让用户输入“明早”或“下午三点左右”
options.feedback: 自然语言无法稳定对应半小时预约位，不同地区对“明早”的理解也可能不同。

options.label: 只显示 09:00、09:30 等时间，不说明它属于哪个地区
options.feedback: 选项看似精确，但跨地区用户可能按自己的本地时间理解，最终预约到错误时刻。

zh.tagline: 时间选择器是让用户从允许范围中选择具体时刻的表单控件

en.title: A user books a meeting with a New York team. Slots are every 30 minutes and some are full. How can time selection avoid ambiguity?

options.label: Use a 30-minute time picker, disable full slots, and explicitly show the New York time zone
options.feedback: Structured slots control format and availability, while the zone tells users in other regions what instant they selected.

options.label: Use a text field and accept phrases such as tomorrow morning or around three
options.feedback: Natural language cannot map reliably to 30-minute inventory, and tomorrow morning differs across regions.

options.label: Show 09:00 and 09:30 options without saying which region they belong to
options.feedback: The values look precise, but remote users may interpret them in their own local time and book the wrong instant.

zh.title: 用户要上传最大 20 MB 的头像，网络中断后还要能重试。哪套方案更完整？

options.label: 浏览器检查格式后直接当作安全文件保存
options.feedback: 浏览器检查能提前反馈，但请求可以被绕过；服务器仍要检查文件类型、大小和权限。

options.label: 选择前说明限制，上传时显示进度，失败后可重试
options.feedback: 用户能提前判断文件是否合适，并看见传输状态；服务器还可以在保存前再次校验。

options.label: 先接收所有文件，传完以后再提示大小不符合
options.feedback: 最终校验仍需要，但已知限制应提前说明；传完才拒绝会浪费时间和流量。

en.title: People can upload avatars up to 20 MB, and a network interruption must be recoverable. Which flow is most complete?

options.label: Check the format in the browser and then treat the file as safe
options.feedback: Browser checks improve feedback but can be bypassed. The server must still verify type, size, and permission.

options.label: Explain limits before selection, show progress, and allow retry after failure
options.feedback: People can choose an eligible file, see the transfer state, and recover from failure while the server validates it again.

options.label: Accept every file first and report an invalid size only after transfer
options.feedback: Final server validation is still required, but known limits should be visible before a long transfer begins.

zh.title: 注册页要收集邮箱、验证码和密码，并一次创建账号。怎样组织这个表单更合适？

options.label: 每个输入框旁放一个保存按钮，三个字段分别提交
options.feedback: 三个字段共同完成注册，分开提交会产生不完整状态，用户也无法确认账号何时真正创建。

options.label: 把字段放进一个表单，就近提示错误，并统一提交
options.feedback: 这些字段属于同一项注册任务；统一提交能一起校验，并明确显示创建成功或失败。

options.label: 统一提交，但只在页面顶部显示“信息有误”
options.feedback: 统一提交是对的，但笼统提示没有指出哪个字段需要修改，用户仍要逐项猜测。

zh.tagline: 网页或软件里让用户填写并提交一组信息的区域，比如注册、下单或修改资料

en.title: A sign-up page collects an email, verification code, and password to create one account. How should the form be organized?

options.label: Put a Save button beside each field and submit all three separately
options.feedback: The fields belong to one sign-up task. Separate submissions create incomplete states and make it unclear when the account exists.

options.label: Group the fields in one form, show errors nearby, and submit them together
options.feedback: The fields complete one task, so one submission can validate them together and report whether account creation succeeded.

options.label: Submit them together but only show an 'Invalid information' message at the top
options.feedback: One submission is appropriate, but a generic message does not identify which field needs correction.

en.tagline: Collect several fields and submit them as one task

zh.title: 主题设置允许用户自由选择品牌主色，还要能把准确颜色交给同事，并保证按钮文字可读。怎样设计？

options.label: 同时提供色盘、可复制色值和实时预览，并检查文字对比度
options.feedback: 色盘用于探索，精确色值用于复现，对比度检查则确保选择后的界面仍能阅读。

options.label: 只显示一块当前颜色，不展示任何色值或输入方式
options.feedback: 用户能看到结果，却无法精确修改、复制或向他人复现同一个颜色。

options.label: 接受色盘中的任意颜色，只要用户觉得好看就直接应用
options.feedback: 视觉偏好不能保证文字与背景可读，过浅或过近的颜色可能让关键按钮失去对比。

zh.tagline: 颜色选择器是让用户查看并选择颜色值的表单控件
zh.visualHtml: #7257D8⌄

en.title: Theme settings allow a freely chosen brand color that must be shared precisely and keep button text readable. How should this work?

options.label: Provide a color field, copyable value, live preview, and text-contrast check together
options.feedback: The field supports exploration, the exact value supports reproduction, and contrast validation preserves readability.

options.label: Show only one current-color swatch with no value or input method
options.feedback: Users can see the result but cannot adjust it precisely, copy it, or reproduce the same color elsewhere.

options.label: Accept any color from the field and apply it whenever it looks good to the user
options.feedback: Visual preference does not guarantee readable foreground contrast, so pale or similar colors may hide key actions.

en.tagline: A form control for viewing and choosing a color value
en.visualHtml: #7257D8⌄

zh.title: 注册表单只用“请输入内容”作占位文字，用户输入后就分不清邮箱和用户名。应该怎样修改？

options.label: 为每个输入框保留可见标签，并让点击标签聚焦对应字段
options.feedback: 可见且关联的标签会在输入前后持续说明字段用途，也扩大了聚焦控件的入口。

options.label: 把占位文字改成“邮箱”和“用户名”，继续在输入后隐藏
options.feedback: 文案更具体仍未解决输入后消失的问题，用户检查已填内容时依然缺少字段名称。

options.label: 在输入框前放邮箱和用户图标，悬停时显示字段说明
options.feedback: 图标可能有歧义，悬停说明在触屏和键盘场景也不稳定，不能替代持续可见的标签。

zh.tagline: 表单标签是说明一个输入控件需要填写或选择什么的可见文字

en.title: A registration form only uses Enter a value as placeholder text, so users cannot tell email from username after typing. What should change?

options.label: Keep a visible label for each field and make label clicks focus the associated input
options.feedback: A visible, associated label explains the field before and after entry and provides another way to focus it.

options.label: Change the placeholders to Email and Username but still hide them after entry
options.feedback: More specific placeholders still disappear, leaving users without field names when reviewing completed values.

options.label: Add mail and user icons and reveal each field description on hover
options.feedback: Icons can be ambiguous and hover explanations are unreliable on touch and keyboard, so they cannot replace labels.

en.tagline: Visible text that tells people what a form control asks for

zh.title: 客服要比较 50 笔订单的编号、金额、状态和下单时间。哪种展示最合适？

options.label: 每笔订单做成一张卡片，把四个字段上下排列
options.feedback: 卡片适合浏览单条丰富内容，但字段上下分散后，很难沿同一列快速比较订单。

options.label: 一行一笔订单，四个字段按固定列对齐
options.feedback: 记录结构相同，而且任务是跨记录比较；固定列能让金额、状态和时间快速对齐。

options.label: 一次只展示一笔订单，用字段名和内容列出详情
options.feedback: 描述列表适合阅读一条记录；逐笔切换会失去同时比较 50 笔订单的能力。

zh.tagline: 表格是按行和列展示同一组字段、便于比较多条记录的数据组件

en.title: Support staff need to compare the ID, amount, status, and date of 50 orders. Which presentation fits best?

options.label: Use one card per order and stack the four fields vertically
options.feedback: Cards help browse rich individual items, but vertically scattered fields make cross-order comparison slow.

options.label: Use one order per row and align the four fields in fixed columns
options.feedback: Every record shares the same fields, and fixed columns make amounts, statuses, and dates easy to compare.

options.label: Show one order at a time as a list of field names and values
options.feedback: A description list is useful for one record, but switching records removes the side-by-side comparison the task needs.

zh.title: 通知中心要按时间展示几十条消息，每条只有标题、摘要、时间和一个查看入口，不需要逐列比较。怎样组织？

options.label: 使用纵向列表，让每条消息保持相同结构并按时间排列
options.feedback: 这些记录结构一致、以顺序浏览为主，列表能让用户连续扫读并进入单条详情。

options.label: 使用四列表格，把标题、摘要、时间和操作分别对齐
options.feedback: 表格更适合跨行比较固定字段；摘要长短不一时拆列会压缩内容并增加横向阅读。

options.label: 使用多列卡片网格，为每条通知增加封面图和大号图标
options.feedback: 通知的主体不是图片，多列卡片会打断时间顺序，还引入当前任务不需要的视觉信息。

zh.tagline: 列表是按相同结构连续排列多条内容或记录的数据组件

en.title: A notification center shows dozens of messages by time. Each has a title, summary, timestamp, and View action, with no need for column comparison. How should it be organized?

options.label: Use a vertical list with a consistent message structure ordered by time
options.feedback: The records share a structure and are read in sequence, so a list supports scanning and opening individual details.

options.label: Use four table columns for title, summary, time, and action
options.feedback: Tables suit comparison across fixed fields. Variable summaries become compressed and force horizontal reading.

options.label: Use a multi-column card grid and add a cover image and large icon to every message
options.feedback: Images are not the main content here. A grid interrupts chronological reading and adds irrelevant visual information.

zh.title: 模板市场要以网格展示模板，每项都有封面、名称、作者和价格，点击后进入模板详情页。怎样组织这些内容？

options.label: 每个模板做成一张信息边界清楚的卡片
options.feedback: 每个模板都是可独立浏览和进入详情的对象，卡片能把它的关键信息组合在一起。

options.label: 把所有模板放进一张覆盖整页的大卡片
options.feedback: 一张大容器无法表达每个模板的独立边界，也会让点击目标和信息归属变模糊。

options.label: 使用只有文字列的紧凑数据表格
options.feedback: 数据表适合密集比较字段，但题目要求突出封面并以视觉方式浏览模板。

zh.tagline: 卡片是把同一对象的标题、摘要、图片和操作组织在一起的内容容器

en.title: A template marketplace shows a grid where each item has a cover, name, author, price, and its own detail page. How should it be organized?

options.label: Give each template its own card with a clear information boundary
options.feedback: Each template is an independent browsable object, so a card can group its key information and destination.

options.label: Put every template inside one large card covering the page
options.feedback: One large container hides item boundaries and makes click targets and information ownership unclear.

options.label: Use a compact text-only data table for all templates
options.feedback: A table suits dense field comparison, but the task calls for visual browsing led by template covers.

en.tagline: Keep information about one item in a single block

zh.title: 订单列表要显示“已付款”等状态，筛选区还要展示当前选择的“北京”和“本月”。怎样使用标签更清楚？

options.label: 状态标签只负责标记，已选筛选标签提供明确的移除入口
options.feedback: 两者都用短文字帮助扫读，但只有可取消的筛选条件需要关闭操作，状态本身不是按钮。

options.label: 把状态和筛选标签都做成按钮，点击任意标签都切换订单状态
options.feedback: 状态标签描述现有结果，不应暗示用户能直接改动；把标记和操作混在一起会造成误触。

options.label: 把状态和筛选条件都改成彩色圆点，只在旁边显示匹配数量
options.feedback: 数量徽标不能代替“已付款”“北京”等具体含义，颜色和圆点也不足以让用户识别条件。

zh.tagline: 标签是用短文字标记内容状态、类别、属性或筛选条件的组件

en.title: An order list shows statuses such as Paid, while the filter area shows active choices Beijing and This month. How should tags work?

options.label: Keep status tags informational and give selected filter tags an explicit remove action
options.feedback: Both use short text for scanning, but only removable filter conditions need a close action. Status is not a button.

options.label: Make every status and filter tag a button that changes order status when clicked
options.feedback: A status tag describes an existing result and should not imply direct editing. Mixing labels and actions invites mistakes.

options.label: Replace every status and filter with colored dots and only show the matching count
options.feedback: Counts cannot replace meanings such as Paid or Beijing, and color dots alone do not identify the active condition.

en.tagline: Mark a status, category, or selected condition with short text
en.visualHtml: In progressCompletedOverdueFront-end×

zh.title: 顶部消息入口有 3 条未读消息，既要节省空间，也要让读屏用户知道完整状态。怎样呈现？

options.label: 在消息入口旁附加数字徽标，并提供“3 条未读消息”的可访问说明
options.feedback: 徽标补充入口的数量状态，可访问说明则让不依赖视觉的人获得同样信息。

options.label: 在导航栏中加入一张统计卡，显示“未读消息总数：3”
options.feedback: 统计卡会占用远多于状态提示所需的空间，也割裂了数量与消息入口的关系。

options.label: 只在消息图标右上角放一个红点，不提供数字或文字
options.feedback: 红点能提示发生了变化，却不能表达数量，依赖颜色的用户也可能无法获得完整状态。

zh.tagline: 徽标是附着在其他元素旁、补充数量或状态的简短标记
zh.visualHtml: 🔔5 ✉️99+ 林

en.title: The top message entry has three unread messages. It must stay compact and expose the full state to screen-reader users. How should it appear?

options.label: Attach a numeric badge to the message entry and expose 3 unread messages accessibly
options.feedback: The badge supplements the entry with a compact count, while the accessible description provides the same information nonvisually.

options.label: Add a navigation statistic card that reads Total unread messages: 3
options.feedback: A statistic card consumes much more space than this status needs and separates the count from the message entry.

options.label: Show only a red dot on the message icon with no number or text
options.feedback: A dot signals change but cannot communicate quantity, and color alone does not provide the complete state.

en.tagline: Add a count or compact status next to another object
en.visualHtml: 🔔5 ✉️99+ Lin

zh.title: 评论区里多人头像相似，还有用户没有上传照片。怎样让每条评论的作者仍然容易识别？

options.label: 头像旁持续显示姓名，缺少图片时用姓名首字作兜底
options.feedback: 头像帮助快速扫读，姓名负责明确身份，稳定的首字兜底还能覆盖图片缺失情况。

options.label: 只显示圆形照片，把完整姓名放进鼠标悬停提示
options.feedback: 相似照片难以区分，触屏和键盘用户也不能稳定依赖悬停提示确认身份。

options.label: 所有人统一显示姓名首字，评论区域不再重复显示姓名
options.feedback: 首字可能重复，只适合作为缺图兜底；没有姓名时仍无法确认具体作者。

zh.tagline: 头像是用于识别用户、团队或组织的图像、首字或标志组件
zh.visualHtml: 林 林油+5

en.title: Several commenters have similar profile photos and some uploaded no photo. How can each author remain easy to identify?

options.label: Keep the name beside the avatar and fall back to name initials when the image is missing
options.feedback: The avatar speeds scanning, the name confirms identity, and a stable initials fallback covers missing images.

options.label: Show only circular photos and put the full name in a hover tooltip
options.feedback: Similar photos are hard to distinguish, and touch or keyboard users cannot reliably depend on hover for identity.

options.label: Use initials for everyone and remove repeated names from the comment area
options.feedback: Initials can collide and work only as an image fallback. Without names, the specific author remains unclear.

en.tagline: Represent a person, team, or organization visually
en.visualHtml: Lin LinM+5

zh.title: 订单详情页要展示一笔订单的收货人、金额、状态等 8 个只读字段，不允许在这里修改。怎样组织最合适？

options.label: 按“字段名 + 内容”组成描述列表，并根据宽度调整列数
options.feedback: 这是单条记录的只读属性，字段名与内容配对能让用户快速确认信息。

options.label: 把 8 个字段都放进禁用输入框，保留类似编辑页的外观
options.feedback: 禁用控件暗示这里本可编辑，还会增加视觉噪声；当前页面只需要清楚阅读。

options.label: 建立 8 列表格并只放这一笔订单，让字段都在同一行
options.feedback: 表格适合多条记录按列比较，单行八列在窄屏上会明显压缩内容。

zh.tagline: 在详情页里用“字段名 + 内容”展示一条记录的只读信息
zh.visualHtml:
创建人oil-oil
状态进行中
更新时间2026-07-20 14:32

en.title: An order detail page shows eight read-only fields such as recipient, amount, and status, with no editing here. How should it be organized?

options.label: Use label-and-value descriptions and adjust the number of columns for available width
options.feedback: These are read-only properties of one record, so paired labels and values make them easy to verify.

options.label: Put all eight values in disabled inputs to preserve the appearance of an edit page
options.feedback: Disabled controls imply potential editing and add visual noise when the task only requires reading.

options.label: Create an eight-column table with the single order in one row
options.feedback: Tables suit comparing many records by column. One row across eight columns compresses badly on narrow screens.

en.tagline: Show the field names and values of one record
en.visualHtml:
Creatormaya-lee
StatusIn progress
Last updated2026-07-20 14:32

zh.title: 运营看板要说明本周订单表现，数据是 486 笔，比上周增加 12%。怎样展示才能让人看懂这个变化？

options.label: 突出“本周订单 486 笔”，并注明“较上周增加 12%”
options.feedback: 指标名称、当前值、单位和比较基准都明确，用户才能理解数字代表什么变化。

options.label: 只放醒目的“↑12%”，把订单数量和比较对象省略
options.feedback: 涨幅没有说明是什么指标、相对哪个时期，无法支持业务判断。

options.label: 改用 12% 进度条表示本周订单，让用户从长度判断表现
options.feedback: 进度条需要明确目标总量；当前数据描述的是订单数量和环比，不是完成进度。

zh.tagline: 在首页或数据看板上突出显示人数、金额、比例等关键数字
zh.visualHtml: 本月销售额¥ 864,000↑ 12.5% 活跃用户12,846↓ 2.1%

en.title: An operations dashboard reports 486 orders this week, up 12% from last week. How should it show the number and comparison clearly?

options.label: Emphasize 486 orders this week and add Up 12% from last week
options.feedback: Metric name, current value, unit, and benchmark are all explicit, so the change can be understood.

options.label: Show only a large ↑12% and omit the order count and comparison period
options.feedback: A percentage without the metric or comparison period cannot support a business judgment.

options.label: Use a 12% progress bar for weekly orders and let its length communicate performance
options.feedback: Progress needs a defined target. This data describes a count and period-over-period change, not completion.

en.tagline: Highlight a small number of important values
en.visualHtml: Sales this month¥ 864,000↑ 12.5% Active users12,846↓ 2.1%

zh.title: 项目详情页要在“概览、成员、日志”之间切换，三个区域都属于当前项目。怎样组织最合适？

options.label: 使用页签切换三个同级内容区，并标出当前项
options.feedback: 三个区域共享同一个项目上下文且层级平行，页签能保持当前位置并切换内容。

options.label: 把三个入口加入全站顶部导航栏
options.feedback: 顶部导航服务跨页面的核心目的地，不适合承载某个项目内部的局部内容。

options.label: 做成必须依次完成的三个步骤
options.feedback: 概览、成员和日志没有完成顺序，用步骤条会制造不存在的流程约束。

zh.tagline: 标签页是在同一页面内切换平级内容面板的导航组件
zh.visualHtml: 全部 24 个项目

en.title: A project detail page switches among Overview, Members, and Logs, all within the current project. How should it be organized?

options.label: Use tabs for the three peer sections and mark the active one
options.feedback: The sections share one project context and the same level, so tabs preserve context while switching content.

options.label: Add all three destinations to the global top navigation
options.feedback: Global navigation serves major destinations across the site, not sections inside one project.

options.label: Turn them into three steps that must be completed in order
options.feedback: Overview, Members, and Logs have no completion order, so steps would invent a false workflow.

en.tagline: Switch between a few peer sections on the same page
en.visualHtml: All 24 projects

zh.title: 文件列表要在“列表视图”和“网格视图”间即时切换，控件放在工具栏里。哪种控件最合适？

options.label: 使用两段式选择器，并持续高亮当前视图
options.feedback: 两个选项短、互斥且切换同一份内容的显示方式，适合紧凑的分段选择器。

options.label: 使用页签，把两种视图当成两个内容页面
options.feedback: 这里没有两个独立内容区，只是在改变同一批文件的显示模式。

options.label: 使用一个开关，用开启和关闭代表两种视图
options.feedback: 列表和网格是并列命名的模式，不是某个功能的开启与关闭状态。

zh.tagline: 把少量选项并排放在一起，点一下就切换当前查看方式

en.title: A file toolbar needs an immediate choice between List view and Grid view. What control fits best?

options.label: Use a two-part segmented control that keeps the current view highlighted
options.feedback: The choices are short, mutually exclusive display modes for the same content, which fits a segmented control.

options.label: Use tabs and treat the views as two content pages
options.feedback: There are no separate content sections here; only the presentation of the same files changes.

options.label: Use one switch where on and off stand for the two views
options.feedback: List and Grid are named peer modes, not the enabled and disabled states of one setting.

en.tagline: Switch quickly between a few short, exclusive modes

zh.title: 购买页有 20 个常见问题，但“退款申请须在 7 天内提交”会直接影响购买决定。怎样安排？

options.label: 问题答案按需折叠，但把 7 天退款条件放在购买入口附近持续显示
options.feedback: 折叠能降低次要内容的浏览负担，影响决定的关键条件则不应等待用户主动发现。

options.label: 把所有答案和退款条件都默认收起，只保留 20 个问题标题
options.feedback: 结构更短却隐藏了关键购买条件，用户可能在没有看到限制时作出决定。

options.label: 把 20 个问题做成一排标签页，每次切换后只显示一个答案
options.feedback: 大量标签难以扫描和换行，也没有解决退款条件需要持续可见的问题。

zh.tagline: 折叠面板是可按需展开或收起一组内容的界面组件
zh.visualHtml:
进入「项目设置 → 成员」，点击“邀请成员”，输入对方邮箱即可。
支持，项目设置里可导出 CSV 或 JSON。

en.title: A purchase page has 20 common questions, but Refund requests must be submitted within 7 days directly affects the decision. How should it be arranged?

options.label: Collapse answers on demand but keep the seven-day rule visible near the purchase action
options.feedback: Collapsing reduces the cost of secondary content, while a decision-critical condition should not depend on discovery.

options.label: Collapse every answer and refund condition by default and show only the 20 questions
options.feedback: The page becomes shorter but hides a key purchase condition, so users may decide without seeing the limit.

options.label: Turn all 20 questions into one row of tabs and show one answer at a time
options.feedback: Many tabs are difficult to scan and wrap, and they still fail to keep the refund condition visible.

en.tagline: Hide secondary details until the user asks for them
en.visualHtml:
Enter "Project Settings → Members", click "Invite Members" and enter the other party's email address.
Yes. You can export CSV or JSON from Project Settings.

zh.title: 工单详情要记录“谁在什么时候创建、转交和关闭了工单”，这些事情都已经发生。怎样展示更合适？

options.label: 用时间轴按统一方向排列事件，并写清人物、时间和动作
options.feedback: 这些是带时间先后的历史事件，时间轴能同时表达顺序和每次变化的具体内容。

options.label: 用步骤条显示“创建、转交、关闭”，让用户逐步点亮每个阶段
options.feedback: 步骤条通常引导待完成流程，而这里需要还原已经发生的记录和责任人。

options.label: 用普通列表展示三条动作，并按动作名称排序方便查找
options.feedback: 按名称排序会丢失事件先后，用户无法判断工单状态是怎样变化的。

zh.tagline: 时间轴是按时间顺序展示一组事件、状态或记录的数据组件
zh.visualHtml:
包裹已签收07-20 14:32
运输中07-19 09:15
已下单07-18 20:02

en.title: A ticket detail page records who created, transferred, and closed the ticket and when. All events already happened. How should they appear?

options.label: Use a timeline with one direction and show the person, time, and action for each event
options.feedback: These are historical events with temporal order, so a timeline expresses both sequence and each specific change.

options.label: Use a stepper for Create, Transfer, and Close and let users mark each stage complete
options.feedback: A stepper usually guides work still to be completed, while this page must reconstruct past records and responsibility.

options.label: Use a regular list and sort the actions alphabetically for easier lookup
options.feedback: Alphabetical ordering removes event sequence, so users cannot see how the ticket state changed.

en.tagline: Show a sequence of events in time order
en.visualHtml:
Package has been signed07-20 14:32
In transit07-19 09:15
Order placed07-18 20:02

zh.title: 项目文件浏览器要展示文件夹、子文件夹和文件，用户主要是逐层查看位置，不需要提交选择结果。怎样组织？

options.label: 使用可展开的树形控件，保留父子缩进和每层展开状态
options.feedback: 文件本身具有多层父子关系，树能在同一区域里逐级浏览并保持当前位置。

options.label: 把所有文件和文件夹放进一个列表，只按名称排序
options.feedback: 扁平排序会丢失文件属于哪个目录，重名文件和深层位置都难以判断。

options.label: 每次用级联选择器选中一条路径，然后提交后才能查看内容
options.feedback: 级联选择适合沿单一路径选值，当前任务需要持续展开和比较同级节点，而不是提交选择。

zh.tagline: 把文件夹、部门或分类按父子关系排列，并让用户逐层展开或收起

en.title: A project browser shows folders, nested folders, and files. Users mainly browse location by level and do not submit a selection. How should it be organized?

options.label: Use an expandable tree with parent-child indentation and persistent expansion state
options.feedback: Files naturally form a multi-level hierarchy, and a tree supports gradual browsing while preserving location.

options.label: Put every file and folder in one list sorted only by name
options.feedback: Flattening removes directory membership, making duplicate names and deep locations difficult to understand.

options.label: Choose one path in a cascader and submit before its contents can be viewed
options.feedback: A cascader fits selecting one path. This task needs persistent expansion and sibling comparison rather than submission.

en.tagline: Expand and browse data with parent-child levels

zh.title: 手机商品详情要在一个主图区域查看 5 个角度，用户需要知道当前是第几张并能自己切换。怎样实现？

options.label: 使用走马灯，提供前后切换、当前位置和可选择的缩略图
options.feedback: 同一区域轮换相关图片节省窄屏空间，明确位置和入口让浏览过程由用户掌控。

options.label: 自动每两秒切换图片，不提供暂停、箭头或当前位置
options.feedback: 用户无法停留查看细节，也不知道还有多少图片或怎样返回上一张。

options.label: 把 5 张大图按原尺寸纵向排列，让用户一直滚动查看
options.feedback: 内容都能看到，但在手机上占用过长页面，失去单个主图区域的浏览目标。

zh.tagline: 走马灯是在同一内容区域轮流展示多张幻灯片的轮播组件
zh.visualHtml:
夏季新品发布会
城市巡展报名中
森林团建回顾

en.title: A mobile product page shows five angles in one main-image area. Users need their current position and manual control. How should it work?

options.label: Use a carousel with previous and next controls, position, and selectable thumbnails
options.feedback: Rotating related images in one area saves narrow-screen space, while position and controls keep users in charge.

options.label: Change images every two seconds with no pause, arrows, or position
options.feedback: Users cannot hold an image for inspection, know how many remain, or return to the previous one.

options.label: Stack all five full-size images vertically and require scrolling through them
options.feedback: Every image is visible, but the mobile page becomes unnecessarily long and loses the intended single-image area.

en.tagline: Show several panels one at a time in the same space
en.visualHtml:
Summer new product launch conference
City tour exhibition registration is open
Forest team building review

zh.title: 新团队第一次打开项目列表，请求已成功，但还没有任何项目。页面应该显示什么？

options.label: 继续显示骨架屏，等用户自己判断列表为空
options.feedback: 请求已经完成，继续显示加载状态会让用户误以为内容仍在路上，而不是当前确实没有项目。

options.label: 说明“还没有项目”，并提供“新建项目”入口
options.feedback: 页面应说明本来会出现什么、为什么现在为空，并给出创建第一条数据的可执行下一步。

options.label: 显示“加载失败”，并要求用户刷新页面重试
options.feedback: 请求已经成功，空数据不是错误；错误提示会让用户重复请求，却仍然得不到项目。

zh.tagline: 空状态是在内容区域没有可展示数据时说明原因和下一步的界面状态
zh.visualHtml: 还没有任何项目创建第一个项目，开始协作吧

en.title: A new team opens the project list for the first time. The request succeeded, but there are no projects. What should appear?

options.label: Keep the skeleton visible and let people infer that the list is empty
options.feedback: The request is finished, so a loading state incorrectly suggests that content is still on its way.

options.label: Say there are no projects yet and provide a Create project action
options.feedback: The page explains what belongs here, why it is empty now, and the useful next step for creating the first item.

options.label: Show a loading error and ask people to refresh the page
options.feedback: An empty successful response is not a failure. Refreshing repeats the request without solving the absence of data.

en.tagline: Explain why no data is shown and what to do next
en.visualHtml: No projects yetCreate your first project and start collaborating

zh.title: 商品卡片的原图比例不同，图片加载后卡片会突然变高，部分图片还被拉伸。应该怎样处理？

options.label: 先预留统一比例的图片区域，再按比例裁切，并为内容图提供文字说明
options.feedback: 预留尺寸能减少加载跳动，按比例裁切避免变形，文字说明覆盖加载失败和非视觉阅读。

options.label: 给所有原图写相同宽度和高度，让浏览器直接拉伸填满区域
options.feedback: 尺寸统一了，但强制改变长宽比会让商品外观失真，影响用户判断。

options.label: 不预留图片空间，等每张原图加载完成后按自然尺寸撑开卡片
options.feedback: 保留原比例却会在加载过程中不断改变卡片高度，导致内容位置跳动。

zh.tagline: 在网页或软件里显示头像、商品图、文章配图等图片
zh.visualHtml:
🔍 预览

en.title: Product card images have different source ratios. Cards jump taller after loading and some images stretch. How should this be handled?

options.label: Reserve a consistent ratio, crop proportionally, and provide text alternatives for content images
options.feedback: Reserved dimensions reduce layout shift, proportional cropping avoids distortion, and text covers failures and nonvisual reading.

options.label: Give every source the same width and height and let the browser stretch it to fill
options.feedback: The boxes become consistent, but changing aspect ratio distorts products and can mislead visual judgment.

options.label: Reserve no image space and let each natural image size expand its card after loading
options.feedback: Original ratios remain intact, but card heights change during loading and make surrounding content jump.

en.tagline: Display an image with the right size, crop, and fallback

zh.title: 用户已经选择三份附件，其中一份正在上传、一份失败、一份已完成。上传区域接下来应该显示什么？

options.label: 逐项显示文件名、大小、处理状态，以及适用的重试或删除操作
options.feedback: 文件项让用户确认具体对象和当前结果，操作也能准确作用在对应附件上。

options.label: 收起文件信息，只显示回形针图标和“已选择 3 个文件”
options.feedback: 总数不能说明哪个文件失败或正在处理，用户也无法确认是否选对文件。

options.label: 继续只显示“选择文件”按钮，全部完成后再一次性列出附件
options.feedback: 传输过程中没有单项状态，用户无法发现失败、取消错误文件或判断是否需要等待。

zh.tagline: 文件项是展示单个文档、图片或附件名称、状态和操作的界面单元
zh.visualHtml: 📄项目计划.pdf2.4 MB · PDF⋯

en.title: A user selected three attachments: one is uploading, one failed, and one completed. What should the upload area show next?

options.label: Show each file's name, size, state, and the relevant retry or remove action
options.feedback: File items let users confirm each object and its result, while actions target the correct attachment.

options.label: Hide file details and show only a paperclip with 3 files selected
options.feedback: A total count cannot identify the failed or active file, and users cannot verify what they selected.

options.label: Keep only the Choose files button and list attachments after every upload finishes
options.feedback: Without per-file progress, users cannot notice failure, remove a mistaken file, or know whether to wait.

en.tagline: A UI row or card that shows one document, image, or attachment and its status
en.visualHtml: 📄project-plan.pdf2.4 MB · PDF⋯

zh.title: 紧凑工具栏里有一个不可撤销的“永久删除项目”操作，新用户不一定认识当前图标。怎样表达更稳妥？

options.label: 把统一图标放进操作按钮，并同时显示“永久删除”文字
options.feedback: 图标帮助扫读，文字消除陌生和高风险操作的歧义，按钮则负责真实交互。

options.label: 只保留垃圾桶图标，在鼠标悬停时显示“永久删除”说明
options.feedback: 悬停说明在触屏上不可用，用户也必须先猜测图标；高风险操作应在点击前持续说明。

options.label: 只显示垃圾桶图标，点击以后再在确认弹窗里解释不可撤销
options.feedback: 确认弹窗能防止误提交，却不能解决入口本身含义不清；用户不应先触发才知道后果。

zh.tagline: 图标是用统一的小型视觉符号表示功能、对象或状态的界面元素
zh.visualHtml: ⌕↓⚙⋯

en.title: A compact toolbar contains an irreversible Permanently delete project action, and new users may not know its icon. How should it be expressed?

options.label: Put a consistent icon in the action button and also show the text Permanently delete
options.feedback: The icon aids scanning, the text removes ambiguity for an unfamiliar high-risk action, and the button owns interaction.

options.label: Keep only a trash icon and reveal Permanently delete on mouse hover
options.feedback: Hover help is unavailable on touch and still requires users to guess the icon. High-risk actions need persistent meaning before activation.

options.label: Show only the trash icon and explain irreversibility in a confirmation dialog after click
options.feedback: Confirmation can prevent final mistakes but does not make the entry understandable before users activate it.

en.tagline: A small, consistent visual symbol for an action, object, or status
en.visualHtml: ⌕↓⚙⋯

zh.title: 文章要突出一句客户原话，用来说明实际使用经历。怎样处理才不会把它变成装饰或虚构背书？

options.label: 保留原话，并标明经授权的说话者、来源和必要背景
options.feedback: 引用块负责区分原话与作者观点，来源和上下文让读者能够判断这句话代表什么。

options.label: 挑一句听起来有力量的话加引号，不说明是谁或来自哪里
options.feedback: 排版上像引用不代表内容可核实，缺少来源时读者无法判断是否为真实原话。

options.label: 把客户意思改写得更有说服力，再配一个通用头像和职位
options.feedback: 改写和虚构身份改变了证据本身，不能继续当作客户原话呈现。

zh.tagline: 引用是从正文中区分出来、并标明来源的原话或文字摘录
zh.visualHtml: “虚构示例：此处放经核对的原话。”— 来源名称 · 原文链接 / 日期

en.title: An article highlights a customer's exact words about their experience. How can it avoid becoming decoration or fabricated endorsement?

options.label: Keep the original words and identify the authorized speaker, source, and necessary context
options.feedback: A quote separates original speech from the author's view, while source and context let readers judge what it represents.

options.label: Choose a powerful sentence, add quotation marks, and omit who said it or where
options.feedback: Quotation styling does not make content verifiable. Without a source, readers cannot know whether the words are real.

options.label: Rewrite the idea to sound stronger and add a generic avatar and job title
options.feedback: Rewriting and inventing identity changes the evidence, so it can no longer be presented as the customer's exact words.

en.tagline: A sourced quotation or excerpt set apart from the surrounding text
en.visualHtml: “Example only: place a verified quotation here.”— Source name · original link / date

zh.title: 帮助页用两分钟视频演示创建项目，步骤是完成任务所必需的信息。怎样提供更完整？

options.label: 提供封面、时长、播放控制、字幕和文字步骤，并处理加载失败
options.feedback: 视频展示动态过程，字幕和文字步骤确保静音、无法播放或需要快速查阅时仍能完成任务。

options.label: 页面打开后自动有声播放，并把暂停和字幕入口收到设置里
options.feedback: 自动声音会打断用户并消耗资源，也没有解决字幕和替代说明的需要。

options.label: 只放视频播放器，把所有关键步骤从页面文字中删除
options.feedback: 无法播放、听不清或只想定位一步的用户会失去完成任务所需的信息。

zh.tagline: 视频是可在页面中播放、包含连续画面和时间进度的媒体内容
zh.visualHtml:
▶
产品演示 · 02:18

en.title: A help page uses a two-minute video to demonstrate project creation, and the steps are necessary to complete the task. What is a complete delivery?

options.label: Provide a poster, duration, controls, captions, written steps, and a load-failure state
options.feedback: Video shows motion, while captions and written steps preserve the task for muted playback, failure, and quick reference.

options.label: Autoplay with sound on page open and place pause and captions inside settings
options.feedback: Automatic sound interrupts users and consumes resources, while still failing to provide captions or alternatives.

options.label: Keep only the player and remove every required step from the surrounding page
options.feedback: Users who cannot play or hear it, or who need one step quickly, lose the information required to complete the task.

en.tagline: Media with moving images and a duration that plays on a page
en.visualHtml:
▶
Product demo · 02:18

zh.title: 账号将在 7 天后到期，用户仍可继续编辑设置，但需要持续看到续费提醒。怎样呈现？

options.label: 在设置内容附近保留一条说明影响和续费入口的警告
options.feedback: 这条信息需要持续可见，但不必阻断编辑；就近警告能同时说明风险和下一步。

options.label: 进入页面时弹出两秒轻提示，然后自动消失
options.feedback: 到期提醒需要用户记住并可能稍后处理，短暂消失的轻提示很容易被错过。

options.label: 每次进入设置都弹窗，续费前不允许关闭
options.feedback: 用户仍可继续使用和编辑，强制阻断超过了当前风险；持续但不阻断的提醒更合适。

zh.tagline: 警告提示是嵌在页面内容中、持续说明状态、风险或异常的提示组件
zh.visualHtml:
⚠体验环境 · 数据每日 0 点重置×
✕提交失败 · 2 处填写有误，请检查后重试×

en.title: An account expires in seven days. People may keep editing settings, but the renewal reminder must remain visible. How should it appear?

options.label: Keep an alert near the settings with the impact and a renewal action
options.feedback: The message remains visible without blocking editing and gives both the risk and a clear next step.

options.label: Show a two-second toast when the page opens and then dismiss it
options.feedback: An expiry reminder may require later action, so a brief disappearing message is too easy to miss.

options.label: Open a modal on every visit and prevent closing it until renewal
options.feedback: The account still works, so blocking the entire settings task overstates the current restriction.

en.tagline: Keep an important message or warning visible on the page
en.visualHtml:
⚠Demo environment · Data resets every day at midnight×
✕Couldn’t submit · 2 entries are incorrect, please check and try again×

zh.title: 用户点击“复制邀请链接”，复制已经成功，也不需要继续处理。最合适的反馈是什么？

options.label: 短暂显示“邀请链接已复制”，随后自动消失
options.feedback: 复制是已经完成的小操作，简短确认能说明结果，又不会打断用户接下来的工作。

options.label: 在页面顶部保留“已复制”警告，直到用户关闭
options.feedback: 结果不需要长期记住或处理，持续占据页面会把一次轻量反馈误写成重要状态。

options.label: 打开确认弹窗，要求用户点击“知道了”才能继续
options.feedback: 复制已经完成且没有后续选择，弹窗增加了无意义的操作并打断当前流程。

zh.tagline: 轻提示是在页面上短暂显示、反馈刚完成操作的提示组件
zh.visualHtml:
保存成功
保存

en.title: Someone clicks Copy invite link. The copy succeeded and no further action is required. What feedback fits best?

options.label: Briefly show 'Invite link copied' and dismiss it automatically
options.feedback: Copying is a completed lightweight action, so a brief confirmation reports the result without interrupting the next task.

options.label: Keep a 'Copied' alert at the top until the person closes it
options.feedback: The result requires no later action or memory, so a persistent alert gives it unnecessary importance.

options.label: Open a modal and require an OK click before continuing
options.feedback: The action is already complete and needs no decision, so a modal adds an unnecessary interruption.

en.tagline: Briefly confirm a small action that just finished
en.visualHtml:
Saved
Save

zh.title: 用户启动报表导出后离开了原页面，文件五分钟后才生成。完成结果应该怎样告知？

options.label: 写入可稍后查看的通知，并在其中提供文件名称和下载入口
options.feedback: 结果发生在原操作之后且需要后续处理，保留通知能让用户回来找到具体文件。

options.label: 在原页面显示两秒“导出完成”，时间到后自动消失
options.feedback: 用户已经离开原页面，短暂反馈很可能完全看不到，也无法稍后找到下载入口。

options.label: 文件完成时在用户当前页面弹出不可关闭窗口，要求立即下载
options.feedback: 导出结果不需要打断当前任务；强制立即处理会让后台任务反过来阻塞用户。

zh.tagline: 在页面角落或通知中心出现，提醒用户某件事已经发生或需要处理

en.title: A user starts a report export and leaves the page. The file becomes ready five minutes later. How should completion be communicated?

options.label: Create a notification that can be revisited, with the file name and download action
options.feedback: The result occurs after the original action and needs follow-up, so a retained notification lets users find the exact file later.

options.label: Show Export complete for two seconds on the original page and then dismiss it
options.feedback: The user already left that page, so brief feedback may never be seen and provides no later download path.

options.label: Open a non-dismissible modal on the user's current page and require an immediate download
options.feedback: Export completion does not block the current task. Forced handling turns a background task into an interruption.

en.tagline: Notify the user about an event with a title and details

zh.title: 用户要修改账单地址，完成后还要回到订单原位置。怎样安排这段编辑？

options.label: 打开居中的编辑弹窗，保存或取消后回到订单原位置
options.feedback: 独立、短暂且需要专注的任务适合弹窗；内容很长或多步时应进入完整页面。

options.label: 在页面顶部展开地址表单，保存后再让用户滚回订单
options.feedback: 内联编辑并非不能用，但把表单插到页面顶部会打断当前位置；这项短任务更适合在原页面上方集中完成。

options.label: 进入独立的地址管理页，保存后再重新找到这张订单
options.feedback: 独立页面适合更长、更复杂的地址管理；这里只修改当前订单地址，跳走会增加返回和重新定位成本。

zh.tagline: 在当前页面上方居中弹出的阻断式对话框，用于聚焦单一核心操作。
zh.visualHtml:

en.title: Editing a billing address has several fields but should not leave the order page. When does a Modal fit?

options.label: Use a Modal for this short, focused edit with clear save and close
options.feedback: Correct. A separate, brief task needing focus fits a modal; long or multi-step work belongs on a full page.

options.label: Put every explanatory line in a Modal so it is always seen
options.feedback: Frequent interruption adds burden; simple guidance does not need a modal layer.

options.label: Put primary site navigation in a Modal
options.feedback: Navigation should remain predictable and returnable, not trap site paths in a dialog.

en.tagline: Pause the page for one focused decision or task

zh.title: 用户要在订单列表旁修改较完整的收货地址，编辑时仍需看见订单内容，完成后回到原位置。怎样安排？

options.label: 从右侧打开可关闭的编辑抽屉，保留列表背景
options.feedback: 抽屉能容纳较完整的表单，同时保留订单上下文和关闭后的列表位置。

options.label: 在页面中央打开尺寸固定的小确认弹窗
options.feedback: 确认弹窗适合短而聚焦的决定，完整地址表单会显得拥挤并遮住更多上下文。

options.label: 跳转到独立地址页，保存后回到列表顶部
options.feedback: 独立页面能完成编辑，但会丢失题目要求保留的订单内容和原列表位置。

zh.tagline: 从屏幕边缘滑出的覆盖层面板，用于展示承载较多内容的辅助操作。
zh.visualHtml:
任务详情 ×

en.title: From an order list, someone edits a full shipping address while keeping the order visible, then returns to the same position. What fits?

options.label: Open a closable editing drawer from the right and keep the list behind it
options.feedback: A drawer has room for the form while preserving order context and the list position after closing.

options.label: Open a fixed-size confirmation modal in the center
options.feedback: A confirmation modal suits a short decision; a full address form becomes cramped and hides more context.

options.label: Navigate to an address page and return to the top after saving
options.feedback: A separate page can edit the address, but it loses the requested order context and list position.

en.tagline: Slide in a side panel without leaving the current page
en.visualHtml:
Task details ×
CloseSave

zh.title: 项目归档后会立刻从团队视图消失，恢复还要进入归档列表。怎样确认更合适？

options.label: 在“归档”旁边就近说明影响，并提供确认和取消
options.feedback: 单个、可逆但有后果的即时动作适合就近确认。

options.label: 打开完整弹窗，重新展示项目详情和所有归档设置
options.feedback: 完整弹窗会让一个简单的就近判断变得过重。

options.label: 第一次点击就直接归档，只显示“操作成功”
options.feedback: 可恢复不等于没有影响；用户仍需要在执行前确认对象和结果。

zh.tagline: 触发危险或关键操作时在控件就近浮现的目标二次确认浮层。
zh.visualHtml:
⚠确认删除这条记录？
取消确定

en.title: Archiving a project removes it from the team view immediately, and restoring it requires the archive list. What confirmation fits?

options.label: Use a Popconfirm near the trigger, explaining impact with Archive and Cancel
options.feedback: Correct. A single, reversible but consequential immediate action fits nearby confirmation.

options.label: Open a full Modal with many settings for every archive
options.feedback: A full dialog makes a simple nearby decision unnecessarily heavy.

options.label: Skip confirmation because it can be restored
options.feedback: Reversible does not mean consequence-free; people still need to confirm the target and result.

en.tagline: Ask for confirmation next to the action that caused it
en.visualHtml:
⚠Delete this record?
CancelConfirm

zh.title: 成员列表中，点击头像要就地查看部门、邮箱和两个快捷操作，手机端也要能打开。用什么方式更合适？

options.label: 使用点击或聚焦打开的气泡卡片，贴近头像并支持内部操作
options.feedback: 内容比一句提示丰富但仍很轻量，Popover 能保持触发关系，也能覆盖键盘和触屏。

options.label: 使用只在鼠标悬停时出现的文字提示，把两个操作写成链接
options.feedback: Tooltip 不适合承载多项资料和交互，触屏设备也没有稳定的悬停入口。

options.label: 每次点击头像都打开占据大半屏的个人资料弹窗
options.feedback: 弹窗能放下内容，但对少量资料和两个快捷操作来说层级过重，打断当前列表浏览。

zh.tagline: 气泡卡片是贴近触发元素展开、可承载补充信息和少量操作的浮层组件

en.title: In a member list, clicking an avatar should reveal department, email, and two quick actions in place, including on mobile. What fits best?

options.label: Use a popover opened by click or focus, anchored to the avatar with working actions inside
options.feedback: The content is richer than a hint but still lightweight. A popover preserves context and supports keyboard and touch.

options.label: Use a text tooltip that appears only on hover and put the two actions inside it
options.feedback: Tooltips do not suit multiple details and interactive actions, and touch devices have no reliable hover entry.

options.label: Open a profile modal that occupies most of the screen whenever the avatar is clicked
options.feedback: A modal can hold the content but is too heavy for a few details and two shortcuts, interrupting list browsing.

en.tagline: Open a small panel with extra information or controls

zh.title: 工具栏只有一个下载图标，需要在鼠标悬停或键盘聚焦时补一句“下载报告”。怎样补充这句说明？

options.label: 给图标关联一个可悬停和聚焦触发的文字提示
options.feedback: 短说明用于补充图标含义，且鼠标与键盘都能触发，符合文字提示的用途。

options.label: 打开带下载格式选择和确认按钮的气泡卡片
options.feedback: 题目只需要解释图标，不需要包含选择和操作的交互式浮层。

options.label: 点击下载后再用消息提示说明这个图标
options.feedback: 用户需要在操作前识别按钮，点击后的消息无法帮助他提前理解图标。

zh.tagline: 鼠标悬停或聚焦时浮现的轻量级文字提示气泡。
zh.visualHtml:
