★收藏
⬇下载

en.title: An icon-only toolbar button needs the label Download report on mouse hover or keyboard focus. What should be used?

options.label: Attach a text tooltip that opens on both hover and focus
options.feedback: A short label explains the icon, and supporting both mouse and keyboard makes the hint reachable.

options.label: Open a card with format choices and a confirmation button
options.feedback: The task only needs to explain the icon, not an interactive layer with choices and actions.

options.label: Explain the icon in a message only after download is clicked
options.feedback: People need to understand the control before acting, so a message after the click arrives too late.

en.tagline: Explain a compact control with a short text label
en.visualHtml:
⚙Settings
★Collection
⬇Download

zh.title: 上传一个 200 MB 文件，而且系统知道已经传了多少。页面应该显示什么？

options.label: 显示真实百分比或已上传大小，失败时提供重试
options.feedback: 任务总量和已完成量可测时，进度条能让用户判断还要等多久。

options.label: 显示“正在上传”和转圈动画，但不展示已经上传多少
options.feedback: 已有真实完成量时，Spinner 丢掉了用户可以利用的信息。

options.label: 根据网速估算一个倒计时，用倒计时替代真实上传进度
options.feedback: 既然系统知道真实上传量，就应优先展示真实进度；网速变化会让估算倒计时反复跳动或提前结束。

zh.tagline: 进度条是用长度、百分比或阶段表示任务完成程度的状态组件
zh.visualHtml: 上传中…66%

en.title: A 200MB upload reports uploaded bytes. What feedback should be used?

options.label: Show real Progress percentage or uploaded size, with retry on failure
options.feedback: Correct. When total and completed work are measurable, progress lets people judge the wait.

options.label: Show only a continuously spinning Spinner
options.feedback: When real completion exists, a Spinner loses useful information.

options.label: Immediately show upload complete while it continues in the background
options.feedback: It presents incomplete transfer as success and can lead to data-loss assumptions.

en.tagline: Show how much of a task has been completed
en.visualHtml: Uploading...66%

zh.title: 文章列表结构固定，数据通常要等一两秒才返回。加载期间怎样减少页面跳动？

options.label: 先显示接近图片和标题形状的骨架，数据到达后替换
options.feedback: 骨架提前占住真实内容的位置，结构相近时能减少内容出现后的布局变化。

options.label: 先显示“还没有文章”，数据回来后再改成列表
options.feedback: 请求尚未结束，空状态会错误地告诉用户没有数据，并在结果到达时改变含义。

options.label: 显示从 0% 自动增长的进度条，不读取真实进度
options.feedback: 系统不知道完成比例，伪造百分比可能提前走完，也无法稳定文章列表的布局。

zh.tagline: 页面加载时先出现的灰色轮廓，用来占住稍后内容的位置

en.title: An article list has a known layout, but its data usually takes one or two seconds to arrive. How can loading reduce layout movement?

options.label: Reserve image and title shapes with a skeleton, then replace it with data
options.feedback: A skeleton that resembles the incoming structure reserves space and reduces movement when real content appears.

options.label: Show 'No articles yet' first and replace it when data arrives
options.feedback: The request is still pending, so an empty state incorrectly claims that no data exists.

options.label: Animate a progress bar from 0% without reading actual progress
options.feedback: The system does not know completion percentage, and fake progress does not reserve the article layout.

en.tagline: Reserve the layout while content is loading

zh.title: 支付请求已经结束并生成订单，用户需要确认是否成功、订单编号以及接下来能做什么。页面应该怎样呈现？

options.label: 显示明确的结果页，包含状态、订单信息和最相关的下一步
options.feedback: 支付是完整流程终点，集中展示结果和后续入口能让用户确认任务是否真正完成。

options.label: 显示两秒“操作成功”提示，然后自动跳回商品首页
options.feedback: 短暂提示没有订单依据和后续入口，用户也可能来不及确认支付对应哪笔订单。

options.label: 清空购物车并显示“暂无商品”，让用户据此推断支付成功
options.feedback: 空购物车只说明当前没有商品，不能证明支付结果，也无法解释失败或处理中状态。

zh.tagline: 结果页是在一个完整流程结束后集中说明结果和下一步操作的页面状态
zh.visualHtml:
✓
提交成功
审核结果将在 1-3 个工作日内通知你

en.title: A payment request has finished and produced an order. The user needs the outcome, order number, and available next step. How should the page respond?

options.label: Show a clear result page with status, order information, and the most relevant next action
options.feedback: Payment ends a complete flow, so one result state lets users verify completion and find the next path.

options.label: Show Operation successful for two seconds and automatically return to the store home
options.feedback: Brief feedback provides no order evidence or follow-up and may disappear before users know which payment it refers to.

options.label: Clear the cart and show No products, leaving users to infer that payment succeeded
options.feedback: An empty cart only describes current contents. It does not prove payment outcome or explain failure and processing states.

en.tagline: Explain the final outcome and the next available step
en.visualHtml:
✓
Submission received
You’ll get the review result within 1–3 business days

zh.title: 点击保存后通常要等两秒，但系统不知道还剩多久。页面应该显示什么？

options.label: 按钮显示“保存中”和转圈图标，并防止重复提交
options.feedback: 短暂且无法估算完成度的等待适合 Spinner，并要说明正在做什么。

options.label: 按照两秒平均耗时，让进度条自动从 0% 走到 100%
options.feedback: 没有真实完成度时，虚假进度会误导用户。

options.label: 保持保存按钮可点击，只在页面角落显示统一加载提示
options.feedback: 加载提示离触发位置太远，而且按钮仍能重复点击。短暂保存应在按钮附近明确状态并暂时阻止重复提交。

zh.tagline: 旋转加载指示器是用持续旋转表示系统正在处理、但完成度未知的状态组件
zh.visualHtml: 正在保存…

en.title: Saving usually finishes in two seconds, but remaining work is unknown. What should appear?

options.label: Show a Spinner and Saving in the button, disabling duplicate submission
options.feedback: Correct. A brief wait with unknown completion suits a Spinner and should say what is happening.

options.label: Show Progress slowly moving from 0% to 100%
options.feedback: Without real completion, fake progress misleads people.

options.label: Show no state and update suddenly on success
options.feedback: People cannot tell whether the click worked and may submit again.

en.tagline: A rotating indicator that shows a short, indeterminate wait
en.visualHtml: Saving…

zh.title: 后台有项目、成员、账单和设置等 8 个独立页面。怎样帮助用户持续找到入口和当前位置？

options.label: 用分组导航菜单列出页面，并高亮当前页面
options.feedback: 这些项目会带用户前往不同页面；分组和当前态能同时解决查找入口与确认位置。

options.label: 把 8 个页面做成一排标签页，在同一区域切换
options.feedback: 标签页适合同一对象的少量并列内容；用它承载整套后台页面会让层级和地址变得模糊。

options.label: 把所有页面入口收进一个常驻的“更多”下拉菜单
options.feedback: 下拉菜单节省空间，却隐藏了主要页面和当前位置；8 个稳定入口更适合分组持续展示。

zh.tagline: 导航菜单是按层级组织页面或功能入口、帮助用户在产品中移动的导航组件
zh.visualHtml: ▦仪表盘 ▤项目 ✉消息3

en.title: An admin product has eight separate pages, including Projects, Members, Billing, and Settings. How should people find pages and their current location?

options.label: List the pages in a grouped navigation menu and highlight the current page
options.feedback: These items navigate to separate pages, and grouping plus a current state supports both discovery and orientation.

options.label: Turn all eight pages into one row of tabs that swaps the content area
options.feedback: Tabs fit a small set of peer views for one object, not the primary hierarchy of an entire admin product.

options.label: Hide every page destination inside one persistent More dropdown
options.feedback: A dropdown saves space but hides the main destinations and current location that should remain visible.

en.tagline: Help people move between the main sections of a product
en.visualHtml: ▦Dashboard ▤item ✉Message3

zh.title: 用户正在“项目 / 夏季活动 / 数据报告”页面，需要看懂它属于哪一层并返回项目。怎样展示？

options.label: 显示“项目 / 夏季活动 / 数据报告”，上级可点击
options.feedback: 这条路径表达页面在内容层级中的位置，并让用户直接返回任一上级。

options.label: 显示用户刚才访问过的三个页面，按时间倒序排列
options.feedback: 访问历史会随进入方式变化，不能稳定说明当前页面属于哪个项目和层级。

options.label: 显示“第 3 步”，并把前两个页面标记为已完成
options.feedback: 这些页面是层级位置，不是必须按顺序完成的流程；步骤状态会暗示不存在的任务进度。

zh.tagline: 面包屑是按层级展示当前页面路径、帮助用户返回上级的导航组件
zh.visualHtml: 首页/ 组件/ 面包屑

en.title: Someone is on Projects / Summer campaign / Data report and needs to understand the hierarchy and return to Projects. What should be shown?

options.label: Show 'Projects / Summer campaign / Data report' with linked parent levels
options.feedback: The path communicates the page's stable place in the hierarchy and provides direct navigation to each parent.

options.label: List the last three visited pages in reverse chronological order
options.feedback: Visit history changes with the route taken and does not reliably explain where the current page belongs.

options.label: Show 'Step 3' and mark the previous two pages as completed
options.feedback: These are locations in a hierarchy, not stages of a required process, so completion states are misleading.

en.tagline: Show the path from a broad section to the current page
en.visualHtml: Home/ Component/ Breadcrumbs

zh.title: 审计日志有几万条，用户需要分享“错误日志第 4 页”，回来后还要保持筛选条件。怎样浏览更合适？

options.label: 使用分页，并把页码和筛选条件同步到网址
options.feedback: 稳定页码适合定位和返回大量记录；写入网址后，同一筛选结果还能分享和复现。

options.label: 持续自动加载更多，不记录用户已经滚到的位置
options.feedback: 连续加载适合随意浏览，但很难准确分享第 4 页，也不利于返回原来的日志位置。

options.label: 把每 20 条日志做成一个标签页，并按数字命名
options.feedback: 标签页用于少量并列类别，不是大量结果的页码；数量增长后会迅速挤满导航。

zh.tagline: 分页是把大量结果分成多个可定位页面浏览的导航组件
zh.visualHtml: ‹ … 10 ›

en.title: An audit log has tens of thousands of entries. People must share 'error logs, page 4' and return with filters preserved. Which browsing pattern fits?

options.label: Use pagination and keep the page number and filters in the URL
options.feedback: Stable pages support precise return and sharing, while URL parameters reproduce the same filtered result.

options.label: Load entries continuously without recording the current position
options.feedback: Continuous loading supports casual browsing but makes page 4 difficult to share or revisit precisely.

options.label: Turn each group of 20 logs into a numerically named tab
options.feedback: Tabs represent a small set of peer categories, not thousands of sequential result pages.

en.tagline: Move through a large result set in separate pages
en.visualHtml: ‹ … 10 ›

zh.title: 结账分为地址、配送、付款和确认四步。怎样让用户知道自己走到哪一步？

options.label: 显示四个步骤，标出当前和已经完成的步骤
options.feedback: 步骤条表达多步流程的位置和进展，不替代每步自己的表单校验。

options.label: 把四步做成可以随意跳转的标签页
options.feedback: 结账步骤有顺序和完成条件，任意跳过会破坏流程。

options.label: 只在标题里写“第 2/4 步”，不展示各步骤名称和完成情况
options.feedback: “第 2/4 步”只能说明数量，用户仍不知道前后分别是什么，也无法快速确认哪些步骤已经完成。

zh.tagline: 步骤条是展示多步流程及当前进度的导航与状态组件
zh.visualHtml: ✓填写信息 2确认订单 3完成支付

en.title: Checkout has Address, Delivery, Payment, and Confirm, and people may return to an earlier step. How should current position be shown?

options.label: Use Steps to mark current and completed stages, allowing return to completed stages
options.feedback: Correct. Steps express position and progress in a multi-step flow; they do not replace validation inside each form.

options.label: Use freely jumpable Tabs as if the stages were unrelated pages
options.feedback: Checkout stages have order and completion conditions; arbitrary skipping breaks the flow.

options.label: Show only a Spinner between stages without showing total stages
options.feedback: A waiting state does not communicate flow position or remaining stages.

en.tagline: Show progress through a task with several required stages
en.visualHtml: ✓Fill in the information 2Confirm order 3Complete payment

zh.title: 每一行项目都有“重命名、复制、归档”。怎样避免列表里挤满按钮？

options.label: 把三个次要操作收进同一个菜单，并保留文字
options.feedback: 与同一对象相关的次要动作可以放进菜单，但不能只靠图标让人猜。

options.label: 每行保留三个图标按钮，只在鼠标悬停时显示名称
options.feedback: 图标含义常有歧义，尤其是低频或有风险的动作。

options.label: 把三个操作都放进右键菜单，行内不再保留任何入口
options.feedback: 右键菜单可以作为补充，但不能作为唯一入口；触屏和不熟悉右键的用户很难发现这些操作。

zh.tagline: 下拉菜单是点击一个入口后展开一组相关操作的浮层菜单组件

en.title: Each project row has Rename, Duplicate, and Archive. How do you avoid a row full of buttons?

options.label: Use an inline Dropdown for these related secondary actions, with clear text when opened
options.feedback: Correct. Related secondary commands can share a menu, but should not rely on guessed icons.

options.label: Use three unlabeled icons per row; people will learn them
options.feedback: Icons are often ambiguous, especially for infrequent or risky actions.

options.label: Treat an action as a form value and save it through a Select
options.feedback: These are immediate commands on the current row, not a persistent field value.

en.tagline: Open a compact menu of actions or destinations

zh.title: 安装文档很长，包含“准备环境、安装、配置、排错”四个章节，用户要快速跳转并知道当前读到哪里。怎样导航？

options.label: 建立页内章节目录，链接到对应锚点，并随滚动高亮当前章节
options.feedback: 锚点直接定位同一页面的内容，高亮还能保持目录与阅读位置同步。

options.label: 把四个章节做成标签页，切换时卸载其他章节内容
options.feedback: 标签会把连续文档拆成互斥状态，用户无法自然滚动阅读全文或使用页内地址定位。

options.label: 只在每章末尾提供“回到顶部”，再让用户从头寻找下一章
options.feedback: 回到顶部不能直接到达目标章节，也没有说明当前阅读位置，长文档查找仍然费力。

zh.tagline: 锚点是让用户在同一长页面内跳到指定章节位置的页内导航链接
zh.visualHtml:
二、方案设计
一、背景 二、方案 三、结论

en.title: A long installation guide has Environment, Install, Configure, and Troubleshoot sections. Users need fast jumps and awareness of the current section. How should it navigate?

options.label: Create an in-page table of contents linked to anchors and highlight the current section on scroll
options.feedback: Anchors locate content within the same page, while highlighting keeps the directory synchronized with reading position.

options.label: Turn the four sections into tabs and unmount every section except the selected one
options.feedback: Tabs split a continuous document into exclusive states, preventing natural reading and addressable in-page locations.

options.label: Only add Back to top after each section and make users find the next section again
options.feedback: Returning to the top does not directly reach a target or communicate current position, so navigation remains costly.

en.tagline: Jump to a named section on the same long page
en.visualHtml:
2. Scheme design
1. Background 2. Plan 3. Conclusion

zh.title: 手机端商品列表很长，用户滚动多屏后常要回顶部换筛选条件，右下角还有客服入口。怎样安排返回顶部？

options.label: 滚动一段距离后显示明确按钮，并避开客服入口和底部操作区
options.feedback: 按钮只在长距离返回有价值时出现，避让现有操作还能保证两个入口都可点击。

options.label: 在所有页面始终显示按钮，即使页面还没有产生滚动
options.feedback: 短页面没有返回需求，常驻按钮会增加噪声并占用有限的手机操作区域。

options.label: 固定在右下角客服按钮上方，用更高层级保证它优先可点
options.feedback: 提高层级只决定谁盖住谁，不能让被遮挡的入口继续可见和可用。

zh.tagline: 回到顶部是让用户从长页面当前位置快速返回页首的导航按钮

en.title: A long mobile product list often requires returning to filters at the top, and a support entry already occupies the bottom-right. How should Back to top work?

options.label: Reveal a clearly named button after meaningful scrolling and keep it clear of support and bottom actions
options.feedback: It appears only when long-distance return is useful, and collision avoidance keeps both controls usable.

options.label: Show the button on every page at all times, including before any scrolling is possible
options.feedback: Short pages have no return need, so a persistent button adds noise and consumes limited mobile action space.

options.label: Place it over the bottom-right support control and raise its layer so it receives clicks first
options.feedback: Layer order only chooses which control covers the other; it does not keep both entries visible and usable.

en.tagline: Return quickly to the top of a long page

zh.title: 键盘用户每次都要按很多次 Tab 才能越过导航、进入正文。怎样减少重复操作？

options.label: 在页面开头提供“跳到正文”的链接
options.feedback: 跳过导航链接让重复使用键盘的人直接越过每页都一样的内容。

options.label: 把导航链接移出 Tab 顺序，让键盘焦点直接进入正文
options.feedback: 移出 Tab 顺序会让键盘用户无法使用导航。正确做法是保留导航，同时提供可主动跳过重复内容的入口。

options.label: 记录上次滚动位置，每次打开页面都自动滚到正文
options.feedback: 自动跳转会打断正常导航；应由键盘用户在需要时主动选择。

zh.tagline: 键盘用户按 Tab 后出现的快捷入口，点击可直接跳过顶部导航到正文
zh.visualHtml: 跳到主要内容

en.title: Keyboard users Tab through a long navigation on every page before reaching content. What should be provided?

options.label: Provide a focusable Skip to main content link at page start that targets main
options.feedback: Correct. A skip link lets repeated keyboard users bypass content that is the same on every page.

options.label: Permanently hide main so people do not pass navigation
options.feedback: Hiding main removes the page’s core information for everyone.

options.label: Automatically move everyone to main on page load
options.feedback: Automatic movement interrupts normal navigation; people should choose it when needed.

en.tagline: A link that lets keyboard users skip repeated navigation and move to the main content
en.visualHtml: Skip to main content

zh.title: 两张卡片彼此贴得太近，但每张卡片内部的文字与边框距离已经合适。应该调整哪里？

options.label: 调整卡片之间的外边距，或统一修改父容器的间距
options.feedback: 问题发生在两个组件之间，外边距或父级 gap 能改变外部关系而不破坏内部留白。

options.label: 增加两张卡片的内边距，让卡片内容进一步远离边框
options.feedback: 内边距只会扩大内容与卡片边框的距离，卡片外边界仍然彼此贴近。

options.label: 在两张卡片中间插入一个固定高度的空白元素
options.feedback: 空元素把视觉间距变成额外内容，响应式变化和统一维护都会更困难。

zh.tagline: 元素边框外侧与其他相邻元素之间的外侧间隔距离。
zh.visualHtml: 卡片 A24卡片 B

en.title: Two cards sit too close together, but the text-to-border spacing inside each card is already correct. What should change?

options.label: Adjust the cards' margin or change the parent container's shared gap
options.feedback: The problem is between components, so margin or parent gap changes their external relationship without disturbing internal space.

options.label: Increase both cards' padding so their content moves farther from their borders
options.feedback: Padding only changes content-to-border distance. The cards' outer edges remain just as close.

options.label: Insert a fixed-height empty element between the two cards
options.feedback: A spacer turns visual distance into extra content and becomes harder to maintain across responsive layouts.

en.tagline: Create space outside an element
en.visualHtml: Card A24Card B

zh.title: 按钮文字紧贴边框，可点击区域也太小，但按钮与旁边元素的距离已经合适。应该怎样调整？

options.label: 增加按钮内部的水平和垂直内边距，并重新检查控件尺寸
options.feedback: Padding 同时拉开文字与边框并扩大按钮自身的点击区域，不改变它和外部元素的关系。

options.label: 增加按钮外边距，把按钮整体推离旁边的文字和图标
options.feedback: Margin 会改变按钮与外界的距离，却不会让文字离边框更远，也不会扩大点击区域。

options.label: 只提高文字行高，让按钮高度随着文本行框一起变大
options.feedback: 行高主要控制文字行框，不能独立建立稳定的左右留白，也不等于完整的按钮内边距。

zh.tagline: 元素内容区域与边框之间的内侧留白间距。
zh.visualHtml: 内容

en.title: Button text touches the border and the hit area is too small, while spacing to nearby elements is already correct. What should change?

options.label: Increase horizontal and vertical button padding and recheck the control size
options.feedback: Padding separates text from the border and expands the button's own hit area without changing external relationships.

options.label: Increase button margin and move the whole button away from nearby text and icons
options.feedback: Margin changes external distance but does not move text away from the border or enlarge the clickable area.

options.label: Only increase text line-height and let the button grow with the line box
options.feedback: Line-height controls the text line box and cannot independently create reliable horizontal space or complete button padding.

en.tagline: Create space between a box and its content
en.visualHtml: Content

zh.title: 同一网站的按钮、输入框和卡片出现了十几种圆角数值，同类组件看起来也不一致。怎样整理？

options.label: 按组件角色建立少量圆角档位，并让同类元素复用同一规则
options.feedback: 角色化档位减少任意数值，同类组件一致，不同角色仍可根据尺寸保持区分。

options.label: 为每个组件保留独立圆角，只要单独看起来协调即可
options.feedback: 局部都合理不代表系统一致，新增组件还会继续产生难以维护的数值。

options.label: 统一给所有按钮、输入框和卡片设置 50% 圆角
options.feedback: 50% 会让长方形形成椭圆或过度圆化，不能作为所有组件的通用档位。

zh.tagline: 控制元素外框边角弧度与圆角曲率的外观样式属性。

en.title: One site uses more than ten radius values across buttons, inputs, and cards, and peers do not match. How should it be organized?

options.label: Create a small set of role-based radius tokens and reuse one rule for peer components
options.feedback: Role tokens remove arbitrary values, align peers, and still let different component sizes remain distinct.

options.label: Keep a unique radius for every component as long as each one looks balanced alone
options.feedback: Local balance does not create system consistency, and every new component adds another value to maintain.

options.label: Set buttons, inputs, and cards all to a 50% radius
options.feedback: Fifty percent turns rectangles into ellipses or excessive rounding and cannot serve every role.

en.tagline: Round the corners of a box

zh.title: 页面同时有普通卡片、下拉菜单和弹窗，现在每个元素都使用同样浓重的阴影。怎样建立更清楚的层级？

options.label: 普通内容保持克制，浮层按真实高度增强阴影，并统一光源方向
options.feedback: 阴影差异对应界面层级，统一方向又让这些层级像来自同一个视觉系统。

options.label: 所有卡片和控件继续使用重阴影，让每个元素都从背景中突出
options.feedback: 每个元素都浮起会失去相对层级，页面同时产生大量互相竞争的边界。

options.label: 给正文文字也加投影，用同一效果补足浅色文字对比度
options.feedback: 文字阴影会降低字形清晰度，对比度应通过前景和背景颜色解决。

zh.tagline: 模拟光影投射效果以构建界面元素悬浮感与视觉层级深度的样式属性。
zh.visualHtml: 浅中浮起

en.title: A page has regular cards, dropdowns, and a modal, but every element uses the same heavy shadow. How should hierarchy become clearer?

options.label: Keep ordinary content restrained, strengthen shadows by actual elevation, and use one light direction
options.feedback: Shadow differences map to interface elevation, while consistent direction makes the layers belong to one system.

options.label: Keep heavy shadows on every card and control so each element stands out
options.feedback: When everything floats, relative hierarchy disappears and many competing boundaries fill the page.

options.label: Add the same shadow to body text to improve contrast against light surfaces
options.feedback: Text shadow reduces glyph clarity; foreground and background colors should establish readable contrast.

en.tagline: Use light and depth to separate overlapping surfaces
en.visualHtml: ShallowMediumFloating

zh.title: 工具栏只有一行：标题靠左，数量会变化的操作按钮靠右，并保持垂直居中。怎样布局最直接？

options.label: 让按钮绝对定位到右侧，再逐个调整 top 数值
options.feedback: 按钮脱离正常排列后，标题或按钮数量变化容易重叠，垂直对齐也要反复手调。

options.label: 父级使用 Flex，两端分布并设置交叉轴居中
options.feedback: 这是沿一条主轴排列的关系；Flex 能让两组内容自然分居两端，并统一垂直对齐。

options.label: 给标题和每个按钮写固定外边距，把它们推到目标位置
options.feedback: 固定距离只适配当前文字和按钮数量，内容变化后不能继续保持两端关系。

zh.tagline: 沿一维主轴方向自动计算并分配子元素尺寸、对齐与间隙的弹性布局系统。

en.title: A toolbar has one row: a title on the left and a changing number of actions on the right, all vertically centered. Which layout is most direct?

options.label: Absolutely position the actions on the right and tune each top value
options.feedback: Removing actions from normal flow makes overlap likely when the title or action count changes.

options.label: Use Flex on the parent, distribute both sides, and center the cross axis
options.feedback: This is a one-axis relationship. Flex keeps the two groups at opposite ends and aligns them vertically.

options.label: Give the title and every action fixed margins until they reach the target positions
options.feedback: Fixed distances only fit the current content and stop preserving the relationship when text or actions change.

en.tagline: Arrange items along one row or one column

zh.title: 模板库要把同类卡片排成多行多列，并根据容器宽度自动减少列数。怎样实现更合适？

options.label: 给每张卡片固定宽度和左边距，逐项计算换行位置
options.feedback: 逐项计算会把布局绑在当前数量和宽度上，容器变化时容易出现空洞或溢出。

options.label: 父级使用 Grid，以 minmax 定义可换列的轨道
options.feedback: 任务同时涉及行和列；网格轨道能统一管理列宽、间距，并按可用空间重新排布。

options.label: 用 Flex 换行，并把每张卡固定为 33.33% 宽
options.feedback: Flex 可以换行，但固定三等分还要额外计算间距和窄屏列数，二维轨道更直接。

zh.tagline: 基于二维行与列网格定位并分配元素位置与占比的二维排版系统。

en.title: A template library needs multiple rows and columns of similar cards, with fewer columns as the container narrows. Which implementation fits?

options.label: Give each card a fixed width and margin and calculate every wrap point
options.feedback: Manual calculations bind the layout to the current count and width, causing gaps or overflow when the container changes.

options.label: Use Grid on the parent and define responsive tracks with minmax
options.feedback: The task coordinates rows and columns. Grid tracks manage width, gaps, and rearrangement from the available space.

options.label: Wrap with Flex and fix every card at 33.33% width
options.feedback: Flex can wrap, but fixed thirds still require gap calculations and separate rules for narrower column counts.

en.tagline: Plan rows and columns as one layout system

zh.title: 下拉菜单已经设为 z-index: 99999，却仍被卡片边界裁掉。下一步最该检查什么？

options.label: 继续把菜单的 z-index 增加到更大的数字
options.feedback: 更大的数字仍受父级层叠上下文和裁切范围限制，不能让子元素越过这些边界。

options.label: 检查父级的 overflow、定位和层叠上下文
options.feedback: 菜单被裁掉通常不只是数值大小问题；要先找到限制它的父级边界，再决定浮层放置方式。

options.label: 把卡片及其所有子元素的 z-index 一起提高
options.feedback: 整体抬高可能压住其他浮层，却没有解除卡片自身的裁切，也会让全局层级更混乱。

zh.tagline: 定位元素在垂直屏幕轴向上的层叠与覆盖优先级规则。
zh.visualHtml: z: 1 z: 2 z: 3

en.title: A dropdown already has z-index: 99999 but is still clipped at the card boundary. What should be inspected next?

options.label: Keep increasing the dropdown's z-index to a larger number
options.feedback: A larger number remains constrained by parent stacking contexts and clipping boundaries.

options.label: Inspect parent overflow, positioning, and stacking contexts
options.feedback: Clipping is usually not a number problem. Find the parent boundary first, then choose the correct layer placement.

options.label: Increase the z-index of the card and every child together
options.feedback: Raising the whole card can cover other overlays without removing the card's own clipping behavior.

en.tagline: Control which overlapping layer appears on top
en.visualHtml: z: 1 z: 2 z: 3

zh.title: 浮层需要半透明背景，让后面的页面隐约可见，但浮层里的文字和按钮必须保持清晰。应该怎样实现？

options.label: 给背景颜色设置透明度，保持文字和按钮本身完全不透明
options.feedback: 半透明颜色只影响背景层，子内容仍维持原有对比度和点击可见性。

options.label: 直接降低整个浮层的 opacity，让背景和所有内容一起变淡
options.feedback: Opacity 会同时影响子元素，文字和按钮也会失去清晰度，无法满足当前限制。

options.label: 需要隐藏时设 opacity: 0，继续保留浮层的点击和焦点
options.feedback: 透明为零不等于移除，元素仍可能挡住页面并接收键盘焦点。

zh.tagline: 透明度是通过 opacity 同时降低元素及其全部子内容可见程度的 CSS 属性
zh.visualHtml: 100%50%15%

en.title: A surface needs a translucent background revealing the page behind, while its text and buttons remain crisp. What should be done?

options.label: Apply transparency to the background color while keeping text and controls fully opaque
options.feedback: A translucent color affects only the background layer, preserving content contrast and visible interaction.

options.label: Lower opacity on the entire surface so its background and all content fade together
options.feedback: Opacity affects descendants too, reducing the clarity of text and buttons against the requirement.

options.label: Set opacity: 0 when hidden but keep the surface clickable and focusable
options.feedback: Zero opacity does not remove the element; it may still block the page and receive keyboard focus.

en.tagline: Make an element and its contents more transparent
en.visualHtml: 100%50%15%

zh.title: 一位第一次访问的用户打开产品官网，需要马上知道产品解决什么问题以及下一步做什么。首屏怎样组织更有效？

options.label: 用明确标题和说明讲清价值，突出一个主要行动，并配必要的产品画面
options.feedback: 标题、说明、行动和画面共同服务于首要理解，用户能判断产品是否相关并继续。

options.label: 使用抽象口号和大幅装饰图，把具体能力留到页面底部再解释
options.feedback: 画面可能醒目，但新访客无法从首屏判断产品负责什么，也不知道是否值得继续。

options.label: 把客户标志、全部功能、三档定价和 FAQ 一起塞进首屏
options.feedback: 信息都重要不等于都属于首屏；过多并列内容会冲淡最主要的价值和行动。

zh.tagline: 网页开头用来说明页面重点并引导下一步的主要区域

en.title: A first-time visitor opens a product site and needs to understand the problem it solves and what to do next. How should the hero work?

options.label: State the value in a clear heading and explanation, emphasize one action, and show the necessary product view
options.feedback: The heading, support copy, action, and visual serve one primary understanding so visitors can judge relevance and continue.

options.label: Use an abstract slogan and large decorative image, explaining the actual capability near the page bottom
options.feedback: The composition may be striking, but new visitors cannot tell what the product does or whether to continue.

options.label: Place customer logos, every feature, three prices, and the FAQ together in the hero
options.feedback: Important content does not all belong in the hero. Too many parallel messages dilute the primary value and action.

en.tagline: Use the opening area to explain the page's main point and next step

zh.title: 落地页的主要目标是让访客开始免费试用，但首屏同时放了“提交、了解更多、联系我们”三个同样醒目的按钮。怎样调整？

options.label: 突出“开始免费试用”，将其他入口降为次级，并说明试用条件
options.feedback: 主行动直接说明点击结果，层级和必要条件还能减少访客在关键一步的犹豫。

options.label: 保留三个同等强调的主按钮，让不同访客自行判断下一步
options.feedback: 同一视觉区域里多个主目标会相互竞争，用户反而更难识别页面希望他完成什么。

options.label: 把三个按钮统一改成“提交”，通过点击后页面再解释结果
options.feedback: “提交”没有说明将开始试用、查看信息还是联系销售，用户点击前无法预期结果。

zh.tagline: CTA 是引导用户执行注册、试用或购买等关键动作的核心入口。

en.title: A landing page primarily wants visitors to start a free trial, but its hero has equally prominent Submit, Learn more, and Contact us buttons. What should change?

options.label: Emphasize Start free trial, demote the other paths, and state the trial conditions
options.feedback: The primary action names its outcome, while hierarchy and relevant conditions reduce hesitation at the key step.

options.label: Keep three equally prominent primary buttons and let each visitor decide
options.feedback: Multiple primary goals compete within one visual region, making the intended next step harder to identify.

options.label: Rename every button Submit and explain the result only after it is clicked
options.feedback: Submit does not say whether it starts a trial, reveals information, or contacts sales, so the outcome is unclear beforehand.

en.tagline: Tell visitors the next action you want them to take

zh.title: 官网要展示客户说“每周少花两小时整理报表”，团队想把它改得更夸张并补一个职业头像。应该怎样处理？

options.label: 保留经确认的原话，说明使用场景、取得方式和授权身份
options.feedback: 具体经历和可核实背景构成用户原声的可信度，展示范围也应服从真实授权。

options.label: 改写成“效率提升 10 倍”，让结果更适合官网传播
options.feedback: 未经证据支持的放大会改变客户原意，不能再作为真实使用结果展示。

options.label: 保留匿名文字，但生成一个头像、姓名和职位增强真实感
options.feedback: 匿名评价可以使用，虚构身份却会把隐私处理变成不存在的可验证背书。

zh.tagline: 真实用户表达的使用体验、诉求与评价原话，用于校准产品需求与设计方向。

en.title: A customer said, We spend two fewer hours each week preparing reports. The team wants to exaggerate it and add a professional avatar. What should happen?

options.label: Keep the confirmed words and state the use case, collection method, and authorized identity
options.feedback: A specific experience and verifiable context create credibility, while display scope must follow actual permission.

options.label: Rewrite it as 10× more efficient so the result works better in marketing
options.feedback: Unsupported amplification changes the customer's meaning and cannot be presented as a real usage result.

options.label: Keep the text anonymous but generate an avatar, name, and title to make it feel real
options.feedback: Anonymous feedback can be valid, but invented identity turns privacy treatment into a false verifiable endorsement.

zh.title: 官网页头在桌面放品牌、五个导航、搜索和登录，到了手机后已经挤成两行。怎样调整？

options.label: 保留品牌和关键操作，把次要导航收进可关闭的移动菜单
options.feedback: 页头继续承担身份和主要入口，移动端按优先级收纳能避免把每个元素强行压小。

options.label: 继续保留全部入口，并缩小字体、间距和按钮高度直到一行
options.feedback: 内容虽然挤回一行，却会降低阅读和点击准确性，也没有建立移动端信息优先级。

options.label: 隐藏品牌和首页入口，只保留导航、搜索与登录
options.feedback: 用户会失去当前网站身份和返回首页的稳定入口，页头的基本职责没有完成。

zh.tagline: 网页顶部集中放置品牌、导航、搜索和账号入口的区域

en.title: A desktop header contains brand, five navigation items, search, and login, but wraps to two lines on mobile. How should it adapt?

options.label: Keep brand and the key action, and move secondary navigation into a dismissible mobile menu
options.feedback: The header preserves identity and primary access, while prioritization avoids shrinking every control beyond usability.

options.label: Keep every entry and reduce type, gaps, and button height until they fit one line
options.feedback: It may fit, but readability and click accuracy decline, and no mobile information priority is established.

options.label: Hide the brand and home entry while keeping navigation, search, and login
options.feedback: Users lose the site identity and stable home path, leaving a basic header responsibility unmet.

zh.title: 窄屏上横向 Logo 挤占了导航按钮，应该怎样处理？

options.label: 使用已定义的紧凑或图形版 Logo，并在窄屏和深色背景分别验收
options.feedback: Logo 可以有适配变体，保持品牌识别的同时给导航留下空间；不应直接删除品牌或改成工具栏图标。

options.label: 继续缩小横向文字版 Logo，直到它和导航挤在同一行
options.feedback: 尺寸变小但文字不可读时，品牌识别已经失败；应切换到合适的紧凑变体。

options.label: 用菜单图标完全替代 Logo，让用户从导航里猜品牌
options.feedback: 菜单图标表达展开导航的动作，不能替代品牌身份入口。

en.title: A horizontal Logo crowds the navigation on a narrow screen. What should you do?

options.label: Use the defined compact or symbol Logo and verify it separately on narrow and dark surfaces
options.feedback: Correct. Logo variants can adapt to space while preserving recognition; do not delete the brand or turn it into a toolbar icon.

options.label: Keep shrinking the horizontal wordmark until it fits beside the navigation
options.feedback: If the text becomes unreadable, brand recognition has already failed; switch to an appropriate compact variant.

options.label: Replace the Logo entirely with a menu icon and make people infer the brand from navigation
options.feedback: A menu icon communicates the action of opening navigation and cannot replace the brand identity entry.

en.tagline: A brand mark used to identify an organization, product, or service

zh.title: 官网的“产品、模板、价格、博客”需要在各页面保持一致，并清楚标出当前栏目。应该放在哪里？

options.label: 放进全站顶部导航栏，并高亮当前栏目
options.feedback: 这些是跨页面的核心目的地，持续可见的导航栏能提供稳定入口和位置提示。

options.label: 每个页面各自放一组内容页签
options.feedback: 页签用于同一页面或对象内的平级内容，不适合承担全站主要目的地。

options.label: 桌面端默认藏进右侧抽屉，需要时再打开
options.feedback: 桌面空间充足时隐藏所有核心入口会增加访问步骤，也削弱当前位置提示。

zh.tagline: 顶部导航栏是网页页头中提供主要页面入口和当前位置提示的导航区域

en.title: Product, Templates, Pricing, and Blog must stay consistent across the site and show the current section. Where should they go?

options.label: Place them in a global top navbar and highlight the current section
options.feedback: These are major cross-page destinations, so a persistent navbar provides stable access and location.

options.label: Create a separate set of content tabs on every page
options.feedback: Tabs organize peer content within one page or object, not the site's main destinations.

options.label: Hide them in a right drawer by default on desktop
options.feedback: Hiding every core destination despite available space adds steps and weakens location awareness.

en.tagline: Keep the brand, main destinations, and key action easy to reach

zh.title: 官网页脚需要放隐私、条款、帮助和联系方式，但 7 天退款期限会直接影响购买。怎样组织？

options.label: 按用途分组补充链接和联系入口，退款期限仍在购买区域显示
options.feedback: 页脚适合集中补充信息，影响决定的规则则应在用户行动前就能看到。

options.label: 把顶部所有导航和按钮原样复制到底部，再追加法律链接
options.feedback: 机械重复会形成难以扫描的链接堆，页脚应围绕结尾阶段的补充需求组织。

options.label: 只在页脚条款链接中说明退款期限，购买卡片保持简洁
options.feedback: 退款限制影响购买判断，藏在页面底部会让用户在行动前无法得到关键信息。

en.title: A site footer needs privacy, terms, help, and contact details, while a seven-day refund window directly affects purchase. How should it be organized?

options.label: Group supplementary links and contact paths, while keeping the refund window visible near purchase
options.feedback: The footer consolidates supplementary information, while decision-critical terms remain visible before action.

options.label: Copy every header navigation item and button into the footer and then add legal links
options.feedback: Mechanical repetition creates an unscannable link pile instead of serving needs at the end of the page.

options.label: Mention the refund window only inside a footer terms link to keep pricing cards clean
options.feedback: A refund limit changes the purchase decision, so hiding it at the bottom withholds key information before action.

zh.title: 客服记录显示用户反复询问退款期限和数据安全。官网 FAQ 应该怎样整理这些内容？

options.label: 按真实问题写标题，答案先给结论，再说明条件和下一步入口
options.feedback: 真实问题对应实际疑虑，先给结论能快速解答，条件和链接帮助用户继续处理。

options.label: 改写成“为什么我们是最佳选择”等问题，用答案集中介绍优点
options.feedback: 自问自答的宣传没有解决客服反复收到的具体疑问，会降低 FAQ 的可信度。

options.label: 只在 FAQ 答案深处说明退款限制，购买区域不再重复展示
options.feedback: FAQ 可以补充细节，但影响购买决定的限制不能只等待用户主动展开寻找。

en.title: Support records show repeated questions about refund windows and data security. How should the site FAQ organize them?

options.label: Use the real questions as headings, answer with the conclusion first, then conditions and a next-step link
options.feedback: Real questions address actual concerns, a conclusion answers quickly, and conditions plus links support follow-up.

options.label: Rewrite them as Why are we the best choice? and use the answers to list product strengths
options.feedback: Promotional self-questioning does not resolve the concrete issues repeatedly reaching support and weakens trust.

zh.title: 订阅页提供个人、团队和企业三档方案，既有月付也有年付。怎样让用户完成真实成本比较？

options.label: 并列说明适用对象、核心权益、计费周期、实际总价和取消规则
options.feedback: 这些信息共同决定方案是否适合以及实际要付多少，用户能够在同一口径下比较。

options.label: 只突出年付折算后的最低月均价，把年付总额放到结账页
options.feedback: 月均价方便比较，但隐藏本次总额会让用户无法在选择前判断真实支出。

options.label: 给利润最高的方案标“最受欢迎”，不说明适用对象或数据来源
options.feedback: 推荐标记会影响选择；没有真实依据时，它不能证明该方案更适合当前用户。

zh.tagline: 定价区是把多个套餐的价格、权益和适用对象并列比较的页面区块

en.title: A subscription page offers Individual, Team, and Enterprise plans with monthly and annual billing. How can users compare real cost?

options.label: Compare intended users, core benefits, billing period, actual total, and cancellation terms
options.feedback: Together these determine fit and actual payment, allowing each plan to be compared on the same basis.

options.label: Emphasize only the lowest annual monthly equivalent and reveal the annual total at checkout
options.feedback: A monthly equivalent aids comparison, but hiding the charged total prevents users from judging real cost before selection.

options.label: Mark the highest-margin plan Most popular without an audience or evidence
options.feedback: Recommendations influence choice. Without evidence, the badge cannot show that the plan fits the current user.

en.tagline: Help visitors compare plans, cost, and included value

zh.title: 官网准备展示客户 Logo 和“10 万团队在用”，但目前只有估算数字，部分 Logo 也没有展示授权。应该怎样处理？

options.label: 只展示已授权素材和可核验数据，并注明时间、口径与来源
options.feedback: 社会证明的价值来自外部可信依据，授权和统计说明让访客知道证据代表什么。

options.label: 先放知名客户 Logo 增加信任，等官网上线后再集中申请授权
options.feedback: 未经授权的标识不能作为可信证据，先展示还会带来品牌和事实风险。

options.label: 把估算数字取整成“10 万+”，只要视觉上足够醒目就不写来源
options.feedback: 无法说明统计对象、时间和来源的数字不能被核验，醒目反而会放大可信度问题。

zh.tagline: 通过展示他人使用证据与评价来降低信任成本、辅助用户决策的设计证明。
zh.visualHtml:
示例占位，使用时须替换为已授权、可核验的资料。

证据展示位置

客户标识需授权来源可查
评分或数据标注来源、统计时间和计算口径

en.title: A site wants customer logos and Used by 100,000 teams, but the count is estimated and some logos lack display permission. What should happen?

options.label: Show only authorized assets and verifiable data, with date, definition, and source
options.feedback: Social proof derives value from credible external evidence. Permission and measurement notes explain what that evidence represents.

options.label: Publish recognizable customer logos first and request permission after the site launches
options.feedback: Unauthorized marks cannot serve as trustworthy evidence, and publishing first creates brand and factual risk.

options.label: Round the estimate to 100,000+ and omit its source as long as the number looks prominent
options.feedback: A number without audience, time, or source cannot be verified, and prominence amplifies the credibility problem.

en.tagline: Support a product claim with evidence from real use
en.visualHtml:
Example only · Replace with authorized, verifiable evidence before use.

Evidence

Customer identityAuthorization requiredVerifiable source
Rating or dataMark the source, timeframe and calculation method

zh.title: 双语杂志网站想用衬线标题和非衬线正文，英文样张很好看，但中文会回退成浏览器默认字体。下一步怎样做？

options.label: 选择覆盖中英文的字体和回退方案，用真实样张测试
options.feedback: 字体风格只有在语言覆盖、字号、字重和行高都可用时才成立，fallback 也应纳入系统。

options.label: 只指定英文字体名称，中文继续交给各个浏览器自动选择回退
options.feedback: 中文回退不受设计控制，双语页面可能出现字重、比例和气质明显不一致。

options.label: 每个同级标题分别挑最有感觉的衬线或非衬线字体
options.feedback: 没有角色规则的混用会让同一层级失去一致性，也难以维护加载和回退。

zh.tagline: 衬线与非衬线是按笔画末端是否带有装饰来区分的两类字体风格
zh.visualHtml:
好的设计经得起凝视

同一段文案，衬线让它显得优雅、正式，像杂志里的编辑精选。

衬线 · Georgia / 宋体
好的设计经得起凝视

同一段文案，非衬线让它显得现代、干净，像效率工具的界面。

非衬线 · 系统默认

en.title: A bilingual editorial site wants serif headings and sans-serif body text. English samples work, but Chinese falls back to browser defaults. What comes next?

options.label: Choose bilingual fonts and fallbacks, then test them with real copy
options.feedback: The style only works when coverage, size, weight, and line-height remain readable, and fallback is part of the system.

options.label: Specify only the English font and let each browser choose its own Chinese fallback
options.feedback: Uncontrolled fallback can create visibly different weight, proportion, and tone across the bilingual page.

options.label: Choose whichever serif or sans font feels best for each heading at the same level
options.feedback: Role-free mixing breaks hierarchy consistency and makes font loading and fallback difficult to maintain.

en.tagline: Choose letterforms that match the content and reading task
en.visualHtml:
Good design holds up to a long look

The same copy in a serif feels elegant and formal, like an editor's pick in a magazine.

Serif · Georgia / Songti
Good design holds up to a long look

The same copy in a sans feels modern and clean, like the interface of a productivity tool.

Sans · System default

zh.title: Hero 使用蓝到紫的渐变背景，白色标题在中间清楚，但靠近浅色一端几乎看不见。怎样修正？

options.label: 调整色阶或文字区域，使整段背景都满足可读性，并准备纯色回退
options.feedback: 渐变每个位置都可能成为文字背景，只有检查完整区域才能保证标题持续可读。

options.label: 增加更多高饱和颜色，让渐变更醒目并盖过文字问题
options.feedback: 更强的颜色变化会进一步干扰正文，不能替代前景与各区域的对比度检查。

options.label: 把同一渐变复制到卡片、按钮和页脚，依靠重复形成全站统一
options.feedback: 重复重点效果会削弱 Hero 的主次，也把对比度风险扩散到更多内容。

zh.tagline: 渐变是一种让两个或多个颜色在指定方向或范围内连续过渡的视觉效果
zh.visualHtml: 线性 · 活力 径向 · 聚焦 双色 · 潮流 同色 · 克制

en.title: A hero uses a blue-to-purple gradient. Its white heading reads well in the center but nearly disappears at the light end. How should it be fixed?

options.label: Adjust color stops or the text region for readability across the full area and provide a solid fallback
options.feedback: Every gradient position can sit behind the heading, so the entire text region must preserve contrast.

options.label: Add more saturated colors so the gradient looks stronger and overpowers the text issue
options.feedback: Stronger color variation further competes with copy and cannot replace contrast checks across the background.

options.label: Repeat the same gradient across cards, buttons, and footer to create site-wide consistency
options.feedback: Repeating a focal effect weakens hierarchy and spreads the same contrast risk to more content.

en.tagline: Blend colors gradually across an area
en.visualHtml: Linear · Energy Radial · Focus Duotone · Trendy Tonal · Restrained

zh.title: 全站卡片有的接近直角、有的像胶囊，按钮和输入框也各用不同数值。怎样统一“圆角气质”？

options.label: 按卡片、输入和操作等角色建立少量档位，同类组件保持一致
options.feedback: 圆角感受来自整套角色关系，少量规则能形成一致气质，也保留必要层级。

options.label: 把所有元素统一成最大圆角，确保整个网站都显得柔和
options.feedback: 同一显著圆角会抹平组件角色，长方形内容还可能变成不合适的胶囊或椭圆。

options.label: 保留现状，遇到不协调的组件就单独微调一个新数值
options.feedback: 逐项修补会继续扩大规则数量，下一次新增组件仍无法知道该使用哪个档位。

zh.tagline: 圆角的气质是指不同圆角大小在界面中带来的视觉感受和一致性规则
zh.visualHtml: 按钮直角 · 边缘清楚 按钮较小圆角 按钮较大圆角 按钮胶囊轮廓

en.title: Some cards are nearly square and others pill-like, while buttons and inputs each use different values. How can the site's corner feel become coherent?

options.label: Create a small set of role-based levels for cards, inputs, and actions and keep peers consistent
options.feedback: Corner feel emerges from role relationships, so a small system creates coherence while retaining necessary hierarchy.

options.label: Apply maximum rounding to every element so the whole site feels soft
options.feedback: One strong radius erases component roles and may turn rectangular content into inappropriate pills or ellipses.

options.label: Keep the current system and introduce a new value whenever one component feels wrong
options.feedback: One-off fixes continue expanding the rule set and leave future components without a clear choice.

en.tagline: Use corner shape to support the product's visual tone
en.visualHtml: Button Right angle · Clear edge Button Smaller rounded corners Button Larger rounded corners ButtonCapsule outline

zh.title: 项目卡片的“删除”入口只在鼠标悬停时出现，手机和键盘都找不到。应该怎样改？

options.label: 保留悬停显示，并让入口出现得更快
options.feedback: 速度不会解决触屏没有悬停、键盘用户不经过鼠标的问题，入口仍然不可发现。

options.label: 保留克制的悬停反馈，同时支持聚焦和触屏入口
options.feedback: 悬停可以强化鼠标反馈，但关键操作还要能通过键盘聚焦和触屏方式发现并执行。

options.label: 桌面继续悬停显示，手机端直接移除删除入口
options.feedback: 移除入口会让手机用户无法完成相同任务；应提供适合触屏的可见菜单或操作。

zh.tagline: 指针设备悬停在交互元素上方时触发的即时视觉反馈状态。
zh.visualHtml: 悬停我浮起 + 变色 对照组我不响应 将鼠标移到按钮上查看悬停变化 ↑

en.title: A card's Delete action appears only on mouse hover, so touch and keyboard users cannot find it. What should change?

options.label: Keep hover-only visibility but make the action appear faster
options.feedback: Speed does not help touch devices without hover or keyboard users who never move a pointer over the card.

options.label: Keep restrained hover feedback and also support focus and touch access
options.feedback: Hover can reinforce mouse interaction, but an important action also needs discoverable keyboard and touch paths.

options.label: Keep hover on desktop and remove the Delete action on mobile
options.feedback: Removing the action prevents mobile users from completing the same task instead of providing a touch-friendly entry.

en.tagline: Respond when a pointer rests over an interactive element
en.visualHtml: Hover meLift + color ControlI don't react Move your mouse over them ↑

zh.title: 提交按钮按下到松开的瞬间没有任何变化，用户经常连续点两次。怎样补充反馈？

options.label: 在按下期间轻微改变颜色或位置，松开后恢复，并支持键盘激活
options.feedback: 短暂变化直接回应输入动作，恢复后也不会被误认为持续选中或禁用状态。

options.label: 第一次点击后一直保持按下样式，直到用户再次点击
options.feedback: 持续样式表达的是切换或选中，不是从按下到松开的瞬时反馈。

options.label: 只保留悬停变色，按下到松开期间不增加反馈，因为 hover 已经说明能点
options.feedback: 悬停只提示指针所在位置，不能确认已经按下；键盘激活时也可能没有这层提示。

zh.tagline: 用户按下或触控元素期间触发的即时物理受力反馈状态。
zh.visualHtml: 按住按钮比较：左侧有按下反馈，右侧只有悬停反馈

en.title: A submit button shows no change between pointer down and release, so users often click twice. What feedback should be added?

options.label: Change color or position slightly while pressed, restore on release, and support keyboard activation
options.feedback: A brief change responds directly to input and restores before it can be mistaken for selection or disablement.

options.label: Keep the pressed style after the first click until the user clicks again
options.feedback: Persistent styling expresses a toggle or selection rather than the moment from press to release.

options.label: Keep only the hover color and add no press-to-release feedback because hover already shows it is clickable
options.feedback: Hover only shows where the pointer is; it does not confirm a press and may not appear during keyboard activation.

en.tagline: Show that a control is being pressed right now
en.visualHtml: Press and hold: the left one sinks, the right one gives no sense of a click

zh.title: 用键盘按 Tab 时，看不出接下来会操作哪个控件。应该先补什么？

options.label: 给当前控件显示清楚的选中轮廓
options.feedback: 焦点指示告诉键盘用户当前位置，不能只在鼠标悬停时出现。

options.label: 只在鼠标点击控件后显示轮廓，按 Tab 时隐藏
options.feedback: 看不见焦点会让键盘操作失去位置，无法判断下一次 Enter 会触发什么。

options.label: 给所有可点击控件加更明显的鼠标悬停底色
options.feedback: 键盘操作不依赖鼠标位置，hover 不能替代 focus。

zh.tagline: 控件当前接收键盘输入与用户操作焦点的激活状态。
zh.visualHtml: 依次聚焦两个输入框：左侧有清楚描边，右侧缺少可见焦点

en.title: A keyboard user cannot tell which control Tab will operate. What should be added first?

options.label: Keep a clear visible focus style on interactive controls
options.feedback: Correct. Focus indication tells keyboard users their position and cannot be replaced by hover.

options.label: Remove the browser focus outline for a cleaner UI
options.feedback: Invisible focus removes position from keyboard operation and hides what Enter will trigger.

options.label: Improve hover only because keyboard users also see a mouse
options.feedback: Keyboard operation does not depend on pointer position; hover cannot replace focus.

en.tagline: Show which element will receive keyboard input
en.visualHtml: Click into both: the left one shows a ring, the right one hides its focus

zh.title: 任务卡支持拖拽排序，但键盘用户和手抖用户也要能调整顺序。哪套设计更完整？

options.label: 只支持拖拽，并用更大的阴影表示抓取成功
options.feedback: 视觉反馈能说明拖拽状态，却没有给无法稳定拖动的人提供完成排序的方式。

options.label: 显示拖拽手柄和落点，同时提供上移、下移操作
options.feedback: 拖动过程有清楚反馈，替代按钮又让键盘和精细操作困难的用户完成同一任务。

options.label: 把整张卡片设成拖拽区，取消文字选择和普通点击
options.feedback: 扩大热区会和选择文字、点击链接等操作冲突，也没有解决键盘排序问题。

zh.tagline: 拖拽是一种按住元素并移动它的位置或把它放到目标区域的交互方式
zh.visualHtml:
⠿ 拖我 放到这里
拖动卡片查看拖拽状态，松手后恢复原位

en.title: Task cards support drag reordering, but keyboard users and people with unsteady movement must also change the order. Which design is complete?

options.label: Support dragging only and use a stronger shadow to confirm pickup
options.feedback: The shadow explains drag state but provides no way to reorder for someone who cannot drag reliably.

options.label: Show a drag handle and drop position, plus Move up and Move down actions
options.feedback: Drag feedback clarifies the gesture, while alternative actions let keyboard and motor-impaired users complete the same task.

options.label: Make the whole card draggable and disable text selection and normal clicks
options.feedback: A full-card drag target conflicts with selecting text and using links, and it still lacks keyboard reordering.

en.tagline: Move or reorder an item by holding and pulling it
en.visualHtml:
⠿ Drag me Drop here
Drag the card to see its active state. Release it to return it to its original position.

zh.title: 提交按钮因“公司名称”未填而禁用，但用户只看到一个灰色按钮。怎样让原因更清楚？

options.label: 把原因只放进按钮的鼠标悬停提示里
options.feedback: 原生禁用按钮通常不能聚焦，触屏也没有稳定悬停；很多用户仍然看不到原因。

options.label: 在缺失字段附近说明要求，并随填写更新按钮状态
options.feedback: 原因和解决方法都靠近问题来源，键盘与触屏用户也能看见何时满足提交条件。

options.label: 只降低按钮透明度，但继续让点击触发提交
options.feedback: 视觉上像禁用、行为却仍可执行，会产生冲突反馈，也可能提交不完整数据。

zh.tagline: 禁用是表示控件当前不能执行操作的交互状态
zh.visualHtml: 先填写邮箱才能提交 右侧使用原生 disabled；原因需要在控件附近持续可见

en.title: Submit is disabled because Company name is empty, but people only see a gray button. How can the reason become clear?

options.label: Put the reason only in a mouse-hover tooltip on the button
options.feedback: Native disabled buttons are often not focusable, and touch has no reliable hover, so the reason remains inaccessible.

options.label: Explain the requirement near the missing field and update the button as it is completed
options.feedback: The cause and remedy appear where the problem occurs, and every input method can see when submission becomes available.

options.label: Lower the button opacity but still submit when it is clicked
options.feedback: The visual state says unavailable while the behavior still runs, creating conflicting feedback and incomplete submissions.

en.tagline: Show that a control is currently unavailable
en.visualHtml: Enter your email address to continue Use the native disabled attribute for the unavailable button, and keep the reason visible beside it

zh.title: 开关的滑块只需要在开和关两个位置之间平滑移动。怎样实现更合适？

options.label: 只给 transform 设置短过渡，并处理减少动态效果偏好
options.feedback: 变化只有明确的起点和终点；限定属性能避免无关样式被动画，并尊重用户的动态偏好。

options.label: 给整个开关设置 transition: all，持续一秒
options.feedback: all 会让未来新增的颜色、尺寸等属性意外参与动画，一秒也会拖慢即时操作反馈。

options.label: 分别写“打开”和“关闭”两套关键帧，再按状态播放
options.feedback: 关键帧能实现运动，但两套方向要重复维护；已有起点和终点时，过渡更直接。

zh.tagline: 控制 CSS 属性在不同状态转换过程中产生平滑渐变的动画机制。
zh.visualHtml:
悬停我← 真的会变（transition）
分帧示意：颜色一格一格变过去，而不是瞬间跳变

en.title: A switch thumb only needs to move smoothly between its on and off positions. Which implementation fits best?

options.label: Apply a short transition only to transform and respect reduced-motion preferences
options.feedback: The change has clear start and end states. Limiting the property avoids animating unrelated styles and respects motion preferences.

options.label: Set transition: all on the whole switch for one second
options.feedback: The all keyword can animate future color or size changes unintentionally, and one second slows direct feedback.

options.label: Write separate Open and Close keyframes and choose one for each state
options.feedback: Keyframes can move the thumb, but two directions duplicate maintenance when a transition already connects the current and next states.

en.tagline: Smooth the change between two visual states
en.visualHtml:
Hover me← it really animates (transition)
Frame by frame: the color eases over instead of snapping

zh.title: 加载图标需要持续旋转，完成后停止；用户开启“减少动态效果”后，图标也不应持续旋转。怎样实现更合适？

options.label: 用关键帧控制旋转，由加载状态启停，并为减少动态效果提供静态反馈
options.feedback: 自主循环适合 Animation，界面状态决定播放范围，减弱方案保留信息而不强迫持续运动。

options.label: 只设置 transition，让图标在没有属性变化时自动持续旋转
options.feedback: Transition 需要属性状态发生变化才能运行，不能独立定义连续循环。

options.label: 让图标在加载结束后继续循环，作为页面保持活力的装饰
options.feedback: 完成后持续运动不再表达加载状态，只会分散注意力并违背减少动态效果偏好。

zh.tagline: 动画是一种用 @keyframes 定义多个阶段，并控制其播放方式的 CSS 动效
zh.visualHtml: 0%50%100%@keyframes 定义节点，浏览器补齐中间

en.title: A loading icon spins continuously and stops when complete. Under reduced motion, it should not keep spinning. What is the right approach?

options.label: Use keyframes, start and stop from loading state, and provide static feedback under reduced motion
options.feedback: Autonomous looping suits Animation, state defines its lifetime, and the reduced version preserves information without forced motion.

options.label: Use only transition and make the icon rotate continuously without any property change
options.feedback: A transition requires a property state change and cannot independently define a continuous loop.

options.label: Keep the icon looping after loading so the page continues to feel active
options.feedback: Motion after completion no longer communicates loading, distracts attention, and ignores reduced-motion preference.

en.tagline: Run a planned sequence of visual changes
en.visualHtml: 0%50%100%@keyframes Define the node and the browser fills in the middle

zh.title: 弹窗进入时需要快速响应再平稳停下，退出时不应拖延当前操作。怎样设置速度变化更合理？

options.label: 进入先尝试快进慢停，退出尝试加速离开，并按距离测试后收敛为变量
options.feedback: 进入、退出的任务方向不同，按语义测试并复用曲线能兼顾响应感与一致性。

options.label: 所有进入、退出和持续动画都用 linear，保证每一帧移动相同距离
options.feedback: 匀速适合持续旋转或进度，对界面位移常显得机械，也没有区分进入和离开。

options.label: 每个弹窗单独拖一条不同曲线，只按当前画面感觉决定
options.feedback: 局部可能顺眼，但随意曲线会让同类交互产生不同节奏，难以维护和预测。

zh.tagline: 缓动是规定动画在持续时间内如何加速和减速的速度曲线
zh.visualHtml: ease-out 入场ease-in 退场linear 机械

en.title: A modal should respond quickly and settle smoothly on entry, while exit should not delay the current task. How should its speed change?

options.label: Start entry fast and settle, accelerate exit, test against distance, and consolidate curves into tokens
options.feedback: Entry and exit serve different directions, so semantic testing plus reuse balances responsiveness and consistency.

options.label: Use linear for entry, exit, and continuous animation so every frame moves the same distance
options.feedback: Constant speed fits rotation or progress but often feels mechanical for interface movement and ignores direction.

options.label: Draw a different custom curve for every modal based only on how the current screen feels
options.feedback: Each may look acceptable alone, but arbitrary curves give peer interactions inconsistent and unpredictable rhythm.

en.tagline: Control how motion speeds up and slows down
en.visualHtml: ease-out entryease-in exitlinear machinery

zh.title: 拖拽卡片松手后需要回到目标位置，同时不能持续晃动。怎样处理更合适？

options.label: 使用项目现有动画方案做一次轻微过冲并快速停稳，减少动态效果时直接到目标位置
options.feedback: Spring 适合直接操作后的回位，但回弹要服务于位置变化，并提供稳定的减弱方案。

options.label: 让卡片持续来回弹动，直到用户再次点击，强化它具有弹性的感觉
options.feedback: 持续回弹会让状态无法稳定，也会分散用户对后续任务的注意。

options.label: 把同一组强回弹参数应用到页面所有按钮、弹窗和列表项，保持完全一致
options.feedback: 不同对象的距离、语义和风险不同；强迫所有元素回弹会削弱层级并干扰严肃操作。

zh.tagline: 弹性动画是一种用刚度、阻尼和质量等物理参数计算运动的动效方式
zh.visualHtml: 先越过目标值再回到稳定位置：过冲（overshoot）与回弹

en.title: A dragged card should return to its target after release without continuing to wobble. What is the better approach?

options.label: Use the existing animation system for one small overshoot that settles quickly, and move directly to the target under reduced motion
options.feedback: Correct. A spring fits settling after direct manipulation, but the bounce must serve the position change and have a stable reduced alternative.

options.label: Keep the card bouncing until the user clicks again so its elasticity remains obvious
options.feedback: Continuous bouncing prevents the state from settling and distracts from the next task.

options.label: Apply the same strong spring to every button, dialog, and list item for complete consistency
options.feedback: Objects differ in distance, meaning, and risk; forcing all of them to bounce weakens hierarchy and disrupts serious actions.

en.tagline: Create motion that settles with weight and elasticity
en.visualHtml: First cross the target value and then return to the stable position: overshoot (overshoot) and rebound

zh.title: Toast 出现和离开只需要轻微淡入淡出，但透明为 0 后仍会挡住后面的按钮。应该怎样修？

options.label: 过渡透明度，并在离开完成时同步移除点击、焦点和占位状态
options.feedback: Fade 负责视觉变化，交互和最终隐藏状态仍要同步处理，透明元素才不会继续挡路。

options.label: 只把 opacity 设为 0，继续保留原来的层级和点击区域
options.feedback: 透明度为零并不移除元素，它仍可能覆盖按钮、占据空间或被键盘聚焦。

options.label: 把所有浮层都统一成纯淡入淡出，包括需要表达侧边来源的抽屉
options.feedback: Toast 适合轻淡化，但抽屉等层级变化可能需要位移说明方向，不能用一个效果覆盖所有场景。

zh.tagline: 渐入渐出是一种通过改变透明度让内容出现或离开的基础动效
zh.visualHtml: 分帧示意：opacity 0 → 1，同时轻轻上移

en.title: A toast only needs a light fade in and out, but after reaching zero opacity it still blocks a button underneath. How should it be fixed?

options.label: Transition opacity and remove hit testing, focus, and layout presence when exit completes
options.feedback: Fade owns the visual change, while interaction and final hidden state must synchronize so transparency stops blocking content.

options.label: Only set opacity to zero and keep the original layer and click area
options.feedback: Zero opacity does not remove an element; it may still cover buttons, occupy space, or receive keyboard focus.

options.label: Use pure fading for every overlay, including drawers that need to communicate a side origin
options.feedback: A toast suits light fading, but drawers may need movement to explain direction and should not share one universal effect.

en.tagline: Reveal or hide an element by changing its opacity
en.visualHtml: Frame indication: opacity 0 → 1, while gently moving up

zh.title: 订单表的商品标题列宽有限，部分标题很长，但价格和状态必须始终完整。怎样处理？

options.label: 只截断商品标题并显示省略号，同时提供键盘和触屏可用的全文入口
options.feedback: 标题可以在有限列宽内缩短，但完整内容仍可访问，价格和状态则保留关键信息。

options.label: 标题、价格和状态都统一单行截断，让每列宽度完全一致
options.feedback: 价格和状态是完成判断所需的关键信息，截断后用户可能无法确认订单。

options.label: 给长标题加省略号，完整内容只留在接口数据里，不提供查看入口
options.feedback: 省略号只说明内容被隐藏；没有全文出口时，用户永远无法获得缺失部分。

zh.tagline: 文本截断是一种在有限空间内隐藏超出文字，并用省略号提示内容未显示完整的显示方式
zh.visualHtml:

en.title: An order table has limited product-title width, but price and status must always remain complete. How should long content be handled?

options.label: Truncate only the title with an ellipsis and provide a full-text path usable by keyboard and touch
options.feedback: The title can shorten in a limited column while remaining accessible, and decision-critical price and status stay complete.

options.label: Truncate title, price, and status to one line so every column has identical width
options.feedback: Price and status are required for the order judgment, and hiding them can prevent confirmation.

options.label: Ellipsize long titles, keep the full value only in API data, and provide no viewing path
options.feedback: The ellipsis only signals hidden content. Without an outlet, users can never access the missing part.

en.tagline: Shorten text that cannot fit in the available space

This plan revolves around "shipping your own page in week one," with three workstreams: curriculum redesign, hands-on project upgrades, and community operations. See the appendix for the schedule.

zh.title: 吸顶导航想做毛玻璃效果，但当前背景完全不透明，低性能手机滚动时也有卡顿。怎样处理？

options.label: 使用半透明底色配合适度模糊，并准备可读的纯色降级方案
options.feedback: 透明底让背后内容参与模糊，克制范围和纯色回退还能兼顾性能与可读性。

options.label: 保留不透明背景，只继续增加 backdrop blur 的模糊半径
options.feedback: 不透明背景挡住后方画面，再大的背景模糊也无法形成可见毛玻璃。

options.label: 把重度模糊扩展到整页内容，让所有区域保持相同风格
options.feedback: 大面积多层模糊会增加渲染负担，也会让正文和状态失去清晰边界。

zh.tagline: 毛玻璃是一种通过模糊元素背后画面，让半透明界面层与背景区分开的视觉效果
zh.visualHtml:
山居民宿 · 云顶

海拔 1,200 米，推开窗就是云海。

en.title: A sticky navigation needs a glass effect, but its background is fully opaque and low-end phones stutter while scrolling. What should change?

options.label: Combine a translucent surface with restrained blur and provide a readable solid-color fallback
options.feedback: Transparency exposes content to the backdrop filter, while limited scope and fallback protect performance and readability.

options.label: Keep the opaque background and continue increasing the backdrop-blur radius
options.feedback: An opaque surface hides the scene behind it, so increasing backdrop blur cannot produce visible glass.

options.label: Extend heavy blur across the whole page so every region uses the same style
options.feedback: Large layered blur increases rendering cost and removes clear boundaries from body content and states.

en.tagline: Blur the content behind a translucent surface
en.visualHtml:
Mountain Guesthouse · Genting

At an altitude of 1,200 meters, you can see the sea of clouds when you open the window.

zh.title: 长表格放在独立滚动面板中，表头设置了 sticky 却没有吸住。下一步最应该检查什么？

options.label: 确认表头设置了 top，并检查实际滚动祖先、容器高度和 overflow
options.feedback: Sticky 需要对应轴的偏移，并受最近滚动祖先和包含范围限制，这些条件决定它能否吸附。

options.label: 把表头改成 fixed，让它始终固定在浏览器视口顶部
options.feedback: Fixed 脱离表格和滚动面板，可能遮挡全页内容，也不再受表格边界约束。

options.label: 保留现有布局，只把表头 z-index 提高到 99999
options.feedback: 层级只能处理重叠顺序，不能补上 sticky 的偏移、滚动容器或可滚动距离。

zh.tagline: 吸顶是一种让元素先按正常位置排列、滚动到指定边界后暂时固定显示的 CSS 定位方式
zh.visualHtml:

en.title: A long table sits in its own scroll panel, but its sticky header does not stick. What should be checked next?

options.label: Confirm a top offset and inspect the real scroll ancestor, container height, and overflow
options.feedback: Sticky needs an offset on its axis and is constrained by its nearest scroll ancestor and containing range.

options.label: Change the header to fixed so it remains at the top of the browser viewport
options.feedback: Fixed leaves the table and scroll panel, may cover page content, and no longer respects table boundaries.

options.label: Keep the layout and only increase the header z-index to 99999
options.feedback: Layer order handles overlap but cannot supply the missing offset, scrolling container, or scrolling distance.

en.tagline: Keep an element visible after scrolling reaches it
