zh.title: 可拖动卡片、文字输入框和禁用按钮现在都显示同一种小手指针。怎样修正？

options.label: 按真实角色分别使用 grab、text 和 not-allowed，并保留清楚的控件样式
options.feedback: 指针与操作类型一致能提前提示行为，但控件本身仍需表达可拖、可输入或禁用。

options.label: 继续全部使用 pointer，让用户知道这些区域都值得关注
options.feedback: Pointer 通常暗示点击，无法区分拖动、文本输入和不可用状态，反而制造错误预期。

options.label: 移除按钮和输入框的视觉差异，只依靠鼠标指针说明功能
options.feedback: 触屏没有鼠标变化，指针也只是辅助线索，不能替代控件的可见角色和状态。

zh.tagline: 鼠标指针会根据所在区域改变形状，提前提示这里可以点击、输入、拖动或暂不可用
zh.visualHtml: 普通文字default 打开详情pointer 输入内容text

en.title: A draggable card, text field, and disabled button all show the same hand cursor. How should this be corrected?

options.label: Use grab, text, and not-allowed by actual role while keeping clear control styling
options.feedback: Role-matched cursors preview behavior, while the controls themselves still communicate drag, input, and disabled state.

options.label: Keep pointer everywhere so users know all three regions deserve attention
options.feedback: Pointer usually implies clicking and cannot distinguish dragging, text input, and unavailable actions.

options.label: Remove visual differences between controls and rely only on cursor shape for meaning
options.feedback: Touch has no cursor change, and a cursor is only a secondary cue rather than a visible role or state.

en.tagline: The mouse pointer changes shape to preview whether an area can be clicked, typed in, dragged, or is currently unavailable
en.visualHtml: Plain textdefault Open detailspointer Type heretext

zh.title: 文章选中文字后，品牌蓝背景和灰色文字几乎融在一起；团队还想禁止正文复制。怎样调整？

options.label: 为正文设置高对比选区颜色并允许复制，只在拖拽手柄等区域禁选
options.feedback: 选区必须清楚可见，正文复制是正常能力；禁选应限制在确实会误触的操作区域。

options.label: 保留品牌蓝和灰字，只要色彩符合品牌规范就不再调整
options.feedback: 品牌一致不能替代选区可读性，低对比会让用户无法确认自己选中了什么。

options.label: 给整篇正文设置 user-select: none，彻底避免误选
options.feedback: 正文并非拖拽控件，全面禁选会阻止复制、引用和辅助阅读等正常任务。

zh.tagline: 选中高亮是用户拖选网页文字后，浏览器为选区显示的前景色和背景色
zh.visualHtml:
默认色

拖选一段文字，中间这段就是选中高亮，底色由浏览器决定。

品牌色

拖选一段文字，中间这段就是选中高亮，和品牌色呼应。

en.title: Selected article text uses brand blue behind gray copy and is barely readable, and the team wants to block copying. What should change?

options.label: Use a high-contrast selection for body text, allow copying, and disable selection only on drag handles
options.feedback: Selection must remain visible and body copying is normal; prevention belongs only where selection interferes with an operation.

options.label: Keep the brand blue and gray text because brand compliance is more important
options.feedback: Brand consistency cannot replace selection readability; low contrast hides what users selected.

options.label: Apply user-select: none to the entire article so accidental selection cannot happen
options.feedback: Body copy is not a drag control, and global prevention blocks copying, quoting, and assistive reading tasks.

en.tagline: Show which text or items the user has selected
en.visualHtml:
Default

Drag to select some text, the part in the middle is the highlight, with colors picked by the browser.

Brand

Drag to select some text, the part in the middle is the highlight, echoing the brand color.

zh.title: 内容网站只有首页、文章、专题、关于和搜索五个一级入口，没有复杂层级。哪种页面结构更直接？

options.label: 使用顶部导航布局，下方内容限宽，手机端收纳次要入口
options.feedback: 少量一级入口适合持续放在顶部，主要内容可以在完整宽度下保持清楚阅读。

options.label: 使用常驻宽侧栏放五个入口，让正文一直占剩余区域
options.feedback: 侧栏更适合层级较深或工具型导航，当前少量入口会长期占用不必要的阅读宽度。

options.label: 取消页面跳转，把文章、专题和关于全部接成一个长首页
options.feedback: 这些入口服务不同内容任务，强行合并会削弱独立网址、搜索和返回路径。

zh.tagline: 顶部导航布局是一种把主要导航放在页面上方、下方安排内容区域的页面结构
zh.visualHtml: 内容区按内容与屏幕设置可读宽度

en.title: A content site has five top-level destinations—Home, Articles, Topics, About, and Search—with no deep hierarchy. Which page structure is direct?

options.label: Use a top-navigation layout, constrain reading width, and collect secondary entries on mobile
options.feedback: A small set of primary destinations fits persistent top access while leaving the main content clear and wide.

options.label: Use a wide permanent sidebar for the five entries and leave the remaining width to articles
options.feedback: Sidebars fit deeper or tool-oriented navigation; these few entries would consume reading width without adding clarity.

options.label: Remove page navigation and append Articles, Topics, and About into one long homepage
options.feedback: These serve different content tasks, and merging them weakens distinct URLs, search, and return paths.

en.tagline: Place the main navigation across the top of the page
en.visualHtml: Content areaSet readable width according to content and screen

zh.title: 管理后台有项目、成员、账单和权限等十多个分组功能，用户会频繁切换，右侧需要尽量大的工作区。怎样布局？

options.label: 用侧栏组织分组导航，内容区弹性伸缩，窄屏改为可关闭抽屉
options.feedback: 稳定侧栏适合频繁访问的层级入口，弹性工作区和移动抽屉还能保留可用内容宽度。

options.label: 把十多个入口全部放进一行顶栏，宽度不足时继续横向滚动
options.feedback: 大量分组入口会失去层级和整体可见性，横向滚动也让导航位置难以预测。

options.label: 桌面和手机都常驻同样宽度的侧栏，正文使用剩余空间
options.feedback: 手机剩余宽度不足以完成主要任务，侧栏应转成按需打开的导航层。

zh.tagline: 侧栏布局是一种把层级导航放在页面一侧、把主要任务内容放在另一侧的页面结构
zh.visualHtml:
导航
顶栏内容区

en.title: An admin app has more than ten grouped areas such as projects, members, billing, and permissions. Users switch often and need a large workspace. How should it lay out?

options.label: Use grouped sidebar navigation, let content flex, and turn the sidebar into a dismissible drawer on narrow screens
options.feedback: A stable sidebar fits frequent hierarchical access, while flexible content and a mobile drawer preserve working width.

options.label: Put every entry in one top bar and allow horizontal scrolling when it no longer fits
options.feedback: Many grouped destinations lose hierarchy and overview, while horizontal scrolling makes locations unpredictable.

options.label: Keep the same permanent sidebar width on desktop and mobile and give content the remainder
options.feedback: Mobile content loses the width required for primary tasks, so navigation should become an on-demand layer.

en.tagline: Keep navigation in a vertical column beside the content
en.visualHtml:
Navigation
Top barContent area

zh.title: 产品落地页围绕一个试用目标，内容按“问题、价值、产品证据、客户证明、行动”依次排列。怎样组织更合适？

options.label: 使用单页滚动布局，按阅读顺序分节，并提供锚点和阶段性行动入口
options.feedback: 所有内容服务同一决策，连续页面能按顺序读完，页内导航也能避免在长页面中找不到位置。

options.label: 把账号、账单和项目管理也接在落地页后面，统一靠滚动完成
options.feedback: 这些是独立的工具任务，不属于同一阅读主线，合并会让导航和状态管理混乱。

options.label: 把每个短章节都拆成独立网址，用户必须逐页点击才能读完
options.feedback: 内容本来组成一个连续决策，过度拆页会打断上下文和阅读节奏。

zh.tagline: 单页滚动布局是指将相关内容按阅读顺序组织在同一长页面中的布局方式。

en.title: A product landing page serves one trial goal through a sequence of problem, value, product evidence, customer proof, and action. How should it be organized?

options.label: Use a single scrolling page with ordered sections, anchors, and contextual action entries
options.feedback: All content supports one decision, so a continuous page keeps one reading order while in-page navigation keeps people oriented on a long page.

options.label: Append account, billing, and project management below the landing page and handle everything by scrolling
options.feedback: Those are separate tool tasks rather than one reading path, so merging them confuses navigation and state.

options.label: Give every short section a separate URL and require page-by-page navigation to read everything
options.feedback: The content forms one continuous decision, and excessive page breaks interrupt context and reading rhythm.

en.tagline: Arrange a complete story in sections down one scrolling page

zh.title: 技术文档既要切换不同页面，又要在当前长文章内跳章节，桌面空间充足但手机很窄。怎样布局？

options.label: 左侧放整站目录，中间正文，右侧放本页大纲；窄屏逐步收起两侧
options.feedback: 三栏分别解决跨页、阅读和页内定位，响应式收起还能保证正文始终优先。

options.label: 三栏始终等宽平分屏幕，手机也完整保留所有目录
options.feedback: 目录和大纲不应与正文同等占宽，窄屏强保三栏会让主要阅读区域无法使用。

options.label: 把整站页面和当前文章小节混进一个长目录，正文铺满剩余区域
options.feedback: 两种导航范围混在一起会失去职责边界，用户难以分清跳转到新页面还是当前章节。

zh.tagline: 文档三栏布局是一种同时显示整站目录、正文内容和本页大纲的页面结构
zh.visualHtml: 目录 正文 大纲

en.title: Technical docs need navigation across pages and within the current long article. Desktop has room but mobile is narrow. How should the layout adapt?

options.label: Use site navigation left, article center, and page outline right, progressively collapsing side columns on narrow screens
options.feedback: The columns handle cross-page access, reading, and in-page location separately, while collapse keeps content primary.

options.label: Keep three equal-width columns on every screen, including all directories on mobile
options.feedback: Navigation and outline do not deserve equal reading width, and three mobile columns make the article unusable.

options.label: Mix site pages and current headings into one long directory and use the rest for content
options.feedback: Mixing navigation scopes removes the boundary between opening another page and jumping within the current one.

en.tagline: Combine section navigation, article content, and an on-page outline
en.visualHtml: Table of Contents Text Outline

zh.title: 模板库有几十张结构一致的卡片，容器宽度会变化，卡片标题和操作不能被压得过窄。怎样排布？

options.label: 使用卡片网格，设定可读的最小卡宽，并让列数随容器自动变化
options.feedback: 最小卡宽保护内容结构，自动列数和统一 gap 能在不同容器中保持稳定扫描。

options.label: 始终使用四等分列，屏幕变窄时继续缩小卡片里的标题和按钮
options.feedback: 固定列数忽略内容所需的最小宽度，标题、图片和操作最终会拥挤或溢出。

options.label: 让每张卡片根据内容自由改变字段顺序和操作位置
options.feedback: 网格仍然存在，但同类信息不再对齐，用户难以快速比较和连续浏览。

zh.tagline: 卡片网格布局是一种用规则行列排列同类卡片，并随可用宽度换行的页面结构

en.title: A template library has dozens of structurally consistent cards in containers of changing width. Titles and actions cannot become too narrow. How should it lay out?

options.label: Use a card grid with a readable minimum card width and automatic column count
options.feedback: Minimum width protects card structure, while automatic columns and one gap preserve scanning across containers.

options.label: Always use four equal columns and keep shrinking card titles and actions as the screen narrows
options.feedback: A fixed count ignores content's minimum width, eventually crowding or overflowing titles, images, and actions.

options.label: Let every card rearrange fields and actions independently according to its content
options.feedback: The grid remains, but comparable information no longer aligns, weakening scanning and comparison.

en.tagline: Arrange similar cards in a responsive grid

zh.title: 博客正文在大屏上铺满 1600 像素，单行文字很长，读者经常找不到下一行开头。怎样调整？

options.label: 限制正文最大宽度并居中，保留两侧留白和左对齐行文
options.feedback: 稳定行宽减少视线横向移动，居中窄栏让阅读任务在宽屏上仍然集中。

options.label: 继续让正文占满屏幕，只增加字号、行高和段落间距
options.feedback: 字号变化不能解决行长随视口无限增长的问题，宽屏阅读仍需长距离回扫。

options.label: 保持全文宽度，但把每段正文改成居中对齐
options.feedback: 每行起点不一致会进一步降低长文阅读效率，也没有控制单行长度。

zh.tagline: 居中窄栏布局是一种限制内容栏宽度并将其置于页面中央的页面结构
zh.visualHtml: 内容栏居中限宽 600~720px

en.title: A blog article spans a 1600-pixel display, producing very long lines that make the next line hard to find. How should it change?

options.label: Constrain and center the article column, keep side whitespace, and retain left-aligned paragraphs
options.feedback: Stable line length reduces horizontal eye movement, and a centered narrow column keeps reading focused on wide screens.

options.label: Keep the article full-width and increase type size, line-height, and paragraph spacing
options.feedback: Type size does not stop line length growing with the viewport, so wide-screen return sweeps remain long.

options.label: Keep the full width but center-align every paragraph
options.feedback: Variable line starts make long-form reading harder and still do not constrain line length.

en.tagline: Keep one narrow content column centered on the page
en.visualHtml: Content columncentered and limited to 600~720px

zh.title: 插画师的作品墙有上百张比例不同的图片，希望浏览紧凑、不出现整行空白。选哪种结构，验收时看什么？

options.label: 用瀑布流保持原始比例补位，并检查手机列数和补位后的阅读顺序
options.feedback: 补位消除了整行留白；视觉顺序会按列交错，必须在桌面和手机上确认顺序仍然可以接受。

options.label: 用卡片网格，把封面统一裁成相同高度，保证每行严格对齐
options.feedback: 统一裁切能得到整齐的行列，但会切掉作品画面；以图为主的展示墙上，裁切损失大于留白。

options.label: 用瀑布流保持原始比例，桌面上看着紧凑就不用再验收
options.feedback: 紧凑只是目标的一半；补位后第 4 张可能排到第 3 张上方，手机收成单列还会再变一次顺序。

zh.tagline: 瀑布流是一种保持列对齐、让不同高度的卡片依次补进当前最短列的页面布局

en.title: An illustrator has a portfolio wall with hundreds of images in different aspect ratios and wants compact browsing without full-row gaps. Which structure and acceptance check fit?

options.label: Use masonry to pack images at their natural ratio, then check column count and reading order on mobile
options.feedback: Packing removes row gaps; the visual order interleaves across columns, so confirm it stays acceptable on desktop and phone.

options.label: Use a card grid and crop every cover to the same height for strict row alignment
options.feedback: Uniform cropping gives tidy rows but cuts into the artwork; on an image-led wall the crop costs more than the gaps.

options.label: Use masonry at natural ratios; if the desktop looks compact, no further check is needed
options.feedback: Compactness is only half the goal; after packing, card 4 can sit above card 3, and a single phone column reorders again.

en.tagline: Pack cards of different heights into equal-width columns

zh.title: 产品登录页左侧放品牌故事、右侧放登录表单，两边各占一半。AI 交付的手机版仍是左右排列，文字和按钮都被压窄。怎样处理？

options.label: 手机端改成上下排列，登录表单在上、品牌区在后，再检查输入和按钮可用
options.feedback: 上下排列保住可读宽度；表单是用户打开登录页要完成的任务，放在前面。

options.label: 保留左右结构，把两个区域等比缩小到手机屏幕宽度
options.feedback: 等比缩小会把输入框和按钮压到难以操作，手机端需要重新排列而不是缩放桌面布局。

options.label: 手机端直接删掉品牌区，只保留登录表单
options.feedback: 品牌区在新访客首次访问时承担建立信任的任务；应先尝试上下重排，确认可省再删。

zh.tagline: 分屏布局是一种把首屏分成两个权重接近的区域、各自承载一个并列任务或入口的页面结构
zh.visualHtml:
ATELIER OS 为独立工作室而建的协作工具 了解服务 任务：建立信任
登录工作台 登录 任务：完成登录
各占一半 · 任务并列

en.title: A product login page puts a brand story on the left half and the login form on the right. The delivered mobile version keeps the side-by-side layout, squeezing text and buttons. What should you do?

options.label: Stack the two areas on mobile with the login form first, then verify inputs and buttons stay usable
options.feedback: Stacking restores readable width; the form is the task visitors came to complete, so it leads.

options.label: Keep the two columns and scale both areas down proportionally to fit the phone
options.feedback: Proportional shrinking crushes inputs and buttons; mobile needs rearrangement, not a scaled-down desktop layout.

options.label: Remove the brand area on phones and keep only the login form
options.feedback: The brand area builds trust for first-time visitors; try restacking first and remove it only when it is proven dispensable.

en.tagline: Give two parallel tasks two near-equal halves of one view
en.visualHtml:
ATELIER OS A collaboration tool for independent studios Learn more Task: build trust
Sign in to the workspace Sign in Task: sign in
Two halves · parallel tasks

zh.title: “新品”角标要始终贴在商品卡片右上角，并随着卡片一起移动和换行。怎样定位最稳妥？

options.label: 让卡片建立定位参照，再把角标绝对定位到右上角
options.feedback: 父卡片成为明确参照后，角标偏移会相对卡片计算，并随卡片整体移动。

options.label: 把角标固定定位到视口右上角，再根据卡片位置调整数值
options.feedback: Fixed 相对视口且脱离卡片，滚动或卡片换行后角标不会继续跟随目标。

options.label: 只给角标设置 absolute 和较大的 top、right，不修改父级
options.feedback: 没有建立预期参照时，角标可能相对更远的包含块定位，页面变化后容易偏离卡片。

zh.tagline: 定位是通过 CSS position 和偏移量决定元素是否脱离文档流及其参照位置的布局规则
zh.visualHtml:
NEW ✓ 卡片写了 relative，角标贴在卡片右上角
NEW ✕ 卡片未建立定位上下文，角标相对外层容器定位

en.title: A New badge must stay on the top-right of its product card and move and wrap with the card. What positioning is most reliable?

options.label: Establish the card as the positioning reference and absolutely position the badge at its top-right
options.feedback: Once the parent card is the reference, badge offsets are calculated from it and move with the whole card.

options.label: Fix the badge to the viewport's top-right and tune offsets to match the card
options.feedback: Fixed positioning follows the viewport rather than the card, so scrolling and wrapping separate badge from target.

options.label: Only set absolute with large top and right values and leave every parent unchanged
options.feedback: Without the intended reference, the badge may position against a distant containing block and drift as layout changes.

en.tagline: Place an element in normal flow, against a parent, or against the viewport
en.visualHtml:
NEW ✓ Card has relative — badge sticks to the card's corner
NEW ✕ No relative on the card — badge flies to the container's corner →

zh.title: 空状态的图标和文案高度会随语言变化，但它们要始终在内容区域水平、垂直居中。怎样实现更合适？

options.label: 让父容器使用 Flex 或 Grid，在水平和垂直两条轴上居中
options.feedback: 父级对齐不依赖空状态自身尺寸，内容变高、容器变宽时仍能保持双轴居中。

options.label: 根据当前截图给空状态写固定上外边距和左外边距
options.feedback: 固定偏移只匹配当前尺寸，语言、视口或内容高度变化后中心位置会失准。

options.label: 把内容绝对定位到一组固定 top 和 left 数值，不考虑自身大小
options.feedback: 固定坐标没有补偿元素自身宽高，也不能跟随容器尺寸变化保持真正居中。

zh.tagline: 居中是把文字、元素或一组内容在容器的水平、垂直或两条轴上对齐到中间的布局方式
zh.visualHtml:
flex
grid
absolute

en.title: An empty state's icon and copy change height by language, but must stay horizontally and vertically centered in the content area. What is the better approach?

options.label: Use Flex or Grid on the parent and center along both horizontal and vertical axes
options.feedback: Parent alignment does not depend on the empty state's own size, so it remains centered as content and container change.

options.label: Set fixed top and left margins based on the current screenshot
options.feedback: Fixed offsets only fit the current dimensions and drift when language, viewport, or content height changes.

options.label: Absolutely position the content at fixed top and left values without considering its size
options.feedback: Fixed coordinates do not compensate for the element's own dimensions or adapt to its container.

en.tagline: Align an element to the middle of the available space
en.visualHtml:
flex
grid
absolute

zh.title: 已经买下 example.com，但打开后仍看不到刚做好的网站。下一步应该确认什么？

options.label: 只在托管平台添加 example.com，不检查域名当前 DNS
options.feedback: 托管平台知道域名还不够；DNS 仍可能指向注册商停放页，访问者不会到达新网站。

options.label: 确认网站已部署，再按托管说明配置 DNS 指向
options.feedback: 域名只是名称；还需要可访问的网站服务，并通过 DNS 把名称连接到该服务。

options.label: 把域名转发到临时地址，让浏览器跳走后再显示网站
options.feedback: 转发可能打开网站，却不会让正式域名直接承载页面；地址会变化，也绕过了正常绑定。

zh.tagline: 域名是给网站、邮箱等网络服务使用的好记名称。
zh.visualHtml:
🔍 vibeui搜索
vibeui.dev✓ 可注册示例报价加入清单
vibeui.com已被注册——

en.title: You bought example.com, but opening it still does not show the website you built. What should be confirmed next?

options.label: Add example.com at the hosting platform but do not inspect its current DNS
options.feedback: The host may know the domain while DNS still points visitors to the registrar's parking page.

options.label: Confirm the site is deployed, then point DNS according to the host's instructions
options.feedback: A domain is only a name. A reachable host must serve the site, and DNS must connect the name to that service.

options.label: Forward the domain to a temporary address and let the browser navigate away
options.feedback: A redirect may open the site but changes the visible address and does not properly bind the custom domain.

en.tagline: Give a website a human-readable address
en.visualHtml:
🔍 vibeuiSearch
vibeui.dev✓ AvailableSample quoteAdd to list
vibeui.comTaken——

zh.title: 域名刚改到新服务器，有些人看到新站，有些人仍打开旧站。下一步怎样排查更稳妥？

options.label: 每隔几分钟更换一次记录值，直到所有人看到新站
options.feedback: 旧缓存尚未过期时反复修改会产生更多版本，让不同地点的结果更难判断。

options.label: 核对当前记录和外部解析结果，再结合 TTL 等待缓存更新
options.feedback: 先确认新记录本身正确，再区分配置错误与旧缓存未过期，能避免无意义的连续修改。

options.label: 只清理自己的浏览器缓存，并据此判断全球已经更新
options.feedback: 浏览器缓存只是其中一层；其他地区的递归解析器仍可能保留旧记录，单点结果不能代表全部。

zh.tagline: 互联网的地址簿，把域名查成浏览器能找到网站的地址
zh.visualHtml:
🌐浏览器查询

en.title: A domain was just pointed to a new server. Some people see the new site while others still see the old one. What is the safest next check?

options.label: Change the record value every few minutes until everyone sees the new site
options.feedback: Repeated edits while old caches remain create more versions and make regional results harder to diagnose.

options.label: Verify the current record and external lookup results, then account for TTL caching
options.feedback: Confirming the new record first separates a configuration error from an old cached answer and avoids unnecessary changes.

options.label: Clear one browser cache and use that result to declare the global update complete
options.feedback: Browser cache is only one layer. Recursive resolvers elsewhere may still hold the previous record.

zh.title: 用户想把“未付款订单第 3 页”发给同事，对方打开后要看到相同结果。网址应该怎样设计？

options.label: 筛选和页码只放在页面内存里，分享统一的 /orders
options.feedback: 内存状态不会随链接传给同事，对方打开后只能看到默认订单列表。

options.label: 把筛选和页码写进查询参数，并确认链接可复现
options.feedback: 路径标明页面，查询参数保存筛选和页码；完整网址能让另一台设备恢复同一结果。

options.label: 把筛选、页码和登录令牌都放进网址后一起发送
options.feedback: 筛选条件可以分享，但登录令牌属于敏感凭证；放进网址可能进入历史、日志和聊天记录。

zh.tagline: URL 是浏览器用来打开某个页面、文件或位置的完整地址。
zh.visualHtml:
https://vibeui.dev/components/button?tab=demo#anatomy
协议域名路径参数锚点

en.title: Someone wants to send 'unpaid orders, page 3' to a teammate who should open the same result. How should the URL work?

options.label: Keep filters and page number only in memory and share the same /orders URL
options.feedback: In-memory state does not travel with the link, so the teammate opens the default order list.

options.label: Put the filter and page in query parameters and verify that the link reproduces the view
options.feedback: The path identifies the page and query parameters preserve filters and position for another device.

options.label: Put the filters, page number, and login token in the URL and send all of it
options.feedback: Filters may be shareable, but a login token is sensitive and can leak through history, logs, and messages.

en.tagline: Describe the exact location of a resource on the web
en.visualHtml:
https://vibeui.dev/components/button?tab=demo#anatomy
ProtocolDomain namePathParametersAnchor

zh.title: 修改昵称后页面没变化，Network 显示 POST /profile 返回 400。下一步最该检查什么？

options.label: 查看这次请求带了什么，以及 400 响应具体说明了什么
options.feedback: HTTP 记录了浏览器实际发送和服务器实际返回的内容；400 表示请求未按约定被接受，应先读证据。

options.label: 只根据 400 显示“网络错误”，不再查看请求和响应内容
options.feedback: 400 已经说明服务器收到请求但不接受；忽略具体内容会丢掉字段或格式错误等可修复线索。

options.label: 把 POST 改成 GET，并把昵称写进网址后重新发送
options.feedback: 保存操作应遵循接口约定；随意换方法会改变请求语义，还没有解决原请求为何被拒绝。

zh.tagline: 浏览器或 App 向服务器提出请求、再接收结果时遵守的通信规则
zh.visualHtml:
GET —— 获取资源
GET /api/components HTTP/1.1
Host: api.vibeui.dev
POST —— 交数据
POST /api/login HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json{ "email": "you@example.com", "pwd": "••••••" }

en.title: After changing a nickname, the page does not update and Network shows POST /profile returned 400. What should be checked next?

options.label: Inspect what the request sent and what the 400 response specifically reports
options.feedback: HTTP exposes the actual request and response. A 400 means the request was not accepted, so the evidence comes first.

options.label: Use the 400 status to show 'Network error' without reading the request or response
options.feedback: A 400 means the server received but rejected the request. Ignoring details loses actionable field or format evidence.

options.label: Change POST to GET, put the nickname in the URL, and send it again
options.feedback: A save should follow the API contract. Changing the method alters semantics without explaining the rejection.

en.tagline: Send a request and receive a response over the web
en.visualHtml:
GET - Get resources
GET /api/components HTTP/1.1
Host: api.vibeui.dev
POST - Submit data
POST /api/login HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json{ "email": "you@example.com", "pwd": "••••••" }

zh.title: 登录接口返回成功，但刷新后用户又变成未登录。下一步最应该检查什么？

options.label: 检查响应是否设置会话 Cookie，以及刷新后的请求是否带回它
options.feedback: 要沿着设置、保存、携带这三步检查，才能判断服务器为何无法在下一次请求识别会话。

options.label: 在 localStorage 里写入 isLoggedIn=true，让页面继续显示登录态
options.feedback: 前端标记只能改变页面显示，不能证明服务器认可会话，也不能代替请求中携带的凭证。

options.label: 只检查数据库里的用户记录，不查看浏览器和请求头
options.feedback: 用户记录存在不代表这次浏览器请求带有可识别的会话；还要查看 Set-Cookie 和后续 Cookie 头。

zh.tagline: 由浏览器按服务器要求保存并在符合规则的后续请求中自动携带的文本数据
zh.visualHtml: 登录响应Set-Cookie → 浏览器 → Cookie后续请求：找到会话

en.title: The login API returns success, but a refresh makes the user signed out again. What should you inspect first?

options.label: Check whether the response sets a session cookie and the refresh request sends it back
options.feedback: Correct. Follow the set, store, and send steps to learn why the server cannot recognize the session on the next request.

options.label: Write isLoggedIn=true to localStorage so the page keeps showing a signed-in state
options.feedback: A frontend flag changes display only. It does not prove that the server accepts a session or replace a request credential.

options.label: Inspect only the user record in the database, not the browser or request headers
options.feedback: An existing user record does not mean this browser request carries a recognizable session. Check Set-Cookie and the later Cookie header too.

en.tagline: A cookie is a small piece of data the browser stores by server rules and sends automatically on matching later requests.
en.visualHtml: Login responseSet-Cookie → browser → CookieNext request: session found

zh.title: 接口返回 {"items":[{"name":"A"}]}，页面却读取 data.list 并报错。应该先怎样修？

options.label: 按实际 JSON 结构读取 items，并检查每项需要的字段
options.feedback: 页面读取路径必须与收到的对象和数组层级一致；继续使用前还要确认字段是否齐全。

options.label: 把返回内容里的双引号换成单引号，再读取 data.list
options.feedback: 标准 JSON 字符串使用双引号，而且换引号不会把 items 字段变成 list。

options.label: 捕获错误后返回空列表，不再查看接口内容
options.feedback: 页面不会崩溃，但真实数据也被丢掉；应先对齐数据结构，再决定缺失时的降级状态。

zh.tagline: JSON 是软件之间传递成组信息时常用的一种文本写法。
zh.visualHtml:
{
  "name": "按钮 Button",
  "price": 0,
  "free": true,
  "tags": ["通用", "表单"]
}

en.title: An API returns {"items":[{"name":"A"}]}, but the page reads data.list and fails. What should be fixed first?

options.label: Read items from the actual JSON shape and verify each required field
options.feedback: The access path must match the received object and array levels, and required item fields still need validation.

options.label: Replace double quotes with single quotes and keep reading data.list
options.feedback: Standard JSON uses double quotes, and changing quote style would not rename the items field to list.

options.label: Catch the error, return an empty list, and stop inspecting the response
options.feedback: The crash disappears but valid data is discarded. Align the structure before choosing an empty-state fallback.

en.tagline: Represent structured data as text that programs can exchange
en.visualHtml:
{
  "name": "Button",
  "price": 0,
  "free": true,
  "tags": ["General", "Form"]
}

zh.title: 登录页已改成 https://，但浏览器仍警告不安全，控制台显示脚本从 http:// 加载。下一步怎样处理？

options.label: 检查证书和域名，并把页面内脚本、图片等资源统一改为 HTTPS
options.feedback: 主页面和子资源都要通过受保护连接加载，混合内容会被警告或直接拦截。

options.label: 保留 HTTP 脚本，在页面内增加“本站可信”说明覆盖提示
options.feedback: 网页文案不能改变传输方式，也无法阻止浏览器拦截不安全资源。

options.label: 只要地址栏出现小锁，就把网站标记为公司和交易都已认证
options.feedback: HTTPS 保护设备与域名之间的连接，不证明经营者、内容或交易本身可信。

zh.tagline: 地址栏里以 https:// 开头、用于保护设备与网站之间数据的加密连接
zh.visualHtml:
🔒 https://vibeui.dev 加密连接
⚠️ http://old-site.com 不安全
浏览器界面会因版本而异；关键是确认连接与证书状态

en.title: A login page uses https://, but the browser still warns because a script loads from http://. What should happen next?

options.label: Check certificate and domain, then load scripts, images, and other subresources through HTTPS
options.feedback: The page and its subresources need protected connections; mixed content may be warned about or blocked.

options.label: Keep the HTTP script and add a This site is trusted notice inside the page
options.feedback: Page copy cannot change transport security or stop the browser from blocking insecure resources.

options.label: Once a lock appears, label the company and every transaction as verified
options.feedback: HTTPS protects the connection to a domain; it does not verify the operator, content, or transaction.

en.tagline: Encrypt the connection between the browser and the website
en.visualHtml:
🔒 https://vibeui.dev Encrypted connection
⚠️ http://old-site.com Not safe
The browser interface will vary depending on the version; the key is to confirm the connection and certificate status

zh.title: 海外用户加载产品图片很慢；接入 CDN 后发布新图，部分地区却仍看到旧版本。怎样处理更完整？

options.label: 让静态图走 CDN，并使用版本化地址或刷新缓存后验证各地区结果
options.feedback: CDN 缩短静态资源路径，版本化或 Purge 则解决节点继续命中旧缓存的问题。

options.label: 继续使用同一个图片地址并延长缓存时间，等待各地区节点自然更新
options.feedback: 同一地址配合更长缓存会让旧副本保留更久，而且无法确定各节点何时一致。

options.label: 发布后绕过 CDN 检查源站；源站是新图就视为所有地区已更新
options.feedback: 源站更新不代表边缘节点已经刷新，仍要检查版本、缓存状态和实际地区结果。

zh.tagline: 把图片和网页文件的副本放到多个地区，让用户从较近的位置加载
zh.visualHtml:
🖥️源站文件原件
→
📍 香港节点（副本）18ms
📍 法兰克福节点（副本）22ms
📍 洛杉矶节点（副本）26ms

en.title: Product images load slowly overseas. After adding a CDN, some regions still show an old image after release. What is the complete response?

options.label: Serve static images through the CDN and use versioned URLs or purge before regional verification
options.feedback: The CDN shortens delivery for static assets, while versioning or purge prevents nodes from serving an old cache.

options.label: Keep the same image URL and extend its cache lifetime while waiting for every region to update naturally
options.feedback: A longer cache on the same URL preserves old copies for longer and provides no reliable update point.

options.label: Bypass the CDN after release and treat a fresh origin image as proof every region has updated
options.feedback: A fresh origin does not prove edge caches have refreshed; verify versions, cache state, and real regions.

en.tagline: Serve static files from locations closer to visitors
en.visualHtml:
🖥️OriginOriginal file
→
📍 Hong Kong node (copy) 18ms
📍 Frankfurt node (copy) 22ms
📍 Los Angeles node (copy) 26ms

zh.title: 你清空本机缓存后已经看到新 CSS，但外地用户仍看到旧版。下一步先查哪里？

options.label: 检查共享缓存或 CDN 的命中记录、响应头和旧副本是否已失效
options.feedback: 本机已更新而其他地区仍旧，范围指向本地之外的共享缓存层；要用外部请求和响应证据确认。

options.label: 继续清理 localStorage，因为所有旧页面都来自浏览器保存的数据
options.feedback: localStorage 保存的是网页数据，不是通用的 HTTP 响应副本；而且本机已经更新，现象也超出了单个浏览器。

options.label: 重新修改 CSS 源文件，不检查请求实际拿到的资源版本
options.feedback: 源文件可能已经正确，重复修改会掩盖资源到底从哪里返回；应先检查共享缓存和响应头。

zh.tagline: 暂存可以复用的结果，让后续请求不必每次都回到源站
zh.visualHtml:
浏览器→共享缓存 / CDN
命中旧版→源站
新 CSS
首次：200命中复验：304

en.title: Your cleared browser now shows the new CSS, but people elsewhere still see the old version. What should you check first?

options.label: Check shared-cache or CDN hits, response headers, and whether the old copy was invalidated
options.feedback: Correct. A fresh local result but stale results elsewhere points beyond one browser, so verify the shared cache with external requests and response evidence.

options.label: Keep clearing localStorage because every old page comes from browser-saved data
options.feedback: localStorage stores web data, not general HTTP response copies. The local browser is already fresh, and the symptom is wider than one browser.

options.label: Edit the CSS source again without checking which resource version the request received
options.feedback: The source may already be correct. Re-editing hides where the resource came from; check shared caching and response headers first.

en.tagline: Keep reusable results so later requests do not always return to the origin
en.visualHtml:
Browser→Shared cache / CDN
Old version hit→Origin
New CSS
First: 200HitRevalidate: 304

zh.title: 三个页面都要显示同一种“活动卡片”，以后还会一起修改。怎样组织才能统一维护？

options.label: 做成一个可复用的活动卡片，由各页面传入内容
options.feedback: 卡片的共同责任集中在一起，改卡片样式或行为后，三个页面会得到同一套结果。

options.label: 在三个页面各复制一份卡片，再用全局 CSS 保持外观一致
options.feedback: 复制可以暂时显示内容，但共同规则会分散，后续容易漏改或出现不一致。

options.label: 做成一个高度可配置的通用卡片，把三个页面的差异都变成参数
options.feedback: 参数越多不代表复用越好。组件应集中稳定的共同责任；把所有差异都塞成开关，会让调用和维护同样复杂。

zh.tagline: 组件是把一块可复用的界面和它负责的行为组织在一起的单元。
zh.visualHtml:
共享组件ProductCardaction="加入清单"
首页<ProductCard />搜索结果<ProductCard />
组件改一次 → 两个页面一起更新

en.title: The event page, homepage, and search page all need cards with the same rules. Which approach makes later changes consistent?

options.label: Put the image, title, state, and click behavior in one event-card component, with each page passing its own data
options.feedback: Correct. The card's shared responsibility lives in one place, so a style or behavior change reaches all three pages.

options.label: Copy the card code into every page, then edit titles and buttons separately
options.feedback: It can show content initially, but shared rules become scattered and will drift or be missed later.

options.label: Put every page and feature into one component named Website
options.feedback: That does not separate responsibilities. A component should make one reasonably independent part of the interface easier to understand and maintain.

en.tagline: A component is a unit that groups a reusable piece of interface with the behavior it owns.
en.visualHtml:
Shared componentProductCardaction="Add to list"
Home<ProductCard />Search results<ProductCard />
One component change → both pages update

zh.title: 用户点击保存后，页面立刻显示“已保存”，但请求随后失败。应该怎样修改？

options.label: 先显示“保存中”，成功后显示“已保存”，失败时提供重试
options.feedback: 等待、成功和失败是不同状态，页面要根据真实请求结果切换。

options.label: 先乐观显示“已保存”，失败时只记到控制台，不回滚界面
options.feedback: 这会把界面文案当成证据，用户会以为数据已经成功保存。

options.label: 提交期间禁用按钮，结束后无论成功失败都恢复成初始状态
options.feedback: 禁用按钮只能防止重复提交，不能告诉用户结果。成功和失败必须进入不同的可见状态。

zh.tagline: 状态是界面在当前时刻需要记住、并会随操作或结果变化的信息。
zh.visualHtml:
昵称小林
尚未提交→保存中…→✓ 已保存或重试
画面由真实请求状态驱动

en.title: A page shows “Saved” immediately after a click, but the network request then fails. What change fits best?

options.label: Enter a Saving state first, show Saved only after success, and show a retryable error on failure
options.feedback: Correct. Pending, success, and failure are different states, and the interface should change from the actual request result.

options.label: Keep showing Saved immediately because users dislike waiting
options.feedback: That treats interface text as proof and makes users think data was stored when it was not.

options.label: Remove every status message so no error text appears
options.feedback: People still need to know whether an action is pending, succeeded, or failed. Removing feedback does not make state accurate.

en.tagline: State is information the interface needs to remember right now and that can change from actions or results.
en.visualHtml:
NicknameLin
Not submitted→Saving…→✓ SavedorRetry
The real request state drives the interface

zh.title: 终端显示网页已运行在 `http://localhost:3001`，但你仍打开 `localhost:3000` 并看到旧页面。先做什么？

options.label: 按终端地址打开 3001，并确认 3000 当前由哪个本地服务提供旧页面
options.feedback: localhost 是同一台电脑，端口才决定你连到哪项服务。

options.label: 继续打开 3000，反复重启当前项目，直到旧页面被新页面替换
options.feedback: 当前项目已经明确监听 3001；重启不能保证另一个占用 3000 的服务消失。

options.label: 让网页服务同时监听 3000 和 3001，保证两个地址都显示同一页面
options.feedback: 这会绕开而不是解释冲突，也可能抢占另一个服务正在使用的端口；应先确认每个端口对应谁。

zh.tagline: 端口是同一台主机上区分不同网络服务的编号入口。
zh.visualHtml:
localhost当前电脑
:3000网页:8080API:5432数据库
同一台电脑 · 端口选择不同服务

en.title: The terminal says the page is running at `http://localhost:3001`, but you keep opening `localhost:3000` and see an old page. What should you do first?

options.label: Open port 3001 as reported, then identify which local service is still serving the old page on 3000
options.feedback: Correct. localhost is the same device; the port decides which service you reach.

options.label: Keep opening port 3000 and restart the current project until the new page replaces the old one
options.feedback: The current project already reports port 3001. Restarting it does not guarantee that the other service using 3000 disappears.

options.label: Make the page service listen on both 3000 and 3001 so both addresses show the same page
options.feedback: That avoids rather than explains the conflict and may take a port another service uses. First identify which service owns each port.

en.tagline: A port is a numbered network entry that distinguishes services on the same host.
en.visualHtml:
localhostThis computer
:3000Web:8080API:5432Database
Same host · the port selects a service

zh.title: 两张卡片各占一半宽度，加上左右留白后却挤出页面。应该先检查什么？

options.label: 检查卡片的宽度是否还要加上内边距和边框
options.feedback: 卡片实际占用的空间可能超过内容宽度，先看每层尺寸最能解释两列为何排不下。

options.label: 把每张卡片宽度改成 49%，先给左右留白腾出空间
options.feedback: 把宽度改小可能暂时不溢出，但没有解释尺寸为什么超出。应先确认盒模型和 `box-sizing`，再决定宽度。

options.label: 让父容器隐藏横向溢出，把超出页面的部分裁掉
options.feedback: 隐藏溢出只会遮住问题，卡片内容仍可能被裁切；应先找出宽度、内边距和边框怎样共同占用空间。

zh.tagline: 由内容、内边距、边框和外边距构成的网页元素几何尺寸与排版占位规则。
zh.visualHtml:
marginborderpadding内容 320px
320 + 24×2 + 1×2= 370px
布局计算元素实际占用空间

en.title: Two cards each use `width: 50%` and each add 24px left and right padding, then overflow horizontally. What concept should you inspect first?

options.label: Inspect whether width must also account for padding and border in the box model, then choose the sizing rule
options.feedback: Correct. A card's actual space may exceed its content width, so inspecting its layers best explains why two columns no longer fit.

options.label: Inspect the search keyword because card text may be too long
options.feedback: Text length can create another issue, but the shared change here is the padding added to every card.

options.label: Inspect cross-origin settings because layout failures are usually CORS
options.feedback: CORS governs cross-origin reads, not CSS size calculation.

en.tagline: The box model is the browser's rule for the space used by an element's content, padding, border, and margin.
en.visualHtml:
marginborderpaddingContent 320px
320 + 24×2 + 1×2= 370px
Layout uses the element’s actual footprint

zh.title: 卡片文字变长后，底部的“下载完整视频”按钮不见了。应该先检查哪里？

options.label: 检查哪一层限制了高度或裁掉内容，再决定增高还是滚动
options.feedback: 先确认哪一层发生纵向溢出，再按内容用途选择增高或滚动，才能保证底部按钮可达。

options.label: 只把按钮的层级调到最高
options.feedback: 被父容器裁掉的内容通常不会因为提高自身层级重新出现；应先检查边界、高度和 overflow。

options.label: 按当前最长文案给卡片设置一个更高的固定高度
options.feedback: 真实内容长度还会变化，删内容只绕过了这一次，不能证明卡片能承受最长内容。

zh.tagline: 内容尺寸超出容器可见区域时的显示、裁剪或滚动控制规则。
zh.visualHtml:
height: 74px · overflow-y: hidden视频生成结果✓ 字幕已经生成✓ 封面已经选好卡片底边
按钮被裁掉→增高或提供滚动

en.title: A content card loses its Download video button when the copy becomes longer. What is the best first step?

options.label: Find the exact container with a fixed height or `overflow: hidden`, then choose whether the card should grow or, only when bounded height is intentional, scroll internally
options.feedback: Correct. Identify the vertical overflow layer first, then choose growth or scrolling so the bottom action stays reachable.

options.label: Only set the button's `z-index` to 9999 without checking whether its parent clips it
options.feedback: Content clipped by a parent normally does not reappear merely because its own stacking level increases. Inspect the boundary, height, and overflow first.

options.label: Delete the last description so this one card happens to fit
options.feedback: Real content length changes. Removing content only avoids this instance and does not prove the card handles the longest case.

en.tagline: Overflow is the rule for how the browser shows, clips, or scrolls content that exceeds a container's available space.
en.visualHtml:
height: 74px · overflow-y: hiddenVideo result✓ Captions ready✓ Cover selectedCard bottom
Action clipped→Grow or make it scroll

zh.title: 本地网页 `localhost:3000` 调用 API `localhost:4000` 时，控制台报 CORS。哪项排查最准确？

options.label: 让 API 允许 `http://localhost:3000`，并核对当前请求的方法和凭据规则
options.feedback: 两个端口构成不同源，浏览器需要从 API 响应里看到对应的允许规则。

options.label: 把网页请求改成 `no-cors`，继续按原方式读取 API 返回的数据
options.feedback: `no-cors` 通常只会得到网页脚本无法读取的不透明响应，不能让原来的数据读取继续工作。

options.label: 让 API 允许 `http://localhost:4000`，因为请求最终发到了这个地址
options.feedback: CORS 要允许发起请求的网页来源，这里是 3000；4000 是被请求的 API 地址。

zh.tagline: CORS 是浏览器要求服务器明确同意后，网页才能跨源读取响应的安全机制。
zh.visualHtml:
网页来源localhost:3000GET →APIlocalhost:8080
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: http://localhost:3000✓ 浏览器脚本可读取
服务器声明允许范围 · 浏览器执行检查

en.title: A local page at `localhost:3000` calls an API at `localhost:4000` and the console reports CORS. Which investigation is most accurate?

options.label: Allow `http://localhost:3000` at the API and verify the request method and credential rules
options.feedback: Correct. The two ports are different origins, and the browser needs matching permission in the API response.

options.label: Change the page request to `no-cors` and keep reading the API data in the same way
options.feedback: `no-cors` normally produces an opaque response that page script cannot read, so the original data flow still does not work.

options.label: Allow `http://localhost:4000` because that is the address receiving the request
options.feedback: CORS must allow the page origin that initiates the request, which is 3000 here; 4000 is the API destination.

en.tagline: CORS is the browser security mechanism that lets a page read a cross-origin response only after the server explicitly permits it.
en.visualHtml:
Page originlocalhost:3000GET →APIlocalhost:8080
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: http://localhost:3000✓ Browser script can read
The server declares scope · the browser checks it

zh.title: 团队要让用户在手机和电脑都看到同一份已提交订单。数据应主要放在哪里？

options.label: 放到受服务端控制的数据库，通过登录后的接口读取；浏览器存储只可辅助本地体验
options.feedback: 订单需要跨设备、可能也需要客服或其他系统读取，不能只依赖当前浏览器。

options.label: 只放 localStorage，因为刷新后还在
options.feedback: 刷新仍在不表示能跨设备同步，也不能提供服务端的权限与可靠保存。

options.label: 只放页面状态，用户不离开当前页就够了
options.feedback: 页面状态通常在刷新或关闭后消失，不能代表已提交订单。

zh.tagline: 浏览器存储是网页把数据保存在用户当前浏览器中的本地机制。
zh.visualHtml:
电脑 A草稿：周末行程localStorage
× 不同步
手机 B这里没有草稿localStorage = empty
正式提交 ↑后端数据库跨设备读取

en.title: A team needs users to see the same submitted orders on both phone and computer. Where should the data primarily live?

options.label: In a server-controlled database, read through authenticated APIs; browser storage can only assist the local experience
options.feedback: Correct. Orders must work across devices and may need support staff or other systems, so the current browser cannot be the sole source.

options.label: Only in localStorage because it survives a refresh
options.feedback: Surviving a refresh does not synchronize devices or provide server-side authorization and reliable persistence.

options.label: Only in page state because the user does not need to leave this page
options.feedback: Page state commonly disappears after refresh or close and cannot represent a submitted order.

en.tagline: Browser storage is a local web mechanism for keeping data in a person's current browser.
en.visualHtml:
Laptop ADraft: weekend triplocalStorage
× no sync
Phone BNo draft herelocalStorage = empty
Submit ↑Backend databaseCross-device read

zh.title: 旧帮助页改版后要保留原链接带来的访问者。哪个做法更合适？

options.label: 把旧 URL 重定向到内容真正对应的新页面，并检查新旧链接访问结果
options.feedback: 访问者和搜索系统都会被带到相关的新内容，旧地址不会直接变成死路。

options.label: 直接删除旧页，不做任何处理，让搜索引擎下次自己更新
options.feedback: 旧链接的读者会得到错误页，相关信号和可用性都会受影响。

options.label: 把所有旧页都跳到首页，不管原来讲什么
options.feedback: 首页未必回答原链接的需求。重定向应尽量对应真实替代内容。

zh.tagline: SEO 是帮助搜索引擎理解、发现和呈现网页内容的一组持续优化工作。
zh.visualHtml:
/help/refunds退款流程怎么走确认条件、提交申请、查看进度
搜索：退款进度退款流程怎么走 · BuildHub200 · 可访问页面
内容可发现 ≠ 保证排名

en.title: After an old help page is redesigned, visitors from its existing link still need a destination. What approach fits best?

options.label: Redirect the old URL to the new page that truly corresponds to its content, then check both old and new link behavior
options.feedback: Correct. Visitors and search systems reach relevant replacement content instead of a dead end.

options.label: Delete the old page with no handling and let search engines update later
options.feedback: People following old links get an error page, harming usability and related signals.

options.label: Send every old page to the homepage regardless of what it covered
options.feedback: The home page may not answer the need expressed by the old link. Redirects should match real replacement content when possible.

en.tagline: SEO is ongoing work that helps search engines understand, discover, and present web content.
en.visualHtml:
/help/refundsHow refunds workCheck eligibility, submit, track status
Search: refund statusHow refunds work · BuildHub200 · reachable page
Discoverable content ≠ guaranteed ranking

zh.title: 旧商品地址还需要让用户自动到新地址，不能继续停留在旧地址。应该使用什么？

options.label: 配置从旧地址到新地址的重定向，并检查地址栏已经改变
options.feedback: 用户必须被带到新地址时，需要重定向并验证最终 URL；canonical 本身通常不会改变地址栏。

options.label: 只在旧页面 head 里加入指向新地址的 canonical
options.feedback: Canonical 是代表版本提示，旧地址通常仍可访问；它不能单独满足自动迁移访问的要求。

options.label: 删除旧页面并让它显示一个找不到页面
options.feedback: 删除旧地址会造成 404，既没有把用户送到新内容，也没有保留旧链接的迁移关系。

zh.tagline: 在多个相同或相近页面中声明更希望被当作代表版本的 URL
zh.visualHtml:
/products/tea?campaign=spring仍可访问/products/tea?ref=mail仍可访问
rel="canonical"→ /products/tea
地址栏不变代表版本：/products/tea

en.title: Visitors must automatically reach the new product URL instead of staying on the old one. What should be used?

options.label: Configure a redirect from the old URL to the new one and check that the address bar changes
options.feedback: Correct. When visitors must reach a new address, use and verify a redirect; a canonical hint normally does not change the address bar.

options.label: Add only a canonical link to the new URL in the old page head
options.feedback: A canonical is a preferred-version hint, and the old URL usually remains accessible. It does not by itself migrate visitors.

options.label: Delete the old page and let it show a not-found page
options.feedback: Deleting the old URL creates a 404 without sending visitors to the new content or preserving a migration relationship.

en.tagline: A preferred representative URL for pages with the same or very similar content
en.visualHtml:
/products/tea?campaign=springStill accessible/products/tea?ref=mailStill accessible
rel="canonical"→ /products/tea
Address bar unchangedRepresentative: /products/tea

zh.title: sitemap.xml 里列出了一条已经返回 404 的文章地址。应该怎样处理？

options.label: 修复文章地址或从 sitemap 中移除它，再验证清单里的 URL 都能访问
options.feedback: Sitemap 应帮助爬虫找到重要且可访问的 URL，不能靠列出错误地址把不存在的页面变出来。

options.label: 保留这条地址，因为爬虫看到它后就会自动创建或收录文章
options.feedback: Sitemap 只提供发现线索，不创建资源，也不保证收录；404 地址反而给抓取带来错误信号。

options.label: 把它换成一个给访客看的文章目录页面，并把目录层级写完整
options.feedback: 可见目录是信息架构或网站导航，不是 XML Sitemap 的替代物；这里仍要处理机器清单中的错误 URL。

zh.tagline: 用机器可读的 XML 文件列出希望爬虫发现的重要 URL
zh.visualHtml:
sitemap.xml机器可读的 URL 清单
https://example.com/https://example.com/articles/newhttps://example.com/about
爬虫→ 请求清单中的 URL200 / 可访问

en.title: An entry in sitemap.xml points to an article URL that returns 404. What should you do?

options.label: Fix the article URL or remove it from the sitemap, then verify every listed URL is reachable
options.feedback: Correct. A sitemap should help crawlers find important reachable URLs; listing a broken address cannot create the missing page.

options.label: Keep it because a crawler will create or index the article after seeing the URL
options.feedback: A sitemap is a discovery hint, not a resource creator or an indexing guarantee. A 404 entry instead gives crawling an error signal.

options.label: Replace it with a visitor-facing article directory and write out the full navigation hierarchy
options.feedback: A visible directory is information architecture or site navigation, not a replacement for an XML sitemap. The broken machine URL still needs handling.

en.tagline: List important canonical URLs in a machine-readable XML file for crawler discovery
en.visualHtml:
sitemap.xmlmachine-readable URL list
https://example.com/https://example.com/articles/newhttps://example.com/about
crawler→ requests listed URLs200 / reachable

zh.title: 管理页包含客户数据，团队想在 robots.txt 里写 Disallow 来保护它。应该怎样判断？

options.label: 用认证和授权保护管理页，再视需要用 robots.txt 减少爬虫抓取
options.feedback: 权限系统决定谁能访问数据；robots.txt 只给遵守规则的爬虫抓取建议，不能阻止知道 URL 的人打开页面。

options.label: 只写 Disallow，因为爬虫看不到的路径就不会被任何人访问
options.feedback: Disallow 不是门锁，普通用户和不遵守规则的程序仍可能请求该地址，敏感数据不能依靠它保护。

options.label: 从导航中删除管理页链接，就能替代访问控制
options.feedback: 隐藏链接只减少被发现的机会，不会检查请求者身份，也不能阻止直接访问已知地址。

zh.tagline: 放在站点根目录、告诉自动爬虫哪些路径可以抓取的规则文件
zh.visualHtml:
/robots.txtUser-agent: *
Disallow: /products?filter=爬虫跳过此路径
爬虫：遵守规则普通用户：仍可访问

en.title: An admin page contains customer data, and the team wants to protect it with Disallow in robots.txt. What is the right judgment?

options.label: Protect the admin page with authentication and authorization, then use robots.txt only to reduce crawling if useful
options.feedback: Correct. Permissions decide who can access data; robots.txt is a crawling suggestion for compliant crawlers and cannot block people who know the URL.

options.label: Disallow is enough because a path hidden from crawlers cannot be accessed by anyone
options.feedback: Disallow is not a lock. People and non-compliant programs can still request the URL, so sensitive data cannot rely on it.

options.label: Remove the admin page from navigation instead of adding access control
options.feedback: Hiding a link only reduces discovery. It does not check identity or prevent direct access to a known URL.

en.tagline: A root-level file that tells automated crawlers which paths they may crawl
en.visualHtml:
/robots.txtUser-agent: *
Disallow: /products?filter=Crawler skips this path
Crawler: follows ruleVisitor: can still access

zh.title: 旧地址 `/account` 要永久带到 `/settings/profile`，而且地址栏要显示新地址。怎样处理？

options.label: 配置到新地址的重定向，再访问旧地址检查最终 URL 和页面内容
options.feedback: 重定向会让浏览器继续访问新 URL，地址栏和内容都应反映新的目标。

options.label: 让旧地址直接返回个人资料页内容，但继续保留 `/account`
options.feedback: 这更接近服务器重写：内容可以变化，但地址栏没有被带到新的 URL。

options.label: 打开旧页面后用前端状态切换到个人资料区域，不改变地址
options.feedback: 页面内部切换不会把旧 URL 迁移到新 URL，也不能满足地址栏显示新地址的要求。

zh.tagline: 重定向是服务器或浏览器把一个 URL 的访问带到另一个 URL 的机制。
zh.visualHtml:
地址栏example.com/old-pricing
GET/old-pricing301Location/pricing→200套餐与价格
旧地址明确带到对应的新 URL

en.title: The old `/account` URL must permanently lead to `/settings/profile`, and the address bar must show the new URL. What should be done?

options.label: Configure a redirect to the new URL, then visit the old URL and check the final address and content
options.feedback: Correct. A redirect makes the browser continue to the new URL, so both the address bar and content should show the new target.

options.label: Return the profile page content at the old URL while keeping `/account` in the address bar
options.feedback: That is closer to a server rewrite: the content changes, but the browser is not taken to the new URL.

options.label: Open the old page and switch its internal state to the profile section without changing the URL
options.feedback: An in-page state change does not migrate the old URL or make the address bar show the new target.

en.tagline: A redirect is a mechanism that sends a visit from one URL to another URL.
en.visualHtml:
Addressexample.com/old-pricing
GET/old-pricing301Location/pricing→200Plans & pricing
The old address leads to its matching new URL

zh.title: 访问不存在的文章地址时，页面显示“找不到”，但 Network 显示 200。下一步应该做什么？

options.label: 让这个地址返回 404，同时保留说明和返回文章列表的入口
options.feedback: 资源不存在时，页面提示和 HTTP 状态都要表达同一个事实，返回入口再帮助用户恢复。

options.label: 把页面改成结果页，显示“操作失败”并提供重新提交按钮
options.feedback: 这里没有一个已经结束的提交流程，重试操作也不能让不存在的文章出现；问题首先是资源和状态不匹配。

options.label: 把所有不存在的地址重定向到首页，并继续返回成功状态
options.feedback: 无关地址被送到首页会丢失用户上下文，也掩盖了资源确实不存在的事实；只有有明确替代内容时才应重定向。

zh.tagline: 资源不存在时返回 404，并给用户一条可以继续走的路径
zh.visualHtml:
example.com/articles/missing
404Not Found
找不到这篇文章链接可能失效返回文章列表

en.title: An unknown article URL shows a Not Found message, but Network reports 200. What should happen next?

options.label: Return 404 for the URL while keeping the explanation and a link back to the article list
options.feedback: Correct. The page message and HTTP status should describe the same missing resource, with a recovery path for the user.

options.label: Turn it into a result page that says Operation failed and offers a resubmit button
options.feedback: No completed submission flow exists here, and retrying cannot create a missing article. The first problem is the resource and status mismatch.

options.label: Redirect every unknown URL to the home page and keep returning a success status
options.feedback: Sending unrelated URLs to the home page loses context and hides that the resource is missing. Redirect only when a matching replacement exists.

en.tagline: Return 404 for a missing resource and give people a way to recover
en.visualHtml:
example.com/articles/missing
404Not Found
We could not find this articleLink may be outdatedBack to articles

zh.title: AI 说“城市博物馆周一开放到 22:00”，还把它排进了晚间行程。哪种做法最合适？

options.label: 联网查看博物馆官网、官方预约页和当天场次，核对日期后再决定是否保留这项行程
options.feedback: 开放时间可以从带日期的一手来源直接核验，搜索摘要和 AI 的详细描述都不能替代官方信息。

options.label: 攻略写得很具体，还有具体时间，所以直接照着去
options.feedback: 具体时间让说法更像真的，却不能证明它准确；到现场才发现闭馆会直接打乱行程。

options.label: 继续问同一个 AI 它是否确定，不查看其他来源
options.feedback: 同一模型重复确认不是独立证据，应回到官网、官方预约页或场馆公告。

zh.tagline: AI 幻觉是模型生成看似可信、但不准确、无依据或虚构的信息。
zh.visualHtml:
AI 攻略博物馆周一开放到 22:00?
官网 · 7 月 28 日周一闭馆核验改正行程移出周一晚间
流畅语气 ≠ 事实证据

en.title: AI says the city museum is open until 10 PM on Monday and puts it in the evening itinerary. What is the best action?

options.label: Research the museum's official website, official reservation page, and daily sessions online, then check the date before keeping it in the itinerary
options.feedback: Correct. Dated primary sources can verify opening hours directly; a search summary or detailed AI wording cannot replace official information.

options.label: Follow the guide because it includes a specific time
options.feedback: A precise time makes the claim sound real but does not prove accuracy. Arriving to find it closed would disrupt the trip.

options.label: Keep asking the same AI if it is sure without checking another source
options.feedback: Repeated confirmation from the same model is not independent evidence. Return to the official site, official reservation page, or venue notice.

en.tagline: An AI hallucination is information a model generates that looks credible but is inaccurate, unsupported, or invented.
en.visualHtml:
AI guideMuseum open Monday until 10 PM?
Official site · Jul 28Closed MondayVerifyFixed itineraryRemove Monday evening
Confident wording ≠ factual evidence

zh.title: 用户发送消息后断网了。聊天界面应该怎样反馈？

options.label: 保留消息，显示发送失败，并提供重试或编辑
options.feedback: 用户既知道发生了什么，也不会丢掉刚写的内容，还能完成下一步。

options.label: 保留消息但不标失败，等联网后在后台静默重发
options.feedback: 静默重发保住了内容，却让用户不知道消息是否送达、何时会发送，也无法决定修改或取消。

options.label: 先把消息标成已发送，再在后台持续重试直到成功
options.feedback: 这制造了错误状态，不能让界面文案代替真实传输结果。

zh.tagline: 聊天界面是组织消息列表、输入区和对话反馈状态的交互界面。
zh.visualHtml:
项目助手在线

帮我安排两天周末旅行

正在读取收藏地点…

网络中断 · 回答未完成

输入内容仍然保留

en.title: A user sends a message and the network disconnects. What chat-interface feedback fits best?

options.label: Keep the unsent message, clearly show sending failed, and offer retry or edit-and-send-again
options.feedback: Correct. The person knows what happened, does not lose the text, and has a usable next step.

options.label: Delete the message so the chat list looks cleaner
options.feedback: The person cannot know whether it was delivered and may lose text that is hard to recreate.

options.label: Show a successful reply first and handle it when the network returns
options.feedback: That fabricates state; interface wording cannot replace an actual delivery result.

en.tagline: A chat UI is the interactive interface that organizes a message list, input area, and conversation feedback states.
en.visualHtml:
Project assistantOnline

Plan a two-day weekend trip

Reading saved places…

Network failed · answer incomplete

Your message is still here

zh.title: 三列商品卡放到手机上以后，文字和按钮都挤在一起。应该先怎样调整？

options.label: 改成单列或更少列，再检查文字和按钮是否容易使用
options.feedback: 响应式先保证当前任务能完成，再决定是否保留所有桌面排列。

options.label: 把桌面页面整体缩小，继续保留三列
options.feedback: 比例缩小会使文字和触控目标难用，不能保证手机上的任务可完成。

options.label: 保持三列宽度，改成横向滑动，让用户左右拖动浏览商品
options.feedback: 横向滑动会隐藏后面的商品，也增加逐项比较成本。常规商品列表应先减少列数，保证内容和购买操作可见。

zh.tagline: 响应式设计是让同一界面根据可用空间和设备能力调整布局与交互的设计方法。
zh.visualHtml:
1440px
BuildHub　学习　搜索　关于
→ 重排 →
390px
BuildHub　☰
同一内容 · 三列变一列 · 操作仍可完成

en.title: Three desktop product-card columns make text cramped and buttons too small at 390px. What change should be proposed first?

options.label: Use one or fewer columns at mobile width and check that title, price, and button remain readable and tappable
options.feedback: Correct. Responsive work preserves the ability to complete the current task before preserving every desktop arrangement.

options.label: Scale down the entire desktop page proportionally; three columns must stay unchanged
options.feedback: Scaling makes text and touch targets unusable and does not ensure a mobile task can be completed.

options.label: Hide the title and purchase button, leaving only images to avoid crowding
options.feedback: That removes information and actions needed to buy rather than reorganizing the layout.

en.tagline: Responsive design is the practice of adapting one interface's layout and interaction to available space and device capabilities.
en.visualHtml:
1440px
BuildHub　Learn　Search　About
→ reflow →
390px
BuildHub　☰
Same content · three columns become one · task stays usable

zh.title: 用户想找名称或描述里提到“预算”的项目，但不知道项目状态。应该先做什么？

options.label: 搜索“预算”，从名称和描述中找相关项目
options.feedback: 目标是从用户输入的词找到候选，不是先指定一个固定分类条件。

options.label: 先筛选“未完成”，再只在剩余项目的标题里搜索“预算”
options.feedback: 状态不能代表“预算”这个词出现在哪里，会遗漏仍在进行中的相关项目。

options.label: 按最近更新时间排序，再从前几页人工查找“预算”
options.feedback: 排序只能改变查看顺序，不能定位关键词；相关项目也可能很久没有更新，人工翻页容易漏掉。

zh.tagline: 搜索是根据用户输入的关键词，从内容集合中找出可能相关结果的功能。
zh.visualHtml:
⌕退款×
退款政策帮助文档
订单退款进度项目 · 售后
在名称和描述中找到 2 条候选结果

en.title: A person wants projects whose name or description mentions “budget” but does not know their status. What should they use first?

options.label: Search for “budget” across project names and descriptions, then filter further if needed
options.feedback: Correct. The goal is to find candidates from a person's words, not to choose a fixed category condition first.

options.label: Use only a Completed filter because all searches should be by status
options.feedback: Status cannot represent where “budget” appears and would miss relevant in-progress projects.

options.label: Draw a status chart so the person can guess which projects are relevant
options.feedback: Charts compare data; they do not locate specific content by keyword.

en.tagline: Search is a feature that uses a person's keywords to find potentially relevant results in a collection.
en.visualHtml:
⌕refund×
Refund policyHelp article
Order refund statusProject · support
2 candidate results from names and descriptions

zh.title: 用户只想看“本周到期，而且还没完成”的任务。怎样处理最准确？

options.label: 同时选择“本周到期”和“未完成”，并显示这两个条件
options.feedback: 两个已知字段共同缩小任务集合，用户也能看见为什么有些任务没有出现。

options.label: 输入整句话，只按任务标题匹配
options.feedback: 标题未必包含“本周到期”或“未完成”，这会把结构化条件误当关键词。

options.label: 先按截止日期排序，再把已完成任务折叠到列表底部
options.feedback: 排序不会排除不符合条件的任务，只会改变它们出现的顺序。

zh.tagline: 筛选是按已有属性或条件缩小当前内容集合的功能。
zh.visualHtml:
状态：待处理 ×期限：本周 ×
修复登录错误待处理 · 本周
检查手机布局待处理 · 本周
5 条 → 2 条
条件来自任务已有字段

en.title: A person wants only tasks due this week and not completed. Which design is most accurate?

options.label: Use two filters—due date is this week and status is incomplete—and show both as active above the list
options.feedback: Correct. Two known fields narrow the task set, and people can see why some tasks are absent.

options.label: Have the person type the full sentence and match only title text
options.feedback: Titles may not contain “due this week” or “incomplete”; that mistakes structured conditions for keywords.

options.label: Sort by due date so other tasks naturally disappear
options.feedback: Sorting does not remove items that fail a condition; it only changes their order.

en.tagline: Filtering is a feature that narrows the current content collection using existing properties or conditions.
en.visualHtml:
Status: pending ×Due: this week ×
Fix sign-in errorPending · this week
Check mobile layoutPending · this week
5 items → 2
Conditions come from existing task fields

zh.title: 需要比较 4 个渠道本月分别带来了多少订单。怎样展示更容易比较？

options.label: 使用柱状图，并标清渠道名称、单位和数值
options.feedback: 柱的长度让类别数量容易比较，标签和数值让结果可核对。

options.label: 使用饼图显示四个渠道的占比，只在悬停时查看具体订单数
options.feedback: 饼图能看构成，但相近扇区不容易精确比较；题目要比较四个独立类别的数量，柱长更直接。

options.label: 使用折线图，把四个渠道当成四个连续点连接起来
options.feedback: 四个渠道不是连续时间点，连线会暗示不存在的顺序和趋势，无法准确表达类别比较。

zh.tagline: 图表是用位置、长度、大小或颜色等视觉编码来比较和理解数据的展示方式。
zh.visualHtml:
近 6 个月订单单位：单
1月2月3月4月5月916月
柱长显示差异 · 数值保留精确结果

en.title: Operations wants to compare this month's order counts from four channels. Which display fits best?

options.label: Use a bar chart with clear channel names, units, and values to compare the four channels, adding a data table when needed
options.feedback: Correct. Bar length makes category counts easy to compare, while labels and values keep the result checkable.

options.label: Use only a colorful ring with no legend or values and rely on color to feel the difference
options.feedback: People cannot reliably tell what each color means or the precise difference.

options.label: Draw a trend line then state that ads caused orders to grow without other evidence
options.feedback: A chart can show changes happening together; it cannot prove causation on its own.

en.tagline: A chart is a way to compare and understand data through visual encodings such as position, length, size, or color.
en.visualHtml:
Orders · 6 monthsunit: orders
JanFebMarAprMay91Jun
Bar length shows difference · labels preserve exact values

zh.title: 背景改成深灰以后，输入框边界和错误提示几乎看不见。下一步应该检查什么？

options.label: 检查文字、边框、错误和焦点在深色背景上是否清楚
options.feedback: 深色模式是整套界面状态，关键操作和反馈都必须继续清楚。

options.label: 复用浅色模式的边框和错误色，只反转背景与正文颜色
options.feedback: 背景更黑不会自动让边界、提示和焦点可辨认，反而可能降低可读性。

options.label: 给所有输入框统一加白色描边，错误状态继续使用同一种边框
options.feedback: 统一白边可能让输入框可见，却抹掉普通、错误和焦点状态的差异；这些状态需要分别检查对比度。

zh.tagline: 深色模式是一套可切换的深色界面主题状态，而不只是把页面背景涂黑。
zh.visualHtml:
浅色周末旅行目的地　杭州
⇄
深色周末旅行目的地　杭州
背景、文字、边框、焦点与错误一起切换

en.title: After the team changes a page background to dark gray, input borders and error messages are almost invisible. What should happen next?

options.label: Audit text, borders, inputs, errors, focus, and charts for contrast and state in the dark theme—not only the background
options.feedback: Correct. Dark mode is a full interface state, so key actions and feedback must remain clear.

options.label: Make the background even blacker; no other colors need change
options.feedback: A darker background does not automatically make borders, feedback, and focus discernible and may reduce readability.

options.label: Hide error messages to make the dark page cleaner
options.feedback: Errors remain feedback needed to complete a task; deleting them does not solve contrast.

en.tagline: Dark mode is a switchable dark interface theme state, not merely a page with a black background.

zh.title: 三个页面的主按钮都要换成新的品牌色。怎样修改更不容易遗漏？

options.label: 让按钮共用一个命名颜色，只修改这个颜色的值
options.feedback: 共同设计决定有一个来源，改品牌色时不会遗漏分散写死的值。

options.label: 在每个组件里分别查找并替换色值
options.feedback: 短期可行，但相同蓝色可能有不同含义，也容易漏掉某个组件或状态。

options.label: 为三个页面分别创建一份按钮颜色变量，再逐页修改
options.feedback: 令牌应承载可共享的设计决定；每个实例各有一份不会带来一致性。

zh.tagline: 设计令牌是集中命名和复用颜色、间距、字体等设计值的变量。

en.title: Primary buttons on three pages all need to change from blue to a new brand color. Which implementation is easier to maintain?

options.label: Have buttons reference one semantic primary-brand token, change that token's value once, and check every button
options.feedback: Correct. The shared design decision has one source, so a brand-color change does not miss scattered hard-coded values.

options.label: Manually find and replace blue hex values in every component
options.feedback: This can work briefly, but the same blue may mean different things and it is easy to miss a component or state.

options.label: Create a different color token for every button used once
options.feedback: Tokens should carry reusable design decisions; one isolated token per instance does not create consistency.

en.tagline: A design token is a named variable that centrally stores and reuses design values such as color, spacing, and typography.

zh.title: 团队要用 Git 共同维护一份包含操作步骤和命令的 README。哪种交付方式最合适？

options.label: 用 Markdown 写标题、列表和代码块，提交前检查预览
options.feedback: Markdown 同时保留可读结构和纯文本内容，命令能复制，修改也能在 Git 中逐行审查。

options.label: 在文档软件里排版，再把每一页导出成图片提交
options.feedback: 图片能保留外观，但文字难以复制、搜索和逐行比较，不适合持续协作的 README。

options.label: 使用纯文本并靠连续空格、空行把内容推到目标位置
options.feedback: 不同编辑器会用不同字体和换行宽度，空格排版无法稳定表达标题、列表和代码边界。

zh.tagline: Markdown 是用少量排版符号表示标题、列表和代码的结构化纯文本格式
zh.visualHtml:
SOURCE · 源码
# 周末计划 **周六爬山**，早点出发 - 带水和零食 ``` npm run dev ```
→
RENDERED · 渲染后
周末计划 周六爬山，早点出发 带水和零食 npm run dev

en.title: A team will maintain a README with procedures and commands through Git. Which delivery format fits best?

options.label: Use Markdown headings, lists, and code blocks, then check the rendered preview
options.feedback: Markdown keeps readable structure in plain text, so commands remain copyable and changes can be reviewed line by line.

options.label: Lay it out in a document editor and commit an image of every page
options.feedback: Images preserve appearance, but their text is difficult to copy, search, and compare line by line.

options.label: Use plain text and align sections with repeated spaces and blank lines
options.feedback: Editors use different fonts and wrapping widths, so spacing cannot reliably express headings, lists, or code boundaries.

en.tagline: Write structured text with lightweight punctuation
en.visualHtml:
SOURCE · Source code
# Weekend Plan **Hike the mountain** on Saturday, start early - Bring water and snacks ``` npm run dev ```
→
RENDERED · After rendering

zh.title: 文章页的大标题只是放大的普通文字，“查看原文”也是可点击的普通容器。应该怎样修改？

options.label: 用合适的 HTML 标题和链接元素表达结构与跳转
options.feedback: HTML 元素会把标题层级和链接角色交给浏览器识别，页面外观仍可继续由 CSS 控制。

options.label: 保留现有容器，只继续加大字号并换成更醒目的颜色
options.feedback: 视觉样式能改变外观，却不会让浏览器、键盘和辅助技术识别标题结构或链接角色。

options.label: 把标题和原文入口做进一张图片，再给整张图绑定点击
options.feedback: 图片会丢失可选择文字和清楚的内容结构，入口范围与含义也难以被正确识别。

zh.tagline: HTML 是用标签描述网页内容结构、供浏览器渲染页面的标记语言
zh.visualHtml:
<html> <head> 元信息 <body> <h1> 标题 <p> 段落 <a> 链接
→
小狸的主页 我喜欢爬山和拍照。 看我的相册 →

en.title: An article's main heading is only enlarged generic text, and View source is a clickable generic container. How should this be fixed?

options.label: Use appropriate HTML heading and link elements for the structure and navigation
options.feedback: HTML elements expose heading hierarchy and link behavior to the browser while CSS can still control appearance.

options.label: Keep the generic containers and only increase the size and color contrast
options.feedback: Visual styling changes appearance but does not give browsers, keyboards, or assistive tools the missing roles.

options.label: Put the heading and source action into one image and make the whole image clickable
options.feedback: An image removes selectable text and clear document structure, and its single click target obscures the action's meaning.

en.tagline: Describe the structure and meaning of a web page
en.visualHtml:
<html> <head> Meta information <body> <h1> Title <p> Paragraph <a> Link
→
Xiaoli's homepage I like hiking and taking pictures. View my photo album →

zh.title: 主按钮可以点击，但页面上仍显示灰色。下一步最应该检查什么？

options.label: 检查按钮命中的 CSS 规则和 Computed 最终颜色，找出覆盖来源
options.feedback: 按钮行为已经存在，先看匹配和覆盖后的最终值，才能知道主题色在哪一步被替换。

options.label: 重写按钮的点击事件，让点击动作顺便设置主题色
options.feedback: 点击逻辑和静态颜色是两件事；改事件可能掩盖 CSS 覆盖问题，还会让颜色依赖一次点击。

options.label: 把按钮换成另一个 HTML 元素，期待浏览器自动使用主题色
options.feedback: 更换元素不会自动解决样式规则冲突；应先确认选择器是否命中以及哪条声明胜出。

zh.tagline: CSS 是用规则描述网页外观、布局和不同空间下变化方式的样式语言。
zh.visualHtml: HTML 按钮+ CSS 规则Computed：蓝色

en.title: The primary button is clickable, but it still appears gray. What should you inspect first?

options.label: Inspect the button's matched CSS rules and computed color to find the override
options.feedback: Correct. The button behavior already exists, so inspect matching and the final value to find where the theme color was replaced.

options.label: Rewrite the click handler so the click also sets the theme color
options.feedback: Click behavior and a static color are separate. This can hide the CSS conflict and make the color depend on one click.

options.label: Replace the button with another HTML element and expect the theme color automatically
options.feedback: Changing the element does not resolve a stylesheet conflict. Check selector matching and which declaration wins first.

en.tagline: CSS is a style language that describes a web page's appearance, layout, and changes across available space.
en.visualHtml: HTML button+ CSS rulesComputed style → blue

zh.title: 点击“新增”后页面多出任务，但查看源代码时没有这条任务。下一步应怎样判断？

options.label: 检查运行时 DOM 和脚本，确认新节点是怎样被创建并插入页面的
options.feedback: 查看源代码反映初始文档，Elements 面板里的运行时 DOM 才能显示点击后的节点变化。

options.label: 直接把这条任务写进初始 HTML，保证页面一开始就能看到
options.feedback: 这会把一次点击产生的动态内容变成固定内容，仍然没有解释脚本怎样更新当前页面。

options.label: 把页面多出的任务当成已保存数据，直接检查数据库记录
options.feedback: DOM 更新只证明当前页面有了节点，不证明数据已写入数据库；刷新后是否保留还要单独验证。

zh.tagline: DOM 是浏览器把网页文档表示成可读取和修改的节点树。
zh.visualHtml: HTML 源：1 个任务+ 脚本插入节点DOM 树：2 个任务

en.title: A task appears after clicking Add, but it is missing from View Source. What should you determine next?

options.label: Inspect the runtime DOM and script to see how the new node was created and inserted
options.feedback: Correct. View Source shows the initial document; the runtime DOM in Elements shows the node change after the click.

options.label: Write the task into the initial HTML so it is visible from the start
options.feedback: That turns click-generated content into fixed content and still does not explain how the script updates the current page.

options.label: Treat the new task as saved data and inspect the database record directly
options.feedback: A DOM update proves only that the current page has a node. It does not prove a database write; refresh persistence needs a separate check.

en.tagline: The DOM is the node tree the browser uses to represent and modify a web document.
en.visualHtml: HTML source: 1 task+ script inserts nodeDOM tree: 2 tasks

zh.title: 两个商品详情页共用“商品详情”这个标签标题，用户切换页面时分不清。浏览器标签页标题应该怎么写？

options.label: 让每个页面的 title 包含对应商品名，并保留页面里的 H1
options.feedback: title 负责浏览器文档标识，商品名能帮助区分页面；H1 仍负责页面正文层级。

options.label: 只把页面 H1 改成商品名，不修改 head 里的 title
options.feedback: H1 的变化不会自动证明浏览器标签页的 title 已经按页面更新。

options.label: 只调整 title 的关键词，保证搜索结果一定原样显示
options.feedback: 搜索系统可能参考 title，但不保证原样采用；当前页面首先要解决标签页识别问题。

zh.tagline: HTML 文档用来标识当前页面的标题

en.title: Two product pages share the tab title Product details, so people cannot tell them apart. How should it change?

options.label: Include the matching product name in each page's title and keep the page H1
options.feedback: Correct. The title identifies the document in the browser, while the product name distinguishes pages and the H1 keeps its content hierarchy.

options.label: Change only the page H1 and leave the title in the head unchanged
options.feedback: Changing the H1 does not prove that the browser tab title updates per page.

options.label: Only tune title keywords and promise that search will always copy them exactly
options.feedback: Search systems may use the title but are not required to copy it exactly; first solve page identification in the tab.

zh.title: 页面在浏览器标签里标题正常，但分享卡没有图片，应该先修哪里？

options.label: 检查分享平台读取的元数据，补齐对应的分享图片并用真实预览复测
options.feedback: 不同消费方读取不同字段，标签页正常不能证明分享卡的图片字段存在或可访问。

options.label: 重写正文第一段，让分享平台从页面正文里自动找一张图片
options.feedback: 正文内容不等于分享元数据，不能替代对分享卡输入字段的检查。

options.label: 更换 Favicon，因为所有页面图像都由它决定
options.feedback: Favicon 主要服务浏览器识别站点，不是分享卡的主图字段。

zh.tagline: 描述网页但不直接显示在正文中的页面信息

<head>titledescriptionog:image

同一个 head，不同读取方

en.title: The browser tab title is correct, but a shared link has no image. Where should you look first?

options.label: Inspect metadata read by sharing platforms, add the matching image, and retest with a real preview
options.feedback: Correct. Consumers read different fields, so a correct tab title does not prove that the share image exists or is reachable.

options.label: Rewrite the first paragraph so the platform can automatically find an image in the body
options.feedback: Page content is not the same as sharing metadata and cannot replace checking the fields that feed the preview card.

options.label: Change the Favicon because every page image comes from it
options.feedback: A Favicon mainly identifies the site in browser surfaces; it is not the main image field for a share card.

en.tagline: Information about a page that is read outside its visible body
en.visualHtml:
<head>titledescriptionog:image
tabsearchshare
one head, different readers

zh.title: 换了页头 Logo 后，浏览器标签页仍显示旧图标，应该先检查什么？

options.label: 检查 Favicon 资源和 rel=icon 配置，再清楚说明可能存在的缓存
options.feedback: 页头 Logo 和浏览器 Favicon 是两条使用路径，应检查图标资源、关联配置和浏览器缓存。

options.label: 继续调整 Header 里的 Logo，直到标签页自动变化
options.feedback: Header 只负责页面中的品牌入口，不会自动替换浏览器标签页图标。

options.label: 把工具栏里的功能图标改成新品牌图形
options.feedback: 界面功能图标服务于操作含义，与浏览器识别站点的 Favicon 不是同一个对象。

zh.tagline: 浏览器用来识别网站的小图标
zh.visualHtml:

en.title: After the header Logo changes, the browser tab still shows the old icon. What should you check first?

options.label: Check the Favicon asset and rel=icon configuration, then account for possible caching
options.feedback: Correct. The header Logo and browser Favicon are separate paths, so inspect the asset, relation, and browser cache.

options.label: Keep adjusting the Header Logo until the tab changes by itself
options.feedback: The Header owns the brand entry in the page; it does not automatically replace the browser tab icon.

options.label: Replace a toolbar action icon with the new brand shape
options.feedback: A UI action icon communicates an operation and is separate from the Favicon that identifies the site in the browser.

en.tagline: A small icon browsers use to identify a website

zh.title: 文章页的 Hero 图在网页中正常，但分享卡没有图片，应该修什么？

options.label: 补或修正 og:image，使用外部可访问的绝对地址，再重新抓取预览
options.feedback: 网页中的 Hero 图和分享卡输入是不同路径，必须检查 og:image 的值与外部可访问性。

options.label: 继续裁切网页 Hero 图，直到分享平台自动发现它
options.feedback: 裁切页面图片不会自动写入 Open Graph 元数据，也不能保证外部平台读取到它。

options.label: 只增加正文关键词，因为 Open Graph 只负责搜索排名
options.feedback: Open Graph 主要描述链接分享预览，不是搜索排名配置；正文关键词不能替代 og:image。

zh.tagline: 用 og:* 元数据描述链接分享预览的内容

en.title: The article Hero image works on the page, but the shared card has no image. What should be fixed?

options.label: Add or fix og:image with an externally reachable absolute URL, then refresh the preview fetch
options.feedback: Correct. The page Hero image and share-card input are separate paths, so inspect the og:image value and reachability.

options.label: Keep cropping the page Hero image until the sharing platform discovers it automatically
options.feedback: Cropping the page image does not write Open Graph metadata or guarantee that the external platform reads it.

options.label: Only add body keywords because Open Graph is for search ranking
options.feedback: Open Graph primarily describes shared-link previews, not search ranking; body keywords cannot replace og:image.

zh.title: 主屏幕图标里的品牌文字被系统裁掉了，应该怎样处理？

options.label: 重做安全区域内的简化方形图标，检查主屏幕、搜索和设置中的识别结果
options.feedback: 系统会缩放或套用形状，图标应保留清楚的识别中心，不能直接把横向 Logo 当成最终图标。

options.label: 把应用内工具栏图标缩小后直接当作 App Icon
options.feedback: 工具栏图标表达单个功能，应用图标负责识别整个应用，尺寸、语义和展示位置都不同。

options.label: 删除图标里的品牌形状，让系统自己生成一个默认图标
options.feedback: 默认图标会失去应用识别；应调整品牌图形的简化程度和安全区域，而不是放弃身份。

zh.tagline: 操作系统用来识别应用的品牌图像

en.title: The system crops the brand text inside the Home Screen icon. What should you do?

options.label: Redesign a simplified square icon within a safe area and check Home Screen, search, and Settings
options.feedback: Correct. The system scales or masks the icon, so its recognition center must remain clear instead of using a horizontal Logo unchanged.

options.label: Shrink an in-app toolbar icon and use it directly as the App Icon
options.feedback: A toolbar icon communicates one function; an App Icon identifies the whole app, so their meanings and surfaces differ.

options.label: Remove the brand shape and let the system generate a default icon
options.feedback: A default icon loses the app's identity. Adjust the brand shape and safe area instead of abandoning recognition.

zh.title: 网站安装后总是从错误路径打开，应该先检查什么？

options.label: 检查 Manifest 的 start_url，并重新安装后验证启动地址
options.feedback: 安装后的默认启动地址由 Manifest 等安装配置决定，不能靠更换 Favicon 修复。

options.label: 更换 Favicon，因为浏览器会从它推断启动路径
options.feedback: Favicon 负责浏览器站点识别，不负责安装后的默认启动 URL。

options.label: 只添加 Service Worker，并假设启动地址会自动变正确
options.feedback: Service Worker 与缓存或离线行为有关，不能替代检查 Manifest 的 start_url。

zh.tagline: 描述 Web 应用名称、图标和启动方式的 JSON 文件

en.title: An installed site always opens at the wrong path. What should you check first?

options.label: Check the Manifest start_url and verify the launch address after reinstalling
options.feedback: Correct. The default installed launch address comes from install configuration such as the Manifest, not from changing the Favicon.

options.label: Change the Favicon because the browser infers the launch path from it
options.feedback: A Favicon identifies a site in browser surfaces; it does not define the installed default URL.

options.label: Only add a Service Worker and assume the launch address will become correct
options.feedback: A Service Worker relates to caching or offline behavior and cannot replace checking the Manifest start_url.

en.tagline: A JSON file that describes a Web app's name, icons, and launch behavior

zh.title: 当前版本已经能运行，接下来要让 Agent 大改首页。怎样先留下可靠的恢复点？

options.label: 复制整个项目文件夹，并用“最终版2”作为备份名
options.feedback: 复制能留下副本，但无法清楚比较每次变化，也容易产生多个不知道差异的文件夹。

options.label: 检查当前改动并创建说明清楚的 Commit，再开始大改
options.feedback: Commit 会把确认可用的状态写进版本历史，之后可以比较新改动并回到这个恢复点。

options.label: 不保存版本，直接运行 Push，把当前文件传到远端
options.feedback: Push 只同步已经 Commit 的历史；未提交的工作区改动不会因此成为可恢复版本。

zh.tagline: Git 是在本地记录文件版本历史、比较改动并协作同步的版本控制工具

en.title: The current version works, and an Agent will make a large homepage change next. How should a reliable restore point be created first?

options.label: Duplicate the whole project folder and name it final-version-2
options.feedback: A copy preserves files but does not clearly compare changes and quickly creates ambiguous backup folders.

options.label: Review the current changes and create a clearly described commit before the large edit
options.feedback: A commit records the verified working state in history so later changes can be compared or restored.

options.label: Skip saving a version and run Push to send the current files remotely
options.feedback: Push transfers committed history. Uncommitted working files do not become a restorable version through Push.

en.tagline: Keep a history of code changes so work can be compared and restored

zh.title: Agent 让你运行 npm install 和 npm run dev，但终端刚打开，不确定当前在哪个目录。应该先做什么？

options.label: 把两条命令一次粘贴运行，报错后再寻找项目
options.feedback: 命令依赖当前目录；一次执行多条还会让后续命令在前一步失败后继续，增加混乱。

options.label: 先用 pwd 和 ls 确认项目目录，再逐条运行并看输出
options.feedback: 先确认作用目标能避免在错误目录安装或启动；逐条执行也能保留第一条可处理的结果。

options.label: 先给两条命令加 sudo，避免之后出现权限错误
options.feedback: 尚未出现权限问题时提高权限会扩大影响范围，也不能解决当前目录是否正确。

zh.tagline: 终端命令行是通过输入文字命令操作电脑和运行程序的界面
