zsh — my-first-page
$ npm run dev > my-first-page@0.1.0 dev ✓ Ready in 1.2s → Local: http://localhost:3000 浏览器打开这个地址，就能看见你的页面

en.title: An Agent asks you to run npm install and npm run dev, but the terminal just opened and you do not know the current directory. What comes first?

options.label: Paste both commands at once and locate the project only after an error
options.feedback: Commands depend on the current directory, and batching them may continue after the first one fails.

options.label: Use pwd and ls to confirm the project, then run each command and read its output
options.feedback: Confirming the target avoids changing the wrong directory, and one-at-a-time execution preserves the first actionable result.

options.label: Add sudo to both commands before any permission error appears
options.feedback: Increasing privileges expands the impact and does not establish whether the command is running in the correct project.

en.tagline: Run text commands in a specific folder on your computer or server
en.visualHtml:
zsh — my-first-page
$ npm run dev > my-first-page@0.1.0 dev ✓ Ready in 1.2s → Local: http://localhost:3000 Open this address in your browser and you will be able to see your page

zh.title: 保存按钮点击后没有更新，页面提示需要看服务器返回的失败原因。先打开哪个面板？

options.label: 打开 Network，查看保存请求的状态码、请求内容和响应
options.feedback: 服务器返回的状态和响应内容属于网络请求证据，Network 能把失败停在哪一步显示出来。

options.label: 打开 Elements，反复修改按钮文字直到页面看起来像保存成功
options.feedback: Elements 适合检查节点和样式，改文字不能证明请求成功，也看不到服务器返回的原因。

options.label: 打开 Storage，先删除所有浏览器数据再重新点击保存
options.feedback: 清除存储可能丢失登录态和草稿，却不能直接说明这次请求为何失败；应先保留并查看请求证据。

zh.tagline: 浏览器开发者工具是一组用来检查网页结构、样式、错误、请求和存储状态的内置工具。
zh.visualHtml: 页面现象→ 选择证据面板Network：400 + 响应

en.title: Clicking Save does not update the page, and the server response is needed to explain the failure. Which panel should you open first?

options.label: Open Network and inspect the save request's status, payload, and response
options.feedback: Correct. The server status and response are network evidence, and Network shows where the save flow stopped.

options.label: Open Elements and keep changing the button text until it looks saved
options.feedback: Elements is for nodes and styles. Changing text cannot prove the request succeeded or reveal the server's reason.

options.label: Open Storage, delete all browser data, and click Save again
options.feedback: Clearing storage may lose a session or draft without explaining this failure. Preserve and inspect the request evidence first.

en.tagline: Browser DevTools are built-in tools for inspecting page structure, styles, errors, requests, and storage state.
en.visualHtml: Visible problem→ choose evidence panelNetwork: 400 + response

zh.title: 刚 Clone 一个 JavaScript 项目，仓库里有 package.json 和锁文件，但没有 node_modules。下一步怎样恢复依赖？

options.label: 让同事压缩并传来他的 node_modules，直接覆盖到项目里
options.feedback: 依赖目录可能与系统和环境不同，也无需手工传递；项目清单和锁文件才是可重建依据。

options.label: 进入项目目录运行 npm install，再执行项目定义的脚本
options.feedback: npm 会根据 package.json 和锁文件恢复依赖，随后 scripts 才能使用项目约定的工具。

options.label: 看到缺哪个包就全局安装哪个，直到启动不再报错
options.feedback: 逐个猜包会偏离项目锁定的依赖版本，也无法让其他环境按同一清单重建。

zh.tagline: npm 是给 JavaScript 项目下载所需工具、运行项目命令的工具。
zh.visualHtml:
package.json · 清单 "react": "^19.0.0" "vite": "^6.0.0" "scripts": dev / build
npm
install
→
node_modules · 依赖目录 📦 react 📦 vite 📦 …共 42 个包

en.title: You just cloned a JavaScript project. It contains package.json and a lockfile but no node_modules. How should dependencies be restored?

options.label: Ask a teammate to zip their node_modules and copy it over the project
options.feedback: The dependency directory may differ by system and does not need manual transfer. The manifest and lockfile are the reproducible source.

options.label: Enter the project directory, run npm install, then use the project's defined scripts
options.feedback: npm restores dependencies from package.json and the lockfile so project scripts can use the intended tools.

options.label: Install every missing package globally until the startup errors disappear
options.feedback: Guessing global packages bypasses the project's locked versions and cannot reproduce the same environment elsewhere.

en.tagline: Install JavaScript packages and run project scripts
en.visualHtml:
package.json · Manifest "react": "^19.0.0" "vite": "^6.0.0" "scripts": dev / build
npm
install
→
node_modules · Dependency directory 📦 react 📦 vite 📦…42 packages in total

zh.title: 要把第三方服务密钥用于后端，又不想把它提交到仓库。应该放在哪里？

options.label: 放在部署环境的服务端环境变量中，并让本地示例文件不含真实值
options.feedback: 密钥由运行环境提供，仓库只保留变量名和设置说明。

options.label: 写进前端配置文件，靠不在界面上显示来隐藏
options.feedback: 发到浏览器的内容可以被查看，不能存放密钥。

options.label: 写在代码注释里，发布前再删掉
options.feedback: 密钥可能已进入提交历史或构建产物，临时写入同样有泄露风险。

zh.tagline: 环境变量是在代码外保存设置值、让不同运行地点读取各自配置的方式。
zh.visualHtml:
.env · 本地开发配置 OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-•••••• DATABASE_URL=postgres://••••
process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY 🛡 .gitignore 规则已匹配；提交前再看 git status

en.title: A backend needs a third-party secret without committing it. Where should it live?

options.label: In a server-side deployment environment variable, with a real-value-free local example
options.feedback: Correct. The runtime supplies the secret; the repository keeps only its name and setup guidance.

options.label: In frontend configuration, hidden by not rendering it
options.feedback: Anything shipped to the browser can be inspected and cannot hold a secret.

options.label: In a code comment until just before release
options.feedback: It can enter history or a build artifact; temporary exposure is still exposure.

en.tagline: Provide configuration outside the source code
en.visualHtml:
.env · Local development configuration OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-•••••• DATABASE_URL=postgres://••••
process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY 🛡 .gitignore rule has been matched; check git status before submitting

zh.title: 代码已经合并，怎样确认用户实际访问到的是新版本？

options.label: 确认构建和部署成功，再用生产地址检查版本标识和关键路径
options.feedback: 合并不等于上线；需要同时确认部署平台和真实用户入口。

options.label: 看到 main 有新提交就宣布上线
options.feedback: 构建、部署、缓存或环境配置仍可能让生产停在旧版本。

options.label: 本地打开正常就算生产已更新
options.feedback: 本地环境无法证明生产构建和发布结果。

zh.tagline: 把项目发布到目标环境运行，使目标用户或其他系统可以正常访问
zh.visualHtml:
本地文件 → build 打包 → 托管平台 → my-app.vercel.app
这是公开静态前端的示例；服务部署还需要运行与访问配置

en.title: Code is merged. How do you confirm users are actually receiving the new version?

options.label: Confirm build and deployment success, then check a version signal and key path on production
options.feedback: Correct. Merge is not release; verify both the platform and the real user entry point.

options.label: Announce release when main has the new commit
options.feedback: Build, deployment, cache, or environment configuration can still leave production on an old version.

options.label: Count a working local page as production updated
options.feedback: Local behavior cannot prove the production build and release.

en.tagline: Build the project and make it available on a server
en.visualHtml:
Local files → build package → Hosting platform → my-app.vercel.app
This is an example of exposing a static front end; service deployment also requires running and access configuration

zh.title: 平台已经分配了运行环境，但公网页面还是旧版本。这个现象更应该先查什么？

options.label: 检查最近一次 Deployment 是否发布了正确版本，并查看公开 URL
options.feedback: 承载环境已经存在，旧版本说明发布动作或版本选择可能有问题；先查 Deployment 的输入和结果。

options.label: 再创建一个 Hosting 环境，让两个环境同时提供页面
options.feedback: 已有承载环境时，新增 Hosting 不会说明为什么旧版本被提供；应先检查发布到哪个环境和哪个版本。

options.label: 只更换域名解析，因为域名本身会决定页面版本
options.feedback: 域名和解析决定请求去哪里，不会自动把新版本发布进已有环境；版本问题仍要检查 Deployment。

zh.tagline: 持续保存并向用户提供网站文件或运行环境的服务
zh.visualHtml:
本地项目部署 Deployment持续托管 Hosting请求公网页面 200
发布后，托管环境继续承载请求

en.title: The platform has assigned a runtime environment, but the public page still shows the old version. What should you check first?

options.label: Check whether the latest deployment published the right version, then inspect the public URL
options.feedback: Correct. The hosting environment exists, so an old version points to the deployment input or result. Check which version was published where.

options.label: Create another hosting environment and have both serve the page
options.feedback: An existing environment does not explain the old version. First check the target environment and the version used by the deployment.

options.label: Change DNS only because the domain determines which version is served
options.feedback: A domain and DNS direct requests to a destination, but they do not publish a new version into that environment. Check deployment instead.

en.tagline: A service that continuously stores and serves website files or a running environment
en.visualHtml:
Local projectDeploymentPersistent hostingRequestPublic page 200
After one release ends, hosting continues to serve later requests

zh.title: 准备给已有真实数据的用户表增加一个必填字段 status（不能为空）。最稳妥的工程做法是什么？

options.label: 分步迁移：先加可空字段，按业务规则回填老数据，空值归零后再收紧为必填
options.feedback: 先兼容旧记录，再完成数据转换，最后增加约束；每一步都有可检查的结果。

options.label: 直接删掉生产用户表并重新建表，通知所有老用户重新注册并录入个人信息
options.feedback: 不对。重建生产表会删除现有记录，不是增加字段所需的迁移方案。

options.label: 登录生产数据库的可视化管理界面直接点点加列，只要在线上生效就无需提交代码
options.feedback: 不对。只在线上手改无法让其他环境复现，也没有进入项目的版本记录和审核流程。

zh.tagline: 把数据库结构或必要的数据转换写成有顺序、可版本化、可追踪的变更步骤。
zh.visualHtml: 0002_add_status_nullable.sql→0003_backfill_status.sqlNULL = 0 后再加 NOT NULL

en.title: You need to add a required column status (NOT NULL) to an existing user table with live data. What is the safest migration strategy?

options.label: Staged migration: add a nullable column first, backfill existing rows, and enforce NOT NULL after verifying zero NULLs
options.feedback: Correct. Keep old rows compatible, complete the data conversion, verify it, and only then enforce the constraint.

options.label: Drop the live user table and recreate it from scratch, asking existing users to sign up and re-enter data
options.feedback: Incorrect. Recreating the production table deletes existing records and is not a migration plan for adding one field.

options.label: Manually add the column via a database GUI in production without checking any migration files into git
options.feedback: Incorrect. A production-only manual edit cannot be reproduced in other environments or reviewed through the project's versioned workflow.

en.tagline: An ordered, versioned, and traceable set of steps for changing database structure or required data.
en.visualHtml: 001_init.sql→002_add_phone.sqlStatus: Up to date (v2)

zh.title: 团队说“行程功能做好了”，但还没有操作过页面。下面哪一条最适合作为验收标准？

options.label: 保存有效行程后显示行程卡；刷新后同一行程仍在；日期错误时提示怎样修改
options.feedback: 每一项都有明确操作和可观察结果，可以直接判定通过或不通过。

options.label: 使用最新框架、覆盖率达到 80%、代码文件足够整洁
options.feedback: 这些可能有价值，但没有说明用户是否完成了保存行程这件事。

options.label: 页面看起来专业，大家感觉应该可以上线
options.feedback: 感觉不能替代可重复的检查条件。

zh.tagline: 验收标准是用来判断成果是否满足要求的一组明确可检查的结果条件。
zh.visualHtml:
杭州周末行程3/3

✓ 保存后出现行程

✓ 刷新后内容还在

✓ 错误日期给出改法

en.title: The team says the itinerary feature is done but nobody has operated the page. Which is the best acceptance criterion?

options.label: Saving a valid itinerary shows its card, it remains after refresh, and invalid dates explain how to fix them
options.feedback: Correct. Every item has an action and an observable result, so it can pass or fail.

options.label: Use the latest framework, reach 80% coverage, and keep files tidy
options.feedback: These can matter, but they do not say whether a person can save an itinerary.

options.label: The page looks professional and everyone feels it can ship
options.feedback: A feeling cannot replace repeatable conditions.

en.tagline: Acceptance criteria are checkable conditions that determine whether a result is acceptable.
en.visualHtml:
Hangzhou weekend3/3

✓ Trip appears after save

✓ Trip remains after refresh

✓ Invalid dates explain the fix

zh.title: 下面哪段最像可执行的“错误密码”测试用例？

options.label: 准备已注册账号，输入正确邮箱和错误密码；点登录；预期留在登录页并显示“密码不正确”
options.feedback: 起点、输入、动作和预期结果齐全，别人可以重复执行。

options.label: 准备已注册账号，依次尝试几组密码，记录登录页出现的结果
options.feedback: 它有准备和操作，但没有写明这次检查期待什么结果，执行者无法直接判断通过或失败。

options.label: 输入任意邮箱和错误密码；点登录；预期统一显示“密码不正确”
options.feedback: 邮箱是否属于已注册账号会改变合理结果；起点不明确时，这条预期可能把“账号不存在”也误判成密码错误。

zh.tagline: 测试用例是写明前置条件、操作步骤、输入和预期结果的一次可重复检查。
zh.visualHtml: member@trip.test•••• wrong-2026! 密码不正确

en.title: Which text most resembles an executable wrong-password test case?

options.label: Prepare a registered account, enter its email and a wrong password, sign in, and expect to remain on the login page with “incorrect password”
options.feedback: Correct. It has a starting point, input, action, and expected result that someone else can repeat.

options.label: Prepare a registered account, try several passwords, and record whatever the login page shows
options.feedback: It has setup and actions but no expected result, so the executor cannot directly decide pass or fail.

options.label: Enter any email and a wrong password, sign in, and always expect “incorrect password”
options.feedback: Whether the email belongs to a registered account can change the valid result. The starting condition is too vague for that expectation.

en.tagline: A test case is one repeatable check that states preparation, action, input, and expected result.
en.visualHtml: member@trip.test•••• wrong-2026! Incorrect password

zh.title: 改了优惠计算规则后，哪项最适合作为单元测试？

options.label: 向优惠计算函数传入 99 元和 100 元，分别断言不减和减 20
options.feedback: 它只检查一个明确规则，输入和预期输出都固定。

options.label: 通过订单 API 提交 99 元和 100 元商品，再核对接口返回的优惠金额
options.feedback: 这也能发现问题，但已经把 API 和订单流程接进来，属于更偏集成层的检查。

options.label: 在浏览器分别下单 99 元和 100 元商品，再检查确认页上的最终金额
options.feedback: 它从用户入口检查完整结果，更接近端到端测试；不能像单元测试一样快速定位计算函数。

zh.tagline: 针对独立函数或单个组件执行功能逻辑隔离验证的单元测试。
zh.visualHtml: calculateTotal(100, .08)expect(result).toBe(108)✓ 1 passed支付 / 数据库未启动

en.title: After changing a discount rule, which is best as a unit test?

options.label: Pass 99 and 100 to the discount function and assert no discount versus 20 off
options.feedback: Correct. It checks one clear rule with fixed input and expected output.

options.label: Submit 99 and 100 items through the order API, then check the discount in its response
options.feedback: This can find a problem, but it includes the API and order flow, so it is closer to an integration test.

options.label: Place 99 and 100 orders in the browser, then check the final amount on the confirmation page
options.feedback: That checks a complete result from the user entry point, which is closer to an end-to-end test and does not isolate the calculation.

en.tagline: A unit test tests one independently verifiable function, component, or small module.
en.visualHtml: calculateTotal(100, .08)expect(result).toBe(108)✓ 1 passedpayment / database off

zh.title: 价格计算单元测试都通过，但提交表单后总价显示为空。下一步最符合集成测试思路的是？

options.label: 提交表单，核对发出的总价字段、API 返回字段和页面读取字段是否一致
options.feedback: 每个小单元可能各自正确，问题常出在它们交接的数据约定。

options.label: 继续给价格计算函数增加输入组合，确认它单独运行时仍能返回总价
options.feedback: 这会继续加强单元测试，却没有检查总价在表单、API 和页面之间是否正确传递。

options.label: 从浏览器完成一次真实支付，只检查最终订单确认页有没有金额
options.feedback: 完整用户流程能证明结果，但范围更大；当前已有单元证据，先检查相邻模块的字段交接更容易定位。

zh.tagline: 集成测试是验证多个模块、服务或依赖之间能否按约定正确协作的测试。
zh.visualHtml: 预订表单POST /bookingsBK-2048bookings · 1 条新记录

en.title: Price unit tests pass, but the total is blank after form submission. What best follows integration-test thinking?

options.label: Submit the form and check that its total field, the API response field, and the page field agree
options.feedback: Correct. Each small unit may be right on its own; the data contract at their handoff is often wrong.

options.label: Add more input combinations to the price function and confirm it still returns a total on its own
options.feedback: That strengthens the unit test but does not check whether the total moves correctly through the form, API, and page.

options.label: Complete a real payment in the browser and only check whether the final confirmation page has an amount
options.feedback: A full user flow can prove the result, but its scope is wider. With unit evidence already available, checking the adjacent handoffs will locate the issue faster.

en.tagline: An integration test verifies that multiple modules or dependencies cooperate correctly.
en.visualHtml: Booking formPOST /bookingsBK-2048bookings · 1 new row

zh.title: 后端工程师准备将用户接口中的 user_id 重命名为 uid。哪种测试能以最低成本最快在 PR 合并前发现前端将被破坏？

options.label: 契约测试：根据调用方留存的接口契约校验，发现字段被重命名后在合并前自动阻断
options.feedback: 提供方验证会把真实响应与调用方记录的最小要求比对，并在 CI 中明确指出缺失的 user_id。

options.label: 后端单元测试：只要后端自己的业务逻辑测试通过，就假定不会影响任何外部系统
options.feedback: 不对。后端单元测试只验证后端自身逻辑，无法知道外部前端是否强依赖旧字段名。

options.label: 线上人工抽查：等代码发布到生产环境后，再由人工手动点击用户中心逐项核对
options.feedback: 不对。这属于滞后的人工验收，不能在提交代码时自动预警，且成本和风险极高。

zh.tagline: 记录调用方真正依赖的请求与响应约定，再验证提供方实际行为是否兼容的自动化测试。
zh.visualHtml:
API 契约 (Contract)

前端期望: avatar_url✓ 匹配

字段变更即刻校验

en.title: A backend developer plans to rename user_id to uid. Which test catches this breakage fastest and cheapest before PR merge?

options.label: Contract testing: validates against consumer expectations and fails CI before code merges
options.feedback: Correct. Contract testing requires no browser orchestration or full environments, pinpointing breaking response schema changes directly.

options.label: Backend unit tests: internal logic checks pass within the isolated service without client context
options.feedback: Incorrect. Unit tests only verify internal logic and cannot detect broken external consumer assumptions.

options.label: Manual live checks: deploy the breaking change directly to production and verify the dashboard
options.feedback: Incorrect. Post-release manual checks come too late and carry massive deployment risk.

en.tagline: An automated test that records the requests and responses a consumer truly depends on, then verifies that the provider remains compatible.
en.visualHtml:
API Contract

Expected: avatar_url✓ Matched

Instant schema check

zh.title: 下面哪项最能证明“用户可以完成预订”这条端到端路径？

options.label: 在浏览器填写行程、提交、重新打开确认页，并核对显示的是刚才保存的行程
options.feedback: 它从用户操作入口走到最终可见结果，跨过必要系统。

options.label: 通过 API 创建行程，再检查数据库里是否写入了对应记录
options.feedback: 这能验证服务和数据的连接，但没有从用户操作入口经过页面和确认结果。

options.label: 在浏览器填写并提交行程，只检查页面有没有跳到确认页
options.feedback: 跳转本身不证明行程已经保存，也不证明确认页显示的是刚才提交的数据。

zh.tagline: 模拟真实用户跨页面跨系统完整操作流的端到端集成测试。
zh.visualHtml:
trip.local/confirmation
  1. ✓ 选行程
  2. ✓ 付款
  3. ✓ 确认
BK-2048

en.title: Which best proves the end-to-end path “a user can complete a booking”?

options.label: In a browser, enter an itinerary, submit it, reopen the confirmation page, and verify it shows the saved itinerary
options.feedback: Correct. It goes from the user's entry action to the final visible result across needed systems.

options.feedback: 监控要把异常与可操作的运行事实关联，支持及时止损。

options.label: Check the one-hour average first; if it is still low, keep watching without correlating a version

options.label: Roll back immediately at 18% without checking the new version, external login service, or metric definition
options.feedback: Stopping impact matters, but monitoring should still provide basic correlation evidence so the team does not take the wrong action or hide the real source.

options.label: End when the command reports success, without checking production metrics
options.feedback: A successful command does not guarantee traffic uses the target version or the anomaly disappeared.

options.label: Immediately start fixing v2 and ignore the current live state
options.feedback: A forward fix can follow, but first prove the present impact has stopped.

options.label: 先把旧页代码永久删除，等出问题再恢复
options.feedback: 这会失去快速回到旧路径的能力，也不是渐进开放。

options.label: Roll back the entire version whenever the trial audience needs adjustment
options.feedback: Rollback affects a whole version and cannot finely control who sees one feature in it.

options.label: Permanently delete old-page code first, then restore it if there is a problem

options.label: 只要部署任务显示成功，就保持 5% 流量不再处理

options.label: Keep 5% traffic indefinitely because the deployment job succeeded

options.label: 运行 git add .，把两个文件一起提交，之后再整理

options.label: 先提交 .env，推送前再从最新版本里删掉
options.feedback: 删掉最新文件不会抹去之前的提交记录。密钥进入历史后应立即轮换。

options.label: Stage only index.html, inspect the staged diff, then commit with “Fix homepage navigation”

options.label: Run git add . and commit both files, then clean it up later
options.feedback: git add . would stage .env too. Once a secret enters history, deleting the latest file does not remove the exposure.

options.label: Commit .env now and delete it from the latest version before pushing
options.feedback: Deleting the latest copy does not erase earlier commits. A secret that enters history should be rotated.

options.feedback: 忽略规则只影响未跟踪内容，历史中的密钥已经暴露，必须作废和更换。

options.label: 只提交 `.gitignore`，旧文件和旧密钥会自动从历史消失
options.feedback: 已跟踪文件不会因新规则消失，历史提交中的内容也仍然存在。

options.label: 保留原密钥继续使用，因为 `.gitignore` 已经把它加密隐藏
options.feedback: Gitignore 只是匹配排除规则，不会加密已经提交或本地保存的内容。

zh.tagline: 告诉 Git 哪些本地文件不要加入版本记录的规则清单
zh.visualHtml:
index.html 会记录style.css 会记录.env 不记录
×.gitignore把本地密钥挡在版本历史外

en.title: A real .env was already committed and pushed before being added to .gitignore. What else must happen?

options.label: Stop tracking it, keep a secret-free example, and immediately rotate exposed credentials
options.feedback: Ignore rules affect untracked content only, and credentials exposed in history must be revoked and replaced.

options.label: Commit only .gitignore and assume the old file and secret disappear from history
options.feedback: Tracked files do not vanish from a new rule, and prior commit content remains.

options.label: Keep using the old secret because .gitignore has now encrypted and hidden it
options.feedback: Gitignore is a matching rule, not encryption for committed or local content.

en.tagline: Tell Git which untracked files should stay out of version control
en.visualHtml:
index.html Trackedstyle.css Tracked.env Ignored
×.gitignoreKeep local secrets out of version control

zh.title: Agent 说“只改了按钮颜色”，但 `git status` 显示 12 个文件有变化，其中还有大段删除。提交前应该怎样确认？

options.label: 逐行检查未暂存和已暂存 Diff，确认误删、调试内容与密钥都不存在
options.feedback: Diff 展示实际增删，分别检查两部分才能知道提交最终会包含什么。

options.label: 只看修改文件数量，只要按钮文件在列表里就直接提交
options.feedback: 文件名不能说明每行变化，其他文件中的误删和敏感内容仍可能进入提交。

options.label: 看到新增绿色行很多就判断改动正确，不阅读删除内容
options.feedback: 颜色只表示增加或删除，不评价业务正确性；大段删除尤其需要停下来确认。

zh.tagline: 把改动前后的内容逐行摆在一起，标出删了什么、加了什么
zh.visualHtml:
改动前按钮文字− 点我
→
改动后按钮文字＋ 立即开始

en.title: An Agent says it only changed a button color, but `git status` shows 12 changed files and large deletions. What should happen before commit?

options.label: Review unstaged and staged diffs line by line for deletion, debug content, and secrets
options.feedback: Diff shows actual additions and removals, and both areas reveal what the final commit will contain.

options.label: Check only the file count and commit as long as the button file appears
options.feedback: Filenames do not reveal line changes, so other files may still contain deletion or sensitive content.

options.label: Assume many green additions mean correctness and skip reading removed content
options.feedback: Colors indicate addition and removal, not business correctness; large deletions require explicit review.

en.tagline: See exactly what changed between two states
en.visualHtml:
Before changesButton text− Click me
→
After changesButton text＋ Start now

zh.title: 项目已经使用 Next.js Route Handler，现在要增加一条注册接口。怎样处理更合适？

options.label: 沿用现有路由、校验和错误处理方式，把注册业务放进对应处理函数并验证成功与失败请求
options.feedback: 框架负责统一入口和公共处理，新增业务应沿用项目已有结构，并用真实请求验证结果。

options.label: 另外安装 Express 专门处理注册接口，让两套框架分别维护自己的路由和错误格式
options.feedback: 同一项目并行维护两套路由和错误处理会增加排错成本，这个需求没有证明需要第二套框架。

options.label: 复制框架示例并返回固定成功结果，等页面完成后再补输入校验和注册业务
options.feedback: 固定成功结果不能证明注册发生，也会让前端把未完成的业务误认为可用。

zh.tagline: 开发后端时使用的现成项目骨架，帮助组织请求、处理代码和错误
zh.visualHtml:
入口路由GET /api/signup → 框架代办公共处理日志 · 身份 · 错误 → 你写的业务处理函数创建账号
框架给骨架；业务规则仍要你写清楚

en.title: A project already uses Next.js Route Handlers and now needs a sign-up endpoint. What is the better approach?

options.label: Follow the existing routing, validation, and error patterns, put sign-up logic in the matching handler, and verify success and failure requests
options.feedback: Correct. The framework supplies consistent entry and shared handling; new business logic should follow that structure and be verified with real requests.

options.label: Install Express just for sign-up so two frameworks can maintain separate routes and error formats
options.feedback: Maintaining two routing and error systems increases debugging cost, and this request does not justify a second framework.

options.label: Copy a framework example that always returns success, then add validation and sign-up logic after the page is finished
options.feedback: A fixed success response does not prove an account was created and makes unfinished business logic appear usable.

en.tagline: Use a shared structure for routes, requests, data, and server behavior
en.visualHtml:
PortalRoutingGET /api/signup → Framework AgentPublic ProcessingLog · Identity · Error → Business you writeProcessing functionCreate account
The framework gives you the skeleton; you still need to write the business rules clearly

zh.title: 同一个“文章”资源既要读取列表，也要创建新文章。怎样安排端点更清楚？

options.label: GET /api/posts 读取，POST /api/posts 创建，并分别约定结果
options.feedback: 方法和路径一起表达要处理的资源与动作，两条端点还能分别说明输入、成功和失败状态。

options.label: 所有功能都发到 /api/do，再让后端从一句文字里猜动作
options.feedback: 通用入口隐藏了资源和操作，文档、权限、错误处理和单独测试都会变得更难。

options.label: 读取和创建都使用 GET /api/posts，只改变请求体内容
options.feedback: GET 通常用于读取，而且请求体没有通用语义；创建应按接口约定使用能表达写入的方法。

zh.tagline: 路由决定访问一个网址或执行一种操作时，应交给后端的哪段功能处理。
zh.visualHtml:
GET/api/posts→ 列表处理
POST/api/posts→ 创建处理
GET/api/posts/:id→ 详情处理
方法和路径一起决定进哪段代码

en.title: The same Posts resource needs to list existing posts and create a new one. How should the endpoints be arranged?

options.label: Use GET /api/posts to list and POST /api/posts to create, with separate result contracts
options.feedback: Method and path together express the resource and action, while each endpoint can define its own inputs and outcomes.

options.label: Send every operation to /api/do and let the backend infer the action from free text
options.feedback: A generic endpoint hides resources and actions, making documentation, permission checks, errors, and testing harder.

options.label: Use GET /api/posts for both listing and creation and only change the request body
options.feedback: GET normally reads data and has no generally defined request-body semantics. Creation needs a method that expresses a write.

en.tagline: Match a request path and method to the code that handles it
en.visualHtml:
GET/api/posts→ List processing
POST/api/posts→ Create processing
GET/api/posts/:id→ Details processing
Method and path together determine which code to enter

zh.title: 要查“当前用户自己的未完成任务”，哪种查询边界更安全？

options.label: 按当前用户和未完成状态筛选，并只取页面需要的字段
options.feedback: 查询条件同时限定归属和状态，避免读取无关或他人的数据。

options.label: 先查全部任务，再由前端隐藏不属于当前用户的行
options.feedback: 数据已经被发到客户端，前端隐藏不能保护访问边界。

options.label: 只要加未完成条件，使用 SELECT * 没关系
options.feedback: 即使行范围正确，也不应无必要地取回敏感或不用的字段。

zh.tagline: 后端或数据库工具用来查找和修改关系型数据的语言
zh.visualHtml:
SELECT name, city FROM users WHERE city = '深圳'
命中这些行
id名字城市
1小狸深圳
2阿机杭州
3小林上海

en.title: For a current user’s incomplete tasks, which SQL boundary is safer?

options.label: Filter by current user and incomplete status, returning only fields the page needs
options.feedback: Correct. The query limits ownership and state so it does not read unrelated or other users’ data.

options.label: Query every task and hide other users’ rows in the browser
options.feedback: The data is already sent to the client; hiding it there does not protect access.

options.label: Use SELECT * as long as incomplete status is filtered
options.feedback: Even with correct rows, do not return sensitive or unused fields without need.

en.tagline: Ask a relational database to read or change structured records
en.visualHtml:
SELECT name, city FROM users WHERE city = 'Shenzhen'
Hit these lines
idnamecity
1XiaoliShenzhen
2AjiHangzhou
3Xiao LinShanghai

zh.title: 报名表把年龄填成“二十”，页面看起来能提交。更可靠的处理是哪一种？

options.label: 前端提示格式，同时由服务端按年龄范围和数据类型再次校验
options.feedback: 前端提示帮助用户更快改正，服务端校验才是不能绕过的最终判断。

options.label: 只要浏览器的输入框限制了数字，就直接保存
options.feedback: 浏览器限制可被绕过，也可能被脚本直接调用接口。

options.label: 先保存原文，之后再由运营手动清理异常值
options.feedback: 错误数据进入系统后会污染后续流程，应该在写入前拒绝或明确修正。

zh.tagline: 数据校验是在使用输入前检查其格式、范围和业务规则的步骤
zh.visualHtml: 后端规则有一处不通过就不写入

en.title: A signup form accepts the age “twenty”. Which handling is more reliable?

options.label: Give browser feedback and validate the type and range again on the server
options.feedback: Correct. Browser feedback helps people fix input; server validation is the final check that cannot be bypassed.

options.label: Save whenever the browser input restricts the field to numbers
options.feedback: Browser restrictions can be bypassed or skipped by a direct API call.

options.label: Save the original text and have operations clean invalid values later
options.feedback: Invalid data should be rejected or corrected before it enters later workflows.

en.tagline: Check that incoming data has the expected shape and allowed values
en.visualHtml: Backend rulesDo not write if it does not pass

zh.title: 有人带着有效登录态访问“我的订单”。系统首先该确认什么？

options.label: 确认这次请求对应的是哪个已登录用户
options.feedback: 身份认证回答“你是谁”；之后才能决定这个用户能看什么。

options.label: 只要页面上显示了用户头像，就认为已经登录
options.feedback: 头像是前端显示，不是服务端可验证的身份凭据。

options.label: 先根据用户是管理员还是普通成员决定身份
options.feedback: 角色属于权限判断，前提是已经可靠地识别出用户。

zh.tagline: 确认当前用户身份的检查过程
zh.visualHtml: 证明身份→服务端核对→登录态

en.title: A request with a valid session opens My Orders. What must the system establish first?

options.label: Which signed-in user this request belongs to
options.feedback: Correct. Authentication answers who the requester is before the system can decide what they may see.

options.label: That the page displays a user avatar
options.feedback: An avatar is browser display, not server-verifiable identity.

options.label: Whether the user is an admin or a member
options.feedback: A role is an authorization decision made after identity is established.

en.tagline: Verify who is making the request
en.visualHtml: Prove identity→Server verification→Login status

zh.title: 已登录的普通成员请求删除另一个团队的项目。下一步该判断什么？

options.label: 该用户是否对这一个项目拥有删除权限
options.feedback: 身份已知后，还要针对资源和动作判断是否允许。

options.label: 让他重新输入一次密码，只要成功就允许删除
options.feedback: 重新认证不能自动授予原本没有的项目权限。

options.label: 只要前端没有显示删除按钮，就不需要服务端判断
options.feedback: 用户仍可直接构造请求，服务端必须执行权限检查。

zh.tagline: 确认身份后，根据规则判断用户是否有权访问特定界面或执行某项操作
zh.visualHtml:
当前用户成员 · 小林
查看项目允许
编辑自己的任务允许
删除他人任务拒绝
管理全部账号拒绝

en.title: A signed-in member asks to delete a project from another team. What should be checked next?

options.label: Whether this user may delete this specific project
options.feedback: Correct. Once identity is known, permission must be checked for the resource and action.

options.label: Ask for the password again and allow deletion if it succeeds
options.feedback: Re-authentication does not grant a project permission the person lacks.

options.label: Skip a server check if the browser hides the delete button
options.feedback: A request can still be constructed directly, so the server must check authorization.

en.tagline: Decide what an authenticated user is allowed to see or change
en.visualHtml:
Current UserMember · Xiaolin
View itemsAllow
Edit own tasksAllow
Delete other people's tasksReject
Manage all accountsReject

zh.title: 小官网只有联系表单：收到提交后保存内容并发通知，不想维护服务器。哪种方案更合适？

options.label: 使用短时 Serverless 函数，把数据保存到外部服务并配置超时与密钥
options.feedback: 任务按请求触发且时间短，平台可托管运行环境；持久数据和密钥仍需使用合适服务。

options.label: 把每次表单内容保存在函数内存里，之后请求继续读取
options.feedback: 不同请求可能落到不同实例，实例也会释放，函数内存不能当作持久数据库。

options.label: 让一次函数调用持续运行几小时，顺便处理视频转码
options.feedback: 短时函数受执行时长和资源限制，长任务需要匹配的队列或计算服务。

zh.tagline: Serverless 是让云平台按需要运行后端代码、免去自己维护服务器的一种方式。
zh.visualHtml:
请求POST /api/contact
→
⚡ 函数平台按需启动
→
响应200 OK
没有请求时实例为 0 · 按运行次数计费

en.title: A small site only needs a contact form that saves submissions and sends notifications, without server maintenance. Which approach fits?

options.label: Use a short serverless function, persist data externally, and configure timeouts and secrets
options.feedback: The task is brief and request-driven, so the platform can manage runtime while persistence and secrets use appropriate services.

options.label: Store form submissions in function memory and read them from later requests
options.feedback: Requests may reach different instances and instances disappear, so function memory is not durable storage.

options.label: Keep one invocation running for hours and use it for video transcoding too
options.feedback: Short functions have duration and resource limits; long jobs require suitable queues or compute services.

en.tagline: Run backend code on demand without managing a long-running server
en.visualHtml:
RequestPOST /api/contact
→
⚡ FunctionPlatform starts on demand
→
Response200 OK
The instance is 0 when there are no requests · Billed by the number of runs

zh.title: 线上订单接口偶发 500，现有日志只有“出错了”，客服给出发生时间和订单号。下一步怎样改进排查？

options.label: 记录时间、请求 ID、动作、耗时和错误堆栈，并按线索搜索复现
options.feedback: 可搜索上下文能串起一次请求的关键步骤，错误堆栈则帮助定位真正失败位置。

options.label: 把密码、Token、Cookie 和完整订单都打印出来方便比对
options.feedback: 敏感信息会进入长期日志和更多访问范围，排错不能以泄露用户凭证为代价。

options.label: 继续只写“出错了”，但把同一句日志提高到 error 级别
options.feedback: 提高级别不会增加动作、对象或原因，仍无法与客服提供的事件对应。

zh.tagline: 记录后端运行时发生了什么，主要用来查找失败原因
zh.visualHtml:
服务端日志req_8fa2
12:08:31收到请求POST /api/orders12:08:31订单已写入order=o_91184ms返回成功201
同一个 request id 串起一次请求

en.title: A production order API intermittently returns 500, and logs only say Error. Support provides time and order number. How should investigation improve?

options.label: Record time, request ID, action, duration, and stack, then search and reproduce from those clues
options.feedback: Searchable context connects the steps of one request, and the stack helps locate the actual failure.

options.label: Print passwords, tokens, cookies, and the complete order to make comparison easier
options.feedback: Sensitive data would enter durable logs and broader access, making diagnosis itself a credential leak.

options.label: Keep only Error but raise the same message to error severity
options.feedback: A higher level adds no action, object, or cause and still cannot connect to the reported incident.

en.tagline: Record what the server did so problems can be traced
en.visualHtml:
Server logreq_8fa2
12:08:31Request receivedPOST /api/orders12:08:31Order writtenorder=o_91184msResponse sent201
One request id connects the whole request

zh.title: 团队准备增加“保存行程”功能。下面哪一条最适合作为用户故事？

options.label: 作为正在规划多日旅行的人，我希望保存未完成的行程，以便稍后继续编辑
options.feedback: 这句话说明了谁有需要、希望完成什么，以及这个能力带来的结果，可以继续讨论保存范围和验收条件。

options.label: 新增 saveTrip() 方法、数据库表和右上角蓝色按钮
options.feedback: 这是实现与界面清单。团队仍然不知道谁需要保存、为什么需要，也无法据此判断哪些方案合适。

options.label: 增加一个体验更好的行程保存功能
options.feedback: 这只是功能名称和模糊评价，没有说明目标用户、使用目的，也没有给后续讨论提供明确边界。

zh.tagline: 以“角色 + 诉求 + 价值”为结构，从真实用户视角描述功能预期的需求表达框架。
zh.visualHtml: 用户故事旅行者需要保存未完成的行程以便稍后继续编辑

en.title: A team plans to add trip saving. Which option works best as a user story?

options.label: As a traveler planning a multi-day trip, I want to save an unfinished itinerary so I can continue editing it later
options.feedback: Correct. It names the user, goal, and value, giving the team a useful starting point for discussing scope and acceptance criteria.

options.label: Add a saveTrip() method, a database table, and a blue button in the top right
options.feedback: That is an implementation and interface list. It does not explain who needs the feature or why.

options.label: Add a better trip-saving experience
options.feedback: That is only a feature label with a vague quality claim. It does not identify the user, goal, or value.

en.tagline: A brief requirement that states who needs what and why from the user's perspective
en.visualHtml: User storyA traveler needs to save an unfinished tripso they can continue editing later

zh.title: 下面哪组内容最适合作为“顾客申请退款”的用户用例？

options.label: 顾客在可退款订单中提交原因；系统检查期限并显示退款结果；超期或重复申请时说明原因和下一步
options.feedback: 它围绕一个参与者目标，写出了触发条件、顾客动作、系统回应、成功结果和重要例外。

options.label: 作为顾客，我希望申请退款，以便取回不需要商品的费用
options.feedback: 这是用户故事，说明了用户、目标和原因，但没有展开系统交互、条件与例外。

options.label: RefundController 调用 PaymentService，再把状态写入 refunds 表
options.feedback: 这是内部实现。用例应描述顾客与系统之间可观察的行为，不要求预先决定控制器、服务和数据表。

zh.tagline: 描述参与者为达成目标与系统交互时的正常路径和重要例外
zh.visualHtml: 顾客提交退款申请→系统批准或说明拒绝原因

en.title: Which option works best as the use case for “a customer requests a refund”?

options.label: The customer submits a reason for an eligible order; the system checks the deadline and shows the result; expired or duplicate requests explain why and what to do next
options.feedback: Correct. It centers on one actor goal and includes the trigger, interaction, system response, successful result, and important exceptions.

options.label: As a customer, I want to request a refund so I can recover the cost of an unwanted item
options.feedback: That is a user story. It states the user, goal, and reason without describing the interaction and exceptions.

options.label: RefundController calls PaymentService and writes the status to the refunds table
options.feedback: That is internal implementation. A use case describes observable behavior without choosing controllers, services, or tables.

en.tagline: A description of the main interaction and important exceptions between an actor and a system while reaching a goal
en.visualHtml: CustomerRequest refund→SystemApprove or explain rejection

zh.title: 团队要检查“访客完成预约”的路径。下面哪张图最符合 User Flow？

options.label: 从预约入口开始，经过选择时段和提交资料，分别画出有号、无号、提交成功、资料错误及返回修改的路径
options.feedback: 这张图围绕一个用户目标，包含起点、关键动作、决策分支、成功终点和失败后的恢复路径。

options.label: 按首页、服务、价格、帮助中心列出全站页面层级，不说明预约动作和结果
options.feedback: 这是 sitemap 的内容组织与导航结构，不能看出访客怎样完成一次预约。

options.label: 详细画出预约页每个输入框、按钮的尺寸与位置，但不连接操作顺序和异常分支
options.feedback: 这是 wireframe 更关心的界面布局。没有动作顺序和分支，就无法检查完整的用户路径。

zh.tagline: 画出用户从入口到完成目标所经过步骤和分支的路径图
zh.visualHtml:
进入预约→ 选时段→ 有号？→ 预约成功
↳ 无号：提示原因并返回重选

en.title: A team wants to inspect the path for “a visitor completes a booking.” Which diagram is the best User Flow?

options.label: Start at the booking entry, continue through slot selection and details submission, and map available, unavailable, success, invalid-details, and return-to-edit paths
options.feedback: Correct. It centers on one user goal and includes an entry, key actions, decisions, a successful endpoint, and recovery from failure.

options.label: List the hierarchy of Home, Services, Pricing, and Help Center pages without showing booking actions or outcomes
options.feedback: That is sitemap content organization and navigation structure. It does not show how a visitor completes a booking.

options.label: Draw the exact size and position of every input and button on the booking screen without connecting the sequence or error branches
options.feedback: That is closer to a wireframe’s interface layout. Without actions and branches, the complete user path cannot be checked.

en.tagline: A path diagram of the steps and branches a user takes to reach one goal
en.visualHtml:
Start booking→Choose a time→Available?→Booked
↳ No: explain and choose again

zh.title: 下面哪份材料最接近“第一次购买并开始课程”的用户旅程？

options.label: 按发现、了解、购买、收到邮件、进入课程分阶段，记录每个触点的行动、疑问、情绪和访谈或行为证据
options.feedback: 它跨越多个触点和时间阶段，并且把行动、想法、感受与证据放在一起。

options.label: 只画登录页、课程列表和播放页之间的点击分支
options.feedback: 这更接近 User Flow，只覆盖产品内完成任务的动作和分支。

options.label: 团队直接写“用户一定很兴奋”，不记录访谈、反馈或行为依据
options.feedback: 旅程图可以记录感受，但必须区分证据、推断和待验证假设，不能替用户编造情绪。

zh.tagline: 按阶段记录用户跨触点完成目标时的行动、想法、感受和阻碍
zh.visualHtml: 发现●了解●付款●开始学习

en.title: Which artifact is closest to the user journey for buying and starting a course?

options.label: Map discovery, evaluation, purchase, email, and course entry, with actions, questions, feelings, and interview or behavior evidence at each touchpoint
options.feedback: Correct. It spans time and touchpoints while connecting actions, thoughts, feelings, and evidence.

options.label: Show only the click branches between sign-in, the course list, and the player
options.feedback: That is closer to a user flow, which focuses on actions and decisions inside the product.

options.label: Write “users will definitely feel excited” without interviews, feedback, or behavior evidence
options.feedback: A journey can include feelings, but it must separate evidence, inference, and assumptions.

en.tagline: A staged view of a user's actions, thoughts, feelings, and obstacles across touchpoints while pursuing a goal
en.visualHtml: Discover●Evaluate●Pay●Start

zh.title: 访谈和低保真测试发现：用户确实会手工并排比较结果，但目前只在意快速看差异，没人使用团队协作或多种导出。下一步怎样做更符合产品发现？

options.label: 把范围收窄到双栏差异和保存结果，继续观察目标用户是否能完成任务并重复使用
options.feedback: 现有证据支持的是更小的问题范围；下一步应据此缩小方案并继续验证，而不是自动批准全部功能。

options.label: 既然有人需要比较，就把团队协作、多种导出、支付和管理后台一起完成
options.feedback: 不对。证据只支持快速比较，不能顺带证明其他功能有价值；扩大范围会重新引入未经验证的假设。

options.label: 因为用户没有认可完整方案，立刻认定比较需求不存在，并停止记录这次发现
options.feedback: 不对。用户已经展示了真实的手工比较行为。合理决定是收窄问题并继续验证，而不是忽略已有证据。

zh.tagline: 在投入完整开发之前，通过收集用户与业务证据，验证问题是否真实存在、方案是否具备价值和可行性的探索过程。
zh.visualHtml: 写下高风险假设→观察真实行为决定：继续 / 收窄 / 暂停

en.title: Research shows users manually compare results side by side, but they currently care only about spotting differences; nobody uses collaboration or multiple exports. What should happen next?

options.label: Narrow the scope to two-column differences and saved results, then keep observing task completion and repeat use
options.feedback: Correct. The evidence supports a smaller problem scope, so the next test should narrow the solution rather than approve every proposed feature.

options.label: Because comparison matters, finish collaboration, multiple exports, payments, and an admin dashboard together
options.feedback: Incorrect. Evidence for quick comparison does not validate the other features; expanding the scope adds untested assumptions.

options.label: Because users did not endorse the full concept, conclude that no comparison problem exists and discard the research
options.feedback: Incorrect. Users demonstrated real manual comparison behavior. Narrowing and testing again fits the evidence better.

en.tagline: The exploration process of collecting user and business evidence to validate whether a problem is real, valuable, and feasible before committing to full development.
en.visualHtml: Validate Pain Point→Validate Solution ValueDecision: Ready to Build

zh.title: 团队准备做“会议纪要一键导出”。下面哪组内容最适合作为这项需求的 PRD 主体？

options.label: 目标用户与导出障碍、要支持和暂不支持的场景、成功标准、假设与待确认问题
options.feedback: 这组内容说明了为什么做、为谁做、做到哪里以及怎样判断有效，团队仍可在边界内讨论具体实现。

options.label: 第三季度所有项目的先后顺序、负责人和预计发布日期
options.feedback: 这些内容主要属于路线图或项目计划，不能替代当前导出需求的用户问题、范围和成功标准。

options.label: 数据库表、接口字段和每个页面像素都预先写死，不说明用户问题或验证标准
options.feedback: 这把技术设计和线框细节当成了需求本身。团队仍不知道为什么这样做，也无法判断交付后是否解决了用户问题。

zh.tagline: 系统阐述产品背景、用户价值、功能范围与验收标准的结构化需求文档。
zh.visualHtml:
PRD会议纪要一键导出
背景与用户问题 目标与成功标准 范围 · 做 / 不做 验收标准

en.title: A team is preparing a one-click meeting-notes export. Which set of content best forms the core of its PRD?

options.label: Target users and export pain points, in-scope and out-of-scope cases, success criteria, assumptions, and open questions
options.feedback: Correct. This explains why the work matters, who it serves, its boundaries, and how to judge the result while leaving implementation choices open.

options.label: The sequence, owners, and projected dates for every third-quarter initiative
options.feedback: That is primarily roadmap or project-planning information. It does not replace the user problem, scope, and success criteria for this export requirement.

options.label: Predefine every database table, API field, and screen pixel without stating the user problem or validation criteria
options.feedback: This mistakes technical design and wireframe detail for the requirement itself. The team still cannot tell why it is building this or whether it solved the problem.

en.tagline: A product document that defines the user problem, scope, and success criteria
en.visualHtml:
PRDOne-click meeting-notes export
User problemGoal and success criteriaScope · in / outAcceptance criteria

zh.title: 团队最担心“自由职业者是否愿意付费使用自动催款”。哪种 MVP 最能先验证这个风险？

options.label: 向目标用户售卖小规模试点，先人工完成催款，并记录购买、使用和续费
options.feedback: 真实付款直接检验付费意愿，人工交付则让团队不用先建设完整自动化系统；购买、使用和续费行为还能帮助判断价值是否持续。

options.label: 快速上线一套功能残缺、数据保护也未完成的财务系统，再看用户会不会抱怨
options.feedback: 低质量和安全缺口会污染反馈并伤害用户，无法说明核心价值是否成立；“最小”不能省掉可信实验必需的条件。

options.label: 发布一张免费功能概念图，只统计点赞数，并据此判断用户愿意付费
options.feedback: 点赞表达的兴趣与真实付费行为不同。这种证据没有直接检验当前最关键的付费假设。

zh.tagline: 以最低成本构建核心可用闭环、用于验证核心业务假设的产品最小原型版本。
zh.visualHtml:
完整产品 6 个月 12+ 功能 · 上线后才知道
MVP 2 周 1 个核心 · 即见真实付费

en.title: The team’s biggest risk is whether freelancers will pay for automatic payment reminders. Which MVP tests that risk first?

options.label: Sell a small paid pilot, deliver reminders manually, and track purchase, usage, and renewal
options.feedback: Correct. An actual payment directly tests willingness to pay, while manual delivery avoids building the full automation system first. Purchase, usage, and renewal behavior also show whether the value lasts.

options.label: Quickly launch an incomplete finance suite without finished data protection, then watch whether users complain
options.feedback: Poor quality and safety gaps distort feedback and harm users. Being minimal does not remove conditions required for a trustworthy experiment.

options.label: Post a free feature concept image, count likes, and treat that as proof that users will pay
options.feedback: Likes show a different kind of interest from actual payment behavior, so this evidence does not directly test the key willingness-to-pay assumption.

en.tagline: The smallest real product or experiment that tests a key product assumption
en.visualHtml:
Full product6 months12+ features · learn after launch
MVP2 weeksOne core value · real payment evidence

zh.title: 支付故障影响所有订单，同时团队收到一个地图配色建议。怎样更新产品待办列表更合理？

options.label: 核对影响后把支付故障移到前面并补充验收条件，配色建议保留在后面等待更多证据
options.feedback: 列表顺序可以根据风险和证据调整；近期条目需要更清楚，较远的想法可以先保留必要信息。

options.label: 所有新内容只按收到时间追加，原有顺序永远不变
options.feedback: 产品待办列表是动态的。新风险和证据出现后仍保持旧顺序，会让列表失去决策作用。

options.label: 给列表里的每一项确定发布日期，并立即向用户承诺全部实现
options.feedback: 进入待办列表只表示该项被记录和考虑，不等于已经承诺范围或日期。

zh.tagline: 按顺序维护产品未来可能需要完成的功能、修复和改进的动态清单
zh.visualHtml: 1支付失败修复2行程自动保存3地图配色建议

en.title: A payment failure affects every order, while the team also receives a map-color suggestion. How should the product backlog change?

options.label: Verify the impact, move the payment failure upward with clearer acceptance conditions, and keep the color idea lower while gathering evidence
options.feedback: Correct. The order can change with risk and evidence. Near-term items need more clarity than distant ideas.

options.label: Append every new item by arrival time and never change the existing order
options.feedback: A product backlog is dynamic. Keeping the old order after new risk appears removes its decision value.

options.label: Assign a release date to every item and promise that all of them will ship
options.feedback: Being in the backlog means an item is considered, not that its scope or release date is committed.

en.tagline: A dynamic, ordered list of features, fixes, and improvements that a product may need next
en.visualHtml: 1Fix payment failure2Autosave trips3Map color idea

zh.title: 下面哪份计划最接近产品路线图？

options.label: Now：减少行程丢失；Next：让同行者一起编辑；Later：验证自动规划需求，并为每阶段标出预期用户结果
options.feedback: 它用时间范围表达目标、方向和预期成果，较远阶段仍保留调整空间。

options.label: 列出未来六周每位开发者每天编写哪个文件，以及精确到小时的完成时间
options.feedback: 这是任务排期，主要回答谁在什么时候完成什么，不是产品路线图的战略视角。

options.label: 把所有人提过的功能放进一张没有目标、顺序和时间范围的清单
options.feedback: 没有方向与取舍的功能清单不能说明产品准备怎样演进。

zh.tagline: 按时间范围表达产品目标、重点方向和预期成果的动态计划
zh.visualHtml: NOW保存可靠→NEXT同行协作→LATER自动规划

en.title: Which plan is closest to a product roadmap?

options.label: Now: reduce lost itineraries; Next: support co-editing; Later: validate demand for automatic planning, with an expected user outcome for each horizon
options.feedback: Correct. It uses time horizons to communicate goals, direction, and expected outcomes while leaving distant work adjustable.

options.label: List the exact file each developer will edit every day for six weeks, with hourly completion times
options.feedback: That is task scheduling. It answers who does what and when, not how the product should evolve.

options.label: Put every suggested feature into a list without goals, order, or time horizons
options.feedback: An unordered wish list cannot communicate product direction or tradeoffs.

en.tagline: A dynamic plan that communicates product goals, priorities, and expected outcomes across time horizons
en.visualHtml: NOWReliable saving→NEXTCo-editing→LATERAuto planning

zh.title: 下面哪组信息最适合进入“行程协作功能”的甘特图？

options.label: 交互设计 3 天；完成后才能开发 5 天；开发结束后测试 2 天；测试通过是发布里程碑
options.feedback: 这组信息包含具体任务、持续时间、依赖和里程碑，可以放到时间轴上检查排期。

options.label: 今年希望让更多旅行者能够顺利与同行者协作
options.feedback: 这是产品目标和方向，适合路线图；它还没有形成可以安排起止时间的具体任务。

options.label: 所有未知任务都先填明天下午完成，让图表看起来完整
options.feedback: 虚构日期会让依赖和风险失真。缺少估算时应明确标注待确认。

zh.tagline: 用时间轴横条展示任务起止时间、持续周期、里程碑和依赖关系的排期图
zh.visualHtml: 8 月设计开发测试

en.title: Which information belongs in the Gantt chart for a trip-collaboration feature?

options.label: Interaction design takes 3 days; development takes 5 days after design; testing takes 2 days after development; passing tests is the release milestone
options.feedback: Correct. It contains tasks, durations, dependencies, and a milestone that can be placed on a timeline.

options.label: This year we want more travelers to collaborate successfully with companions
options.feedback: That is a product goal suited to a roadmap, not yet a set of schedulable tasks.

options.label: Set every unknown task to finish tomorrow afternoon so the chart looks complete
options.feedback: Invented dates distort dependencies and risk. Unknown estimates should remain visibly unresolved.

en.tagline: A schedule chart that uses timeline bars to show task dates, duration, milestones, and dependencies
en.visualHtml: AugustDesignBuildTest

zh.title: 评估者在设置页点击“保存昵称”后看不到任何变化。哪条问题记录最方便团队修复并在之后复查？

options.label: 写清昵称表单的位置、修改后点击保存的步骤、系统状态不可见原则、用户影响，以及修复后要重走的路径
options.feedback: 事实、原则、影响和复查路径都明确，团队可以复现问题，也能判断修复是否有效。

options.label: 只记录“这个页面感觉不高级，建议整体重新设计”，不写位置和操作步骤
options.feedback: 不对。主观评价无法定位或复现问题，也不能判断改动后是否真的改善。

options.label: 直接要求把按钮改成绿色，不说明用户遇到了什么问题，也不重新执行保存任务
options.feedback: 不对。先写清观察和影响，再提出对应建议；只改样式不能证明状态反馈问题得到解决。

zh.tagline: 让评估者依据一组可用性经验原则，逐项检查界面中可能妨碍用户完成任务的问题。
zh.visualHtml: 位置：昵称表单原则：系统状态可见复查：保存中与结果均可见

en.title: An evaluator clicks Save Nickname in Settings and sees no change. Which issue record best supports a fix and later recheck?

options.label: Record the nickname form location, edit-and-save steps, visibility heuristic, user impact, and the path to repeat after the fix
options.feedback: Correct. The observation, principle, impact, and recheck path make the issue reproducible and the fix verifiable.

options.label: Write only that the page feels unpolished and should be redesigned, without a location or task steps
options.feedback: Incorrect. A subjective reaction cannot be reproduced or used to verify that the change improved the task.

options.label: Ask for a green button without describing the user problem or repeating the save task afterward
options.feedback: Incorrect. The observation and impact must come before a recommendation; a color change does not prove status feedback works.

en.tagline: A usability inspection method where evaluators systematically check an interface against established design principles to identify interaction defects.
en.visualHtml: Heuristic 1: StatusHeuristic 5: Error PreventionAudit: 3 Issues Found

zh.title: 团队想比较两种注册引导。下面哪种做法最接近有效的 A/B 测试？

options.label: 同一时期把符合条件的新访客随机分到 A、B 两版，预先确定注册完成率和错误率，再按约定样本与时间分析
options.feedback: 同期随机分组减少了流量和时间差异，预设主要指标、保护指标和停止条件也避免根据中途波动挑结果。

options.label: 本月给所有人上线 B 版，再与上月 A 版比较
options.feedback: 流量来源、活动和季节都可能变化，前后差异不能只归因于页面版本。

options.label: 实验开始后每小时查看，哪一版暂时领先就立刻停止并宣布胜出
options.feedback: 短期随机波动可能制造领先。应在开始前约定分析窗口和停止规则。

zh.tagline: 把符合条件的用户随机分到不同版本，并用预先确定的指标比较结果的实验方法
zh.visualHtml: A原版50 / 50B新版比较注册完成率

en.title: Which approach is closest to a valid A/B test for two sign-up guides?

options.label: During the same period, randomly assign eligible new visitors to A or B, predefine completion and error rates, and analyze after the agreed sample and duration
options.feedback: Correct. Concurrent random assignment reduces traffic and time differences, while predefined metrics and stopping rules limit result picking.

options.label: Show B to everyone this month and compare it with A from last month
options.feedback: Traffic sources, campaigns, and seasonality may change, so the difference cannot be attributed only to the page.

options.label: Check hourly and stop as soon as one version briefly leads
options.feedback: Short-term random variation can create a temporary lead. Set the analysis window and stopping rule before launch.

en.tagline: An experiment that randomly assigns eligible users to variants and compares them using predefined metrics
en.visualHtml: AControl50 / 50BVariantCompare completion

zh.title: 注册漏斗显示：访问 1,000 人、开始注册 620 人、提交资料 310 人、完成注册 280 人。应先调查哪里？

options.label: 先调查“开始注册 → 提交资料”，同时核对两个事件的定义和采集是否一致
options.feedback: 这一步从 620 人降到 310 人，步骤转化率为 50%，是当前最大流失；先核对数据口径，再调查页面、规则和用户原因。

options.label: 只看最终有 280 人完成，不需要检查中间步骤
options.feedback: 最终人数不能说明主要阻碍发生在哪里，中间步骤正是漏斗提供的定位线索。

options.label: 直接认定资料表单太长并删除字段，不核对事件或用户反馈
options.feedback: 漏斗说明哪里流失，不会自动解释为什么。原因仍需数据检查和用户证据。

zh.tagline: 按既定步骤统计用户数量和转化比例，用来发现从入口到目标结果之间的流失位置
zh.visualHtml: 访问 1,000开始 620提交 310完成 280

en.title: A sign-up funnel shows 1,000 visits, 620 starts, 310 profile submissions, and 280 completions. What should the team investigate first?

options.label: Investigate start → profile submission first, while verifying that both events use matching definitions and tracking
options.feedback: Correct. This step falls from 620 to 310, a 50% step conversion and the largest loss. Verify the data before investigating interface, rules, and user reasons.

options.label: Look only at the 280 completions and ignore intermediate steps
options.feedback: The final count cannot locate the main obstacle. Intermediate steps are the funnel's diagnostic value.

options.label: Assume the form is too long and delete fields without checking events or user feedback
options.feedback: A funnel shows where loss happens, not why. The cause still needs data checks and user evidence.

en.tagline: A sequence of user counts and conversion rates that locates drop-off from entry to a target outcome
en.visualHtml: Visit 1,000Start 620Submit 310Finish 280

zh.title: Agent 建议把现有项目的页面、数据服务和部署方式全部换成热门工具，但还没看当前代码。应该先做什么？

options.label: 先盘点现有语言、框架、数据服务和运行方式，再判断具体替换收益
options.feedback: 技术栈描述的是项目实际分工，只有知道现状和约束，替换才有可比较的成本与结果。

options.label: 按热度一次替换全部工具，完成后再处理兼容和迁移问题
options.feedback: 同时改变多层会扩大风险和排查范围，流行程度也不能证明适合当前项目。

options.label: 只记录几个产品名称，不说明它们分别负责页面、数据还是部署
options.feedback: 品牌清单没有表达职责，无法判断重复能力、缺口或某项替换会影响哪里。

zh.tagline: 技术栈是一套项目实际使用的编程语言、现成框架、数据服务和运行工具。
zh.visualHtml:
交互task.tsx页面page.tsx外观task.css运行package.json
→同一个项目待办页面可打开、点击、发布

en.title: An Agent proposes replacing a project's UI, data service, and deployment with popular tools before inspecting the code. What should happen first?

options.label: Inventory current languages, frameworks, data services, and runtime before judging replacement value
options.feedback: A stack describes actual responsibilities, and only current constraints make replacement cost and outcome comparable.

options.label: Replace every layer by popularity first and resolve migration and compatibility afterward
options.feedback: Changing many layers expands risk and diagnosis scope, while popularity does not prove fit.

options.label: List product names without saying which one owns UI, data, or deployment
options.feedback: A brand list hides responsibilities, so overlaps, gaps, and replacement impact cannot be judged.

en.tagline: The set of languages, frameworks, data services, and tools used to build and run software
en.visualHtml:
Behaviortask.tsxPagepage.tsxStyletask.cssRunpackage.json
→One projectThe to-do opens, responds, and ships

zh.title: 收藏按钮点击后数字从 4 变成 5，但刷新页面又回到 4。怎样判断问题？

options.label: JavaScript 已更新当前画面，还要确认保存请求和服务器结果是否成功
options.feedback: 浏览器逻辑可以立即改画面，刷新后的结果仍取决于数据是否真正保存。

options.label: 数字已经变化，说明收藏完成，只需阻止页面刷新
options.feedback: 画面变化只是当前浏览器状态，不能证明服务器已经保存收藏。

options.label: 把收藏权限检查全部写进浏览器，服务器直接接受结果
options.feedback: 浏览器代码可被修改，真实权限和数据规则必须由受控服务再次检查。

en.title: A favorite count changes from 4 to 5 after clicking but returns to 4 after refresh. How should the issue be understood?

options.label: JavaScript updated the current view, but the save request and server result still need verification
options.feedback: Browser logic can change the view immediately, while refresh depends on whether the data was persisted.

options.label: The number changed, so saving succeeded and refresh should simply be blocked
options.feedback: A view update is only browser state and does not prove the server stored the favorite.

options.label: Put all favorite permission checks in the browser and let the server accept the result
options.feedback: Browser code can be modified, so real permissions and data rules require a controlled server check.

options.label: 提前发现字段拼写或类型不符，但折扣业务公式仍需测试验证
options.feedback: 类型系统能检查数据形状和使用方式，无法判断一个合法数字是否符合业务含义。

options.label: 只要项目没有类型报错，字段和所有折扣结果就都正确
options.feedback: 通过类型检查不代表逻辑正确，20 和 0.2 都可能是合法数字。

options.label: 把用户资料和价格都标成 any，避免编辑器继续阻止运行
options.feedback: Any 关闭了最需要的结构检查，让拼写和错误用法更晚才暴露。

options.label: Catch misspelled fields and type mismatches early, while business formulas still need tests
options.feedback: Types check data shape and usage, but cannot know whether a valid number carries the correct business meaning.

options.label: If there are no type errors, every field and discount result must be correct
options.feedback: Passing type checks does not prove logic; both 20 and 0.2 can be valid numbers.

options.label: Mark profiles and prices as any so the editor stops blocking execution
options.feedback: Any disables the structural checks needed here and delays spelling and usage failures.

zh.title: 要用 Python 把 200 份 Markdown 汇总成 CSV，原文件不能被覆盖。运行脚本前最重要的准备是什么？

options.label: 确认输入目录、输出文件和覆盖规则，先用少量副本试运行
options.feedback: 文件自动化的主要风险是作用范围和写入结果，先明确并试运行可以避免批量损坏。

options.label: 直接对 200 份正式文件运行，若结果不对再从编辑器撤销
options.feedback: 批量脚本可能跨文件写入，编辑器撤销不一定覆盖整个过程；应先用副本验证范围和输出。

options.label: 只确认脚本能够启动，不检查输出列、编码和异常文件的处理方式
options.feedback: 能够启动只说明语法和环境基本可用，不能证明批量输入、输出和异常路径安全。

en.title: A Python script will summarize 200 Markdown files into CSV without overwriting sources. What preparation matters most before running?

options.label: Confirm input directory, output file, and overwrite rules, then test with a small copied sample
options.feedback: File automation risk comes from scope and writes, so explicit targets and a trial prevent batch damage.

options.label: Run it directly on all 200 production files and use editor Undo if the result is wrong
options.feedback: Batch scripts may write across files, and editor Undo may not cover the process; test scope and output on copies first.

options.label: Check only that the script starts, without verifying output columns, encoding, or malformed files
options.feedback: Starting proves only that syntax and runtime basically work, not that batch input, output, and error paths are safe.

options.feedback: 共享状态作为唯一画面依据，能避免三个位置各自维护并逐个同步。

options.feedback: 手工同步容易遗漏新位置，也把数据来源分散在多个操作步骤里。

options.label: 只更新 React 状态，并假设刷新页面后购物车会自动保留

options.feedback: Manual synchronization misses new locations easily and scatters the data source across operations.

options.label: Update React state and assume the cart remains after a page refresh

options.feedback: Vue 根据状态重新显示相关组件，避免手工查找和同步多个文本节点。

options.feedback: 手工操作绕开了响应式数据来源，页面增加新预览位置后容易遗漏。

options.label: 只要使用 Vue，输入的主题名称就会自动保存到服务器
options.feedback: Vue 能更新当前界面，不会自动提供请求、数据库或长期保存。

options.feedback: Manual operations bypass the reactive source and easily miss new preview locations.

options.feedback: Next.js 扩展 React 的网站结构和渲染能力，不会自动生成符合业务的数据与授权。

options.label: 安装 Next.js 后，文章数据库、登录权限和后台管理会自动完成
options.feedback: 框架提供构建能力，不知道项目的数据模型、账号规则或管理流程。

options.label: 只要页面里有一个 React 按钮，就必须迁移整个项目到 Next.js
options.feedback: 单个组件不需要完整网站框架，是否采用取决于路由、渲染和部署任务。

options.feedback: shadcn/ui 交付的是进入项目的组件源码，不是只能远程调用的黑盒服务。

options.feedback: 添加命令会把代码写进项目，项目可以直接修改，也要承担后续维护。

options.label: Button 会自动跟随所有上游更新，不需要检查本地改动或兼容性
options.feedback: 本地组件不会自动安全升级；更新时仍要审查项目自己的修改和使用位置。

options.label: Button automatically follows every upstream update without reviewing local changes or compatibility

zh.title: AI 做出的活动报名页已经能在本机打开，团队准备明天收集真实姓名和手机号。下一步更合适的是？

options.label: 暂停继续堆功能，先检查数据流、权限和依赖，补关键测试并由人审查改动
options.feedback: 本机画面正常只证明原型能运行；接触真实个人信息前，需要把它当正式软件检查和验证。

options.label: 继续接受 AI 的全部修改，只要页面没有报错就直接上线
options.feedback: 没有报错不能证明数据处理、权限和异常路径安全，真实信息不适合只靠原型体验验收。

options.label: 先让 AI 把颜色和动画做精致，视觉完成后再默认功能可靠
options.feedback: 视觉完成度与数据是否正确保存、是否越权没有直接关系，不能代替技术检查。

options.label: Pause feature work, inspect data flow, permissions, and dependencies, add critical tests, and have a person review the changes
options.feedback: Correct. A working local screen proves only that the prototype runs. Software handling real personal data needs formal review and verification.

options.label: Keep accepting every AI change and ship as soon as the page shows no error
options.feedback: No visible error does not establish safe data handling, authorization, or failure behavior.

options.label: Polish colors and animation first, then treat visual completion as proof that the feature is reliable
options.feedback: Visual polish says nothing about correct storage or access control and cannot replace technical checks.

zh.title: 下面哪一种更符合 AI Agent，而不是单次回答或预先写死的工作流？

options.label: 它先读报错和相关文件，再根据测试结果自行决定继续定位、修改还是请求人工判断
options.feedback: 步骤不是预先固定的，模型会用环境中的真实观察决定下一步，同时仍受工具和停止条件控制。

options.label: 模型收到一篇文章，只返回一次摘要，不读取外部信息也不继续行动
options.feedback: 这是一次模型生成，没有围绕环境反馈反复选择行动。

options.label: 代码固定执行“分类、翻译、发送”三步，模型不能改变顺序或选择其他工具
options.feedback: 这是预设工作流：模型参与其中，但运行路径由代码提前决定。

options.label: It reads the error and relevant files, then uses test results to decide whether to investigate, edit, or ask for human judgment

options.label: A model receives one article and returns one summary without external information or follow-up action
options.feedback: That is a single generation, not a loop of actions chosen from environmental feedback.

options.label: Code always runs classify, translate, and send in that order, and the model cannot change the path or choose another tool
options.feedback: That is a predefined workflow: a model participates, but code decides the route in advance.

options.label: 保留目标、限制、架构决定和未解决问题；压缩旧日志，只在定位需要时按路径取回原文
options.feedback: 当前目标和限制要持续可见；重复记录可以改成摘要，需要细节时再按文件位置读取原文。

options.label: 把全部历史和工具原始输出再次放入上下文，避免遗漏任何一个字
options.feedback: 信息越全不等于重点越清楚；重复输出会占空间并掩盖当前限制。

options.label: 只把最后一句提示词改得更强硬，历史和工具结果保持原样
options.feedback: 问题不只在措辞。旧信息如何筛选、压缩和取回也是上下文工程的一部分。

en.title: A long task contains requirements, approved architecture decisions, dozens of pages of old logs, and repeated tool output. The agent starts missing the newest constraint. How should the next turn be prepared?

options.label: Keep the goal, constraints, architecture decisions, and open issues; compress old logs and retrieve originals by path only when needed
options.feedback: Correct. Critical decisions stay visible, low-signal material is compressed, and locators preserve access to details on demand.

options.label: Insert the entire history and every raw tool result again so no word can be omitted
options.feedback: More material does not mean clearer priorities. Repeated output consumes context and can bury the current constraint.

options.label: Make only the final instruction more forceful and leave all history and tool results unchanged
options.feedback: Wording is only one part. Selecting, compressing, and retrieving the rest of the context also matters.

zh.title: 前端 Agent 连续三次交付“看起来完成”的页面，但点击主按钮都没有反应。哪种改法最像 Harness Engineering？

options.label: 让独立评审器用浏览器完成主流程，把失败步骤和截图送回下一轮，通过后才结束
options.feedback: 这里补的是会实际操作页面、产生失败证据并把证据送回下一轮的评测环境。

options.label: 只让 Agent 多截几张静态图，图看起来完整就算通过
options.feedback: 静态图只能证明页面能显示，不能证明按钮、导航和完整任务真的可用。

options.label: 把提示词改成“请认真检查所有交互”，仍由 Agent 自己判断是否完成
options.feedback: 自我提醒没有增加新的证据来源，同一种遗漏仍可能被带到下一轮。
