✕ 点击无反应 → 反馈 → ✓ 主流程通过

en.title: A frontend agent delivers a page that “looks done” three times, but the main button never works. Which change is harness engineering?

options.label: Have an independent evaluator complete the live flow, return failed steps and screenshots, and end only after it passes
options.feedback: Correct. This adds an environment that operates the page, produces failure evidence, and returns it to the next turn.

options.label: Only ask for more static screenshots and pass the page whenever they look complete
options.feedback: A static image proves that the page renders, not that its buttons, navigation, or end-to-end task work.

options.label: Add “carefully check every interaction” while still letting the agent judge its own work
options.feedback: A reminder adds no new source of evidence, so the same omission can survive another turn.

en.tagline: The engineering practice of turning project knowledge, tools, state, permissions, and checks into a working environment an AI agent can use
en.visualHtml:
Repeated failureThe page renders, but the main button does not work
Playwright interactionIndependent review
Next agent turnFailed step → fix → retest
Live screenshotPassing evidence
✕ No response → feedback → ✓ Main flow passed

zh.title: 旅行 Agent 已经找到合适航班，下一步会直接使用已保存的支付方式出票。怎样设置人在回路最合适？

options.label: 在扣款出票前暂停，展示日期、乘机人、总价和退改规则，批准后才继续
options.feedback: 暂停发生在不可逆动作之前，人也拿到了足够信息，可以批准、拒绝或要求修改。

options.label: 先自动扣款出票，完成后再通知用户检查订单
options.feedback: 这时高风险动作已经发生，人工检查无法起到事前控制作用。

options.label: 每次搜索一个航班都要求用户确认，连只读比较也暂停
options.feedback: 人在回路不等于每一步都审批；低风险、可撤销的检索可以自动完成。

zh.tagline: 人在回路是在 AI 工作流的关键判断或高风险动作前暂停，让人审阅、批准、拒绝或修正后再继续的机制。
zh.visualHtml:
旅行 Agent上海 ⇄ 东京¥4,260
✓ 自动比价→人付款前确认→扣款出票
⏸ 尚未扣款 · 等待你的决定

en.title: A travel agent has found a suitable flight and is about to ticket it with a saved payment method. Where should human-in-the-loop approval occur?

options.label: Pause before charging and ticketing, show the dates, passenger, total, and change rules, then continue only after approval
options.feedback: Correct. The pause occurs before the irreversible action and gives the person enough information to approve, reject, or request a change.

options.label: Charge and issue the ticket automatically, then ask the user to review the order
options.feedback: The high-risk action has already happened, so the review cannot provide preventive control.

options.label: Require approval for every flight search, including read-only comparisons
options.feedback: Human-in-the-loop does not mean approving every step. Low-risk, reversible searches can remain automatic.

en.tagline: Pausing an AI workflow before a critical decision or high-risk action so a person can review, approve, reject, or correct it
en.visualHtml:
Travel AgentShanghai ⇄ Tokyo¥4,260
✓ Compare→YouApprove payment→Charge & ticket
⏸ No charge yet · waiting for your decision

zh.title: 上线前要检查无障碍、接口错误处理和测试缺口，三项都只读代码并能独立给出证据。怎样安排更合适？

options.label: 分别交给三个只读 Sub-agent，写清检查范围；主 Agent 等全部结果后去重并汇总
options.feedback: 三项互不依赖且不改文件，适合并行；主 Agent 仍负责合并冲突结论和最终判断。

options.label: 让三个 Sub-agent 同时重写同一个配置文件，不划分所有权
options.feedback: 并行写同一文件容易覆盖和冲突。应先明确所有权，或由主 Agent 汇总结论后串行修改。

options.label: 把“检查一切”原样交给多个 Sub-agent，不说明范围、证据或返回格式
options.feedback: 边界不清会造成重复、遗漏和难以汇总；委派时仍要写清任务与产出。

zh.tagline: 由主 Agent 调度、专注处理特定独立子任务的专项执行单元。
zh.visualHtml:
主 Agent拆成 3 个边界清楚的任务
Sub Agent查官方资料Sub Agent检查代码风险Sub Agent实现导航修改
汇总证据 · 解决 nav.jsx 冲突

en.title: Before release, accessibility, API error handling, and test gaps must be reviewed. All three checks are read-only and can produce independent evidence. What is the better arrangement?

options.label: Assign one read-only subagent to each scoped check, then have the main agent wait, deduplicate, and summarize
options.feedback: Correct. Independent read-only checks parallelize well, while the main agent still resolves overlapping or conflicting findings.

options.label: Have three subagents rewrite the same configuration file at once without ownership boundaries
options.feedback: Concurrent writes to the same file can conflict or overwrite work. Define ownership or make changes serially after synthesis.

options.label: Give several subagents the same instruction to check everything, without scope, evidence requirements, or a return format
options.feedback: Unbounded delegation creates duplication, gaps, and results that are difficult to combine.

en.tagline: A separate agent the main agent assigns to a bounded part of a larger task
en.visualHtml:
Main AgentSplits 3 bounded tasks
Sub-agentResearch docsSub-agentReview code riskSub-agentPatch navigation
Merge evidence · resolve the nav.jsx conflict

zh.title: 日历助手回答“明天下午有两场会”，但产品从未给它日历权限，也没有调用日历接口。应该怎样修正？

options.label: 由应用申请权限并调用日历工具，再把真实结果交给 AI 组织回答
options.feedback: AI 只能根据收到的上下文和工具结果回答，真实日程必须由受控产品能力读取。

options.label: 继续让模型根据用户语气推测日程，不需要连接实际日历
options.feedback: 语言模型无法凭空知道私人数据，推测会把不存在的信息当成真实结果。

options.label: 只在提示词中要求“必须查询日历”，并把回答当作已执行
options.feedback: 提示词不能创造工具和权限，是否查询必须由应用实际调用记录证明。

zh.tagline: AI 应用是把 AI 放进网页或软件里，让用户提问或完成任务的产品。
zh.visualHtml:
用户帮我查明天下午的日历
界面接住问题→模型选择工具⇄日历真实日程
应用负责流程、权限与结果展示

en.title: A calendar assistant says there are two meetings tomorrow afternoon, but the product has no calendar permission and made no calendar call. How should this be fixed?

options.label: Have the app request permission, call the calendar tool, and give real results to the AI for wording
options.feedback: AI answers from supplied context and tool results; private schedules require a controlled product capability.

options.label: Let the model infer meetings from the user's tone without connecting a real calendar
options.feedback: A language model cannot know private data without access, so inference turns invented information into a claimed result.

options.label: Write You must query the calendar in the prompt and treat the response as executed
options.feedback: A prompt creates neither tools nor permission; actual execution requires an application call record.

en.tagline: A product that uses an AI model, an interface, and sometimes tools to help people complete tasks
en.visualHtml:
UserCheck my calendar tomorrow afternoon
InterfaceReceives→ModelSelects tool⇄CalendarReal schedule
The application controls flow, permission, and display

zh.title: 你想让 AI 判断手机结账页里的付款按钮为什么看不见，怎样做最合适？

options.label: 附上当前截图，说明按钮本应出现的位置，请它区分画面能确认的线索和需要检查代码才能确认的原因
options.feedback: 图片提供当前画面，文字说明问题和判断边界。模型先分析可见线索；原因还要由你，或获得项目工具权限的 Agent，在真实项目中验证。

options.label: 只说“页面有问题，帮我修一下”，不提供截图或具体表现
options.feedback: 模型没有收到当前画面，也不知道哪里异常，只能猜测。多模态任务仍需要明确提供相关信息。

options.label: 只上传截图，并默认 AI 已经看见全部代码、隐藏状态和真实运行过程
options.feedback: 截图只包含画面中的像素，不会自动带上源代码、设备状态或运行数据。

zh.tagline: 多模态 AI 能在同一个任务里结合文字、图片、音频或视频等不同形式的信息。
zh.visualHtml:
输入文字截图录音
✦多模态模型结合判断
输出回答标注图
支持哪些输入与输出，要分别确认

en.title: You want AI to explain why the payment button is not visible on a mobile checkout page. What is the best approach?

options.label: Attach the current screenshot, say where the button should appear, and ask it to separate visible evidence from causes that require checking the code
options.feedback: Correct. The image supplies the current screen, while the text defines the question and its limits. The model can inspect visible clues first; you, or an agent with project-tool access, must then verify the cause in the real project.

options.label: Only say “the page is broken, fix it” without a screenshot or a specific symptom
options.feedback: The model has neither the current screen nor a clear symptom, so it can only guess. A multimodal task still needs relevant information.

options.label: Upload only the screenshot and assume the AI can now see all code, hidden state, and runtime behavior
options.feedback: A screenshot contains only visible pixels. It does not automatically include source code, device state, or runtime data.

en.tagline: AI that can combine information such as text, images, audio, or video in one task
en.visualHtml:
InputTextImageAudio
✦Multimodal modelCombines signals
OutputAnswerMarked image
Confirm supported inputs and outputs separately

zh.title: 团队按“一个汉字等于一个 Token”估算上下文和费用，实际账单总是对不上。应该怎样估算？

options.label: 按所用模型的实际分词和用量统计输入、输出与相关上下文
options.feedback: Token 划分随模型和内容变化，真实用量或对应分词工具比字符数规则可靠。

options.label: 继续按每个汉字、字母和标点各算一个 Token
options.feedback: 字符与 Token 不是固定一一对应，代码、中文和英文都可能被不同方式切分。

options.label: 只统计 AI 最终回答，系统规则、历史和文件都不计入
options.feedback: 模型读取的输入同样占用上下文和用量，不能只看屏幕上新增的回答。

zh.tagline: Token 是 AI 读取和生成文字、标点或代码时使用的计数单位。
zh.visualHtml:
“帮我改 login 按钮”
帮我改 login 按钮
输入5 tokens＋输出逐片生成

en.title: A team estimates context and cost with one Chinese character equals one token, but bills never match. How should usage be estimated?

options.label: Use the selected model's tokenizer or actual usage for input, output, and included context
options.feedback: Tokenization varies by model and content, so actual usage or the matching tokenizer is more reliable than character rules.

options.label: Keep counting each character, letter, and punctuation mark as one token
options.feedback: Characters and tokens are not one-to-one; code, Chinese, and English may all split differently.

options.label: Count only the final AI answer and ignore system rules, history, and files
options.feedback: Input read by the model also consumes context and usage, not only newly displayed output.

en.tagline: A small piece of text or code that a model reads and writes
en.visualHtml:
“Fix the login button”
Fix the login button
Input4 tokens＋OutputGenerated piecewise

zh.title: Agent 开始遗漏刚补充的要求，回答也常在结尾被截断。准备继续同一任务前，先怎么处理？

options.label: 梳理当前任务必需的规则、资料和近期决定，摘要旧内容并预留回答空间
options.feedback: 上下文要优先保留当前任务需要的信息；旧内容可浓缩，但仍要给回答留出空间。

options.label: 保留所有输入，把给回答预留的空间压到最小
options.feedback: 输入都放进去却没有足够输出空间，模型仍可能无法完成回答。

options.label: 再发一条消息，把剩余资料继续贴进去
options.feedback: 新消息也会占用上下文。没有先筛掉无关内容，只会让空间更紧张。

zh.tagline: 上下文窗口是 AI 一次回答时能够同时参考的资料和回答内容的总量上限。
zh.visualHtml:
一次请求的上下文窗口100%
规则历史文件回答预留
旧日志重复文件空间不够 → 取舍

en.title: An Agent starts missing newly added requirements and replies often cut off. Before continuing the same task, what should you do first?

options.label: Identify the rules, material, and recent decisions the task needs, summarize older content, and reserve answer space
options.feedback: Correct. Prioritize material the current task needs, compress older content, and leave room for a response.

options.label: Keep every input and reduce the response reserve as much as possible
options.feedback: Without enough response space, the model may still be unable to complete the answer.

options.label: Send another message and paste the remaining material there
options.feedback: The new message also consumes context. Adding more without removing noise makes the limit worse.

en.tagline: The total amount of input and output a model can process in one request
en.visualHtml:
One request context window100%
RulesHistoryFilesAnswer reserve
Old logsDuplicate filesNo room → choose

zh.title: 客服 Agent 有“不能承诺退款结果”的固定规则，但用户在聊天里要求它马上承诺。哪条应优先？

options.label: 保留系统规则，说明可执行的下一步而不是承诺结果
options.feedback: 系统提示词用于产品级固定约束，用户消息不能覆盖它。

options.label: 按最新用户消息承诺，因为用户最了解自己的情况
options.feedback: 用户需求重要，但不能推翻产品设定的安全和业务边界。

options.label: 把整段系统提示词原样发给用户要求确认
options.feedback: 应执行规则并说明可做什么，不需要暴露内部提示词全文。

zh.tagline: 系统提示词是 AI 产品在背后先交给模型的规则，例如客服助手该用什么语气、哪些问题不能自行处理。
zh.visualHtml:
系统规则删除前必须确认
用户现在就删＋模型先请求确认→产品权限未确认 · 拦截
提示词影响建议 · 产品代码执行权限

en.title: A support agent has a fixed rule not to promise refund outcomes, but a user asks for an immediate promise. Which instruction wins?

options.label: Keep the system rule and offer an actionable next step instead of a promise
options.feedback: Correct. System instructions set product-level constraints that a user message cannot override.

options.label: Promise it because the newest user message knows the situation best
options.feedback: User needs matter, but cannot override product safety and business boundaries.

options.label: Send the full system prompt to the user for confirmation
options.feedback: Apply the rule and explain available action; do not expose the internal prompt.

en.tagline: Instructions an AI product gives the model behind the scenes to guide its behavior
en.visualHtml:
System ruleConfirm before deletion
UserDelete it now＋ModelAsk to confirm→Product permissionUnconfirmed · block
Prompt guides output · product code enforces access

zh.title: 用户在很长对话后说“把第二条改短”，界面能看到所有旧消息，但模型答错了对象。怎样改进？

options.label: 在本次请求中带回相关列表和指代，并控制无关历史的长度
options.feedback: 模型需要当前所指内容才能解析“第二条”，界面可见不代表请求实际包含它。

options.label: 每次永久发送完整历史，不考虑窗口、费用或无关信息
options.feedback: 全量历史会持续占用空间和成本，还可能让旧目标干扰当前任务。

options.label: 保持界面显示旧消息即可，不必检查请求里有没有发送
options.feedback: 产品保存和展示消息是一层，组装模型输入是另一层，二者不能互相替代。

zh.tagline: 对话历史是产品保存的旧消息，其中与当前问题有关的部分可以在下一次请求中再次交给模型。
zh.visualHtml:
“把第二条改短”
带回相关历史1. 新手指南2. 完整安装说明✓ 知道“第二条”
只发当前消息第二条是指什么？缺少指代

en.title: After a long chat, a user says Shorten the second one. All old messages are visible, but the model edits the wrong item. How should this improve?

options.label: Include the relevant list and reference in this request while limiting unrelated history
options.feedback: The model needs the referenced content to resolve second; visible history does not prove it was sent.

options.label: Always send the complete history without considering window, cost, or relevance
options.feedback: Full history continuously consumes space and cost and may let outdated goals interfere with the task.

options.label: Keep old messages visible in the UI and do not inspect whether the request includes them
options.feedback: Saving and displaying messages is separate from assembling model input, so one cannot replace the other.

en.tagline: Conversation history is the earlier messages a product saves and can include again when they matter to a new request
en.visualHtml:
“Make the second one shorter”
Relevant history included1. Starter guide2. Full install guide✓ Resolves “second”
Current message onlyWhich second item?Missing referent

zh.title: 服务端只收到一句“继续完成刚才的表格”，请求里没有表格或上一轮结果。模型应该如何获得背景？

options.label: 由应用在每次请求中重新附上当前表格、目标和相关上一轮结果
options.feedback: 请求本身无状态，模型只能使用这次收到的内容，应用需要重建必要背景。

options.label: 只发送“继续”，模型会根据用户账号自动恢复之前内容
options.feedback: 账号或会话存在不代表模型持有旧请求，缺少背景时“继续”没有可确定对象。

options.label: 让聊天界面保留旧表格即可，不必把它加入新请求
options.feedback: 界面存储服务于展示，只有实际组装进请求的内容才能被模型读取。

zh.tagline: 无状态请求是一次模型调用只依据本次收到的内容，不会自动保留上一轮输入和结果。
zh.visualHtml:
请求 ①资料：当前表格补全价格列
→模型
请求 ②当前表格 + 上轮结果继续补全
→模型
每次都重新带上本轮需要的资料

en.title: A server receives only Continue the previous table, with no table or prior result in the request. How should the model get context?

options.label: Have the application attach the current table, goal, and relevant prior result to each request
options.feedback: The request is stateless and the model can only use current input, so the application rebuilds required background.

options.label: Send only Continue and let the model recover previous content from the user account
options.feedback: An account or session does not mean the model retains prior requests, leaving Continue without a known object.

options.label: Keep the old table visible in the chat UI without adding it to the new request
options.feedback: UI storage supports display; only content assembled into the request can be read by the model.

en.tagline: A stateless request is a model call that uses only what it receives this time and does not automatically retain prior input or results
en.visualHtml:
Request ①Data: current tableComplete the price column
→Model
Request ②Current table + prior resultContinue filling it
→Model
Each request carries the material it needs

zh.title: 页面要把模型结果显示成任务卡片。哪种返回方式最容易稳定处理？

options.label: 要求符合任务字段 schema 的结构化结果，并校验必填字段
options.feedback: 字段固定后，程序才能可靠地渲染、校验和处理缺失值。

options.label: 让模型写一段自然语言，再用字符串规则猜标题和截止日
options.feedback: 自然语言格式容易变化，解析规则会脆弱且难以发现遗漏。

options.label: 让模型直接返回整张任务卡片的 HTML
options.feedback: 模型生成的展示 HTML 难以安全校验；应返回数据，再由界面负责渲染。

zh.tagline: 结构化输出是要求 AI 按事先约定的栏目和格式返回结果的方式。
zh.visualHtml:
活动邮件周五 19:00 · 城市剧场
title设计之夜date2026-07-31place城市剧场
✓ schema · 日期与地点仍需业务校验

en.title: A page must render model results as task cards. Which return format is most reliable?

options.label: Request structured output matching a task-field schema and validate required fields
options.feedback: Correct. Stable fields let software render, validate, and handle omissions reliably.

options.label: Ask for prose and guess title and due date with string rules
options.feedback: Natural-language formats change, making parsing brittle and omissions hard to detect.

options.label: Ask the model to return full task-card HTML
options.feedback: Model-generated display HTML is hard to validate safely; return data and let the UI render it.

en.tagline: Model output returned in an agreed, machine-checkable shape
en.visualHtml:
Event emailFriday 7 PM · City Theatre
titleDesign Nightdate2026-07-31placeCity Theatre
✓ schema · date and place still need validation

zh.title: 长回答要 20 秒完成，产品想让用户更早看到内容，但还要正确处理失败和结束。怎样设计？

options.label: 接收真实流并逐段渲染，明确生成中、完成、中断和重试状态
options.feedback: 流式响应缩短首段等待，完整状态则防止把中断内容误认为最终答案。

options.label: 等完整回答返回后，再用打字机动画慢慢显示
options.feedback: 用户仍等待了全部生成时间，只是把已完成内容延迟播放，并没有更早获得结果。

options.label: 出现第一个字就标记任务完成，后续内容在后台随缘追加
options.feedback: 首段可见不代表回答结束，过早完成会破坏复制、保存和错误处理。

zh.tagline: 流式响应是 AI 一边生成内容，界面一边逐段显示内容的方式。
zh.visualHtml:
响应事件“这个”“按钮”“可以…”•••
界面持续追加这个按钮可以
首段已可见 · 完整回答仍在生成

en.title: A long answer takes 20 seconds, and the product wants earlier visible content while handling failure and completion correctly. How should it work?

options.label: Render a real stream incrementally with generating, complete, interrupted, and retry states
options.feedback: Streaming reduces time to first content, while explicit states keep interrupted output from looking final.

options.label: Wait for the complete answer, then reveal it slowly with a typewriter animation
options.feedback: Users still wait for full generation and then receive an artificial delay rather than earlier content.

options.label: Mark the task complete at the first character and append later content in the background
options.feedback: First content is not completion, and premature state breaks copying, saving, and error handling.

en.tagline: A response sent and displayed in consecutive pieces as it is generated
en.visualHtml:
Response events“This”“button”“can…”•••
Interface keeps appendingThis button can
First piece visible · full answer still generating

zh.title: Agent 说“已经创建日历会议”，但还没有执行日历工具。此时最准确的状态是什么？

options.label: 它只提出了工具调用请求；应用执行并返回结果后才能说会议已创建
options.feedback: 模型选择工具不等于外部操作已经发生。

options.label: 模型写出了会议标题，就可视为会议已经存在
options.feedback: 文字和真实日历状态是两件事。

options.label: 直接告诉用户成功，不必等待工具的返回
options.feedback: 工具可能失败、被拒绝或创建了不同结果，必须依据真实返回确认。

zh.tagline: 工具调用是 AI 请求应用执行某项操作，再读取操作结果的方式。
zh.visualHtml:
模型请求calendar.read({ day: "tomorrow" })
应用校验权限 ✓ 参数 ✓→真实结果14:00 空闲
tool call 是请求 · 工具返回才是结果

en.title: An agent says a calendar meeting is created but has not run the calendar tool. What is the accurate state?

options.label: It has only requested a tool call; claim creation only after the app executes it and returns a result
options.feedback: Correct. Choosing a tool is not the same as an external action occurring.

options.label: A meeting title in model text means the meeting exists
options.feedback: Text and real calendar state are different things.

options.label: Tell the user it worked without waiting for the tool response
options.feedback: The tool may fail, be denied, or create a different result; confirm from its real return.

en.tagline: A model’s request for an application to run a named tool with parameters
en.visualHtml:
Model requestcalendar.read({ day: "tomorrow" })
App validatesPermission ✓ params ✓→Real result2 PM available
A tool call is a request · the return is the result

zh.title: Agent 认为登录按钮缺少点击事件，但读取文件后发现点击事件已经存在。下一步怎样处理更符合 ReAct？

options.label: 根据文件结果放弃原判断，改查点击后发出的网络请求
options.feedback: 真实观察否定了原判断，下一步应该改查仍未解释的网络请求。

options.label: 继续重写按钮点击代码，因为最初已经认定问题在按钮
options.feedback: 文件已经证明点击事件存在，继续按原判断修改会忽略刚得到的证据。

options.label: 直接宣布按钮代码没有问题，不再检查点击后的真实结果
options.feedback: 确认一个位置没有问题，不代表故障已经解释；还要根据现有证据选择下一处检查。

zh.tagline: ReAct 是让 AI 根据当前证据选择一个操作，读取真实结果，再据此选择下一步的任务方式。
zh.visualHtml:
判断按钮可能没有点击事件→行动读取 login-button.jsx↓观察点击事件已存在↖
停止改按钮 · 下一步查看 401 请求

en.title: An agent assumes a login button has no click handler, but the file shows that the handler already exists. What should happen next in a ReAct pattern?

options.label: Drop the original assumption and inspect the network request triggered by the click
options.feedback: Correct. The file result disproves the original assumption, so the next action investigates the unexplained network behavior.

options.label: Rewrite the click handler anyway because the original plan blamed the button
options.feedback: The file already shows a handler, so continuing the original edit ignores the latest evidence.

options.label: Declare the button correct and stop without checking what happens after the click
options.feedback: Clearing one location does not explain the failure; the observation should direct the next check.

en.tagline: A task pattern where an agent decides, acts with a tool, observes the result, and decides again
en.visualHtml:
DecideThe button may lack a click handler→ActRead login-button.jsx↓ObserveThe handler already exists↖
Stop editing the button · inspect the 401 request next

zh.title: Agent 修复手机导航后，同一项横向滚动检查连续失败两次。规则规定同类失败最多两次，接下来应该怎样做？

options.label: 暂停任务，保留两轮检查结果，并在扩大修改范围前请求确认
options.feedback: 同类失败已经达到上限，循环应暂停并把证据交给用户，而不是继续扩大改动。

options.label: 让 AI 把任务标为完成，因为它已经尝试过两次
options.feedback: 尝试次数不是完成证据；构建和手机页面检查还没有通过。

options.label: 继续自动修改，直到检查通过为止，不再限制次数
options.feedback: 这会绕过已经设定的上限，并可能让改动范围不断扩大。

zh.tagline: Agent 循环是应用反复调用 AI 和工具，并根据检查结果决定继续、暂停或结束的运行机制。
zh.visualHtml:
运行控制器修复手机导航溢出同类失败 2 / 2
修改→检查→再次失败→暂停
✓ 两项检查通过 → 结束! 达到上限 → 请求确认

en.title: An agent tries to fix mobile navigation, but the same horizontal-overflow check fails twice. The rule allows two attempts for the same failure. What should happen next?

options.label: Pause, preserve both check results, and ask before expanding the change scope
options.feedback: The repeated failure has reached its limit, so the loop should pause and present evidence instead of expanding changes.

options.label: Mark the task complete because the agent already tried twice
options.feedback: Attempt count is not proof; the build and mobile-page check have not passed.

options.label: Keep editing automatically until the check passes, with no further limit
options.feedback: This bypasses the stated limit and can let the change scope keep growing.

en.tagline: A runtime mechanism that repeatedly calls AI and tools, then uses check results to continue, pause, or stop
en.visualHtml:
Runtime controllerFix mobile nav overflowSame failure 2 / 2
Edit→Check→Failed again→Pause
✓ Both checks pass → stop! Limit reached → ask

zh.title: 模型 A 一秒出现首字但长回答生成很慢，模型 B 三秒开始却很快写完。应该怎样比较速度？

options.label: 分别记录首段等待、生成后速度和完整回答总时长
options.feedback: TTFT、TPS 和总时长描述不同阶段，分开测才能解释两种体验差异。

options.label: 只比较谁先出现第一个字，并据此认定整体速度更快
options.feedback: 首段等待短不代表后续生成快，长回答的总完成时间可能反而更久。

options.label: 把网络等待和生成速度合成一个 TPS 数字，不区分阶段
options.feedback: TPS 描述开始输出后的生成速率，混入前置等待会失去指标含义。

zh.tagline: TTFT 和 TPS 分别表示 AI 出现第一段回答前的等待时间，以及之后每秒生成多少内容。
zh.visualHtml:
发送1.2sTTFT32 TPS完成
第一段前的等待生成速度总时长 4.8s

en.title: Model A shows its first token in one second but generates slowly; Model B starts in three seconds and finishes quickly. How should speed be compared?

options.label: Measure time to first content, generation rate after start, and total completion separately
options.feedback: TTFT, TPS, and total time describe different phases and together explain the two experiences.

options.label: Compare only which model shows the first character and call it faster overall
options.feedback: Short first-content wait does not imply fast generation, and a long answer may finish later.

options.label: Combine network waiting and generation into one TPS number without phases
options.feedback: TPS describes output rate after generation starts, so including prior waiting removes its meaning.

en.tagline: Measures of time to first output and of token generation speed after output begins
en.visualHtml:
Send1.2sTTFT32 TPSDone
Wait for first pieceGeneration speedTotal 4.8s

zh.title: Agent 每轮都重新发送长系统规则、完整聊天和工具结果，账单持续上涨。怎样定位并降低成本？

options.label: 逐轮统计输入、输出、缓存和模型价格，裁剪无关上下文
options.feedback: 多轮成本来自每次实际处理的内容和价格，分项记录才能找到重复输入与高成本环节。

options.label: 只计算用户新输入的几句话，忽略系统规则、历史和工具结果
options.feedback: 模型每轮读取的所有输入都会占用用量，界面上新写的文字只是其中一部分。

options.label: 把旧消息从聊天界面隐藏，假设请求成本也会自动下降
options.feedback: 显示与请求组装是两层，隐藏消息不代表后端不再发送它们。

zh.tagline: AI 处理的文字片段会逐轮累加，费用还要按所用模型的价格计算。
zh.visualHtml:
第 1 轮输入 1.2k输出 280第 2 轮输入 2.1k输出 460第 3 轮输入 3.0k输出 190
输入 × 输入价＋输出 × 输出价＝ 总成本

en.title: An Agent resends long system rules, full chat, and tool results every round, and the bill keeps rising. How should cost be diagnosed and reduced?

options.label: Track input, output, cache, and model price per round, then remove irrelevant context
options.feedback: Multi-round cost follows actual processed content and rates, so itemized usage reveals repeated input and expensive stages.

options.label: Count only the user's new sentences and ignore system rules, history, and tool results
options.feedback: Everything the model reads each round contributes to usage; newly visible user text is only one part.

options.label: Hide old messages in the chat interface and assume request cost falls automatically
options.feedback: Display and request assembly are separate, so hidden messages may still be sent by the backend.

en.tagline: The cumulative model tokens in a task and the price calculated from the model’s rate card
en.visualHtml:
Turn 1In 1.2kOut 280Turn 2In 2.1kOut 460Turn 3In 3.0kOut 190
Input × input rate＋Output × output rate＝ total cost

zh.title: 短时间内连续点击“重新生成”触发了限流。界面下一步该怎么做？

options.label: 停止立即重试，说明等待时间或可重试时机，并防止重复提交
options.feedback: 限流是暂时拒绝；明确等待和禁用重复动作能避免继续加重请求。

options.label: 在后台每 100 毫秒自动重试，直到成功
options.feedback: 高频重试会继续触发限制，也可能影响其他请求。

options.label: 不显示错误提示，让用户多点几次试试
options.feedback: 用户需要知道当前动作没有完成以及何时可以重试。

zh.tagline: 速率限制是服务规定一段时间内最多能发多少次请求、处理多少内容或同时运行多少任务的上限。
zh.visualHtml:
请求队列12345
→
并发上限2
✓ 2 个执行中429 · Retry-After: 3s
排队并等待 · 不立即无限重试

en.title: Rapid clicks on Regenerate hit a rate limit. What should the UI do next?

options.label: Stop immediate retries, explain when to retry, and prevent duplicate submission
options.feedback: Correct. A limit is temporary refusal; clear waiting guidance and duplicate prevention avoid making it worse.

options.label: Retry automatically every 100ms until it succeeds
options.feedback: Fast retries keep triggering the limit and can affect other requests.

options.label: Hide the error and let people click more
options.feedback: People need to know the action did not complete and when it can be retried.

en.tagline: A service limit on requests, tokens, or concurrent tasks within a period of time
en.visualHtml:
Request queue12345
→
Concurrency2
✓ 2 running429 · Retry-After: 3s
Queue and wait · do not retry without limit

zh.title: 你让 AI 把展览官网改成包豪斯风格，结果页面只是多了红、黄、蓝色块，内容结构没有变化。怎样判断和反馈？

options.label: 指出配色不等于包豪斯，要求每个几何形承担分区、指示或强调等功能
options.feedback: 包豪斯的判断依据是几何与功能的关系；每个形状都有明确职责时，风格才成立。

options.label: 接受当前方案，包豪斯的核心就是三原色对比，结构可以保持不变
options.feedback: 三原色只是容易被记住的表面特征；只有色块没有功能关系时，页面只是换了配色。

options.label: 改成严格文字网格和无衬线排版，去掉页面里的几何图形
options.feedback: 这是瑞士排版的解决方式；它同样现代，但用网格秩序取代了几何构成，不是包豪斯。

zh.tagline: 包豪斯是一种用基础几何形、材料特性和功能需求组织画面的现代主义设计流派
zh.visualHtml:
FORM / WERK展览藏品参观
DESIGN EXHIBITION · 2026

形状就是结构

每个几何形负责一件事。

预约参观 →
圆形 = 展期与地点 三角 = 参观动线 方形 = 内容分区

en.title: You asked the AI to take an exhibition site in a Bauhaus direction, and it only added red, yellow, and blue blocks without changing the content structure. How do you judge and respond?

options.label: Point out that a palette is not Bauhaus; every geometric shape must serve a function like dividing, pointing, or emphasizing
options.feedback: Bauhaus is judged by the geometry-function relationship; the style holds only when each shape has a clear job.

options.label: Accept it, since primary-color contrast is the core of Bauhaus and structure can stay
options.feedback: Primary colors are just the most memorable surface trait; blocks without functional roles are only a recolor.

options.label: Switch to a strict text grid with sans-serif type and remove the geometric shapes
options.feedback: That is the Swiss typography answer; it replaces geometric composition with grid order, which is a different movement.

en.tagline: Organize the page with basic geometry, honest materials, and function
en.visualHtml:
FORM / WERKExhibitionArchiveVisit
DESIGN EXHIBITION · 2026

Shape is structure

Every geometric form has one job.

Book a visit →
Circle = dates and venue Triangle = visitor route Square = content sections

zh.title: 你让 AI 把精品酒店官网改成装饰艺术风格，结果页面只是换成了黑底金字，构图没有变化。哪个反馈最接近问题？

options.label: 要求先建立中轴对称骨架、阶梯轮廓和放射纹样，金色只作少量点缀
options.feedback: 装饰艺术的判断依据是几何骨架；对称、阶梯和放射关系成立后，材质才有附着点。

options.label: 认可当前方向，装饰艺术就是黑金配色，可以再加大金色面积
options.feedback: 黑金只是容易被记住的配色结果；没有对称和几何纹样时，加大金色面积也得不到装饰艺术。

options.label: 加入更多植物藤蔓和流动曲线，让页面看起来更复古
options.feedback: 长曲线和植物形态属于新艺术；装饰艺术使用对称的几何形，两种风格的形状语言相反。

zh.tagline: 装饰艺术是一种用几何对称、阶梯轮廓和放射纹样表现现代奢华的设计流派
zh.visualHtml:
GRAND HOTEL LUMIÈRE
GRAND OPENING 臻藏之夜 11.08 · 宴会厅
中轴对称 阶梯轮廓 放射纹样

en.title: You asked the AI to take a boutique hotel site in an Art Deco direction, and it only switched the page to a black background with gold text. Which response comes closest to the problem?

options.label: Ask for a symmetrical skeleton, stepped contours, and radiating motifs first, with gold only as a restrained accent
options.feedback: Art Deco is judged by its geometric skeleton; materials only have a place once symmetry, steps, and rays exist.

options.label: Approve the direction since Art Deco is the black-and-gold palette, then enlarge the gold areas
options.feedback: Black and gold is only the memorable surface result; without symmetry and geometric motifs, more gold is still not Art Deco.

options.label: Add more plant vines and flowing curves to make the page feel more vintage
options.feedback: Long curves and plant forms belong to Art Nouveau; Art Deco uses symmetrical geometry, the opposite shape language.

en.tagline: Express modern luxury through symmetry, stepped contours, and radiating motifs
en.visualHtml:
GRAND HOTEL LUMIÈRE
GRAND OPENING A Night of Treasures NOV 8 · The Ballroom
Central symmetry Stepped contour Radiating motif

zh.title: AI 说「报价工具的增删改查都做完了」。下面哪个功能不属于这四种操作？

options.label: 把报价记录导出成月度统计图
options.feedback: 导出和统计是建立在已有数据之上的扩展功能。四种基本操作只管每条记录本身的进出和修改。

options.label: 把一条报价的状态从「跟进中」改成「已成交」
options.feedback: 这属于更新（Update）：修改已有记录里的信息。

options.label: 删掉一条不再需要的报价记录
options.feedback: 这属于删除（Delete）：移除一条已有记录。

zh.tagline: 增删改查是对同一类数据反复做的四种基本操作：创建、读取、更新和删除。
zh.visualHtml: ＋ 创建☰ 读取✎ 更新🗑 删除单条数据的四项基本操作

en.title: An AI says "the CRUD for the quote tool is done." Which feature below is NOT one of those four operations?

options.label: Exporting quotes into a monthly chart
options.feedback: Correct. Exporting and reporting are extra features built on top of the data. The four basic operations only manage each record itself.

options.label: Changing a quote's status from "following up" to "won"
options.feedback: That is Update: modifying information in an existing record.

options.label: Removing a quote record that is no longer needed
options.feedback: That is Delete: removing an existing record.

en.tagline: CRUD is the four basic operations repeatedly performed on one kind of data: create, read, update, and delete.
en.visualHtml: ＋ Create☰ Read✎ Update🗑 Deleteone record's full life

zh.title: 设计报价工具时，下面哪个属于字段？

options.label: 每条报价的「金额」
options.feedback: 金额是每条记录里单独的一项信息，是字段；客户名、日期、状态也是字段。

options.label: 表单底部的「保存」按钮
options.feedback: 按钮是操作入口，不是被记录的信息。字段指信息本身，不指控件。

options.label: 整张新建报价的表单
options.feedback: 表单是填写一组字段的界面；字段是表单里的单项信息。

zh.tagline: 字段是一条记录里单独的一项信息，比如客户名、金额或日期。
zh.visualHtml: 客户名 文字金额 数字日期 日期状态 选项一条记录 = 一组字段

en.title: While designing a quote tool, which of these is a field?

options.label: The "amount" of each quote
options.feedback: Correct. Amount is one standalone piece of information per record; client name, date, and status are fields too.

options.label: The "save" button at the bottom of the form
options.feedback: A button is an action entry, not recorded information. A field is the information itself, not the control.

options.label: The entire new-quote form
options.feedback: The form is the interface for filling in a group of fields; a field is one item inside it.

en.tagline: A field is one standalone piece of information in a record, such as client name, amount, or date.
en.visualHtml: Client textAmount numberDate dateStatus choiceone record = a set of fields

zh.title: 报价工具里要「按日期远近排序」，日期字段用哪种类型最合适？

options.label: 日期类型
options.feedback: 日期类型才能按时间先后排序，手机上还会弹出日期选择器，避免格式混乱。

options.label: 文字类型，自己输入「3月2日」
options.feedback: 文字没法比较先后：「3月2日」和「12月1日」按文字排序会排错，格式也各写各的。

options.label: 数字类型，输入 0302 表示 3 月 2 日
options.feedback: 凑数字会丢失月份天数，排序和显示都不对；日期就该用日期类型。

zh.tagline: 数据类型是一条信息的格式约定：文字、数字、日期还是开关值。
zh.visualHtml: 客户名 文字金额 数字签约日期 日期自动保存 开关类型决定输入方式与计算规则

en.title: The quote tool needs to "sort by date." Which type should the date field use?

options.label: A date type
options.feedback: Correct. A date type sorts chronologically and opens a date picker on phones, avoiding messy formats.

options.label: A text type, typing "Mar 2" manually
options.feedback: Text cannot be ordered in time: "Mar 2" and "Dec 1" sort wrongly as text, and formats drift.

options.label: A number type, entering 0302 for March 2
options.feedback: Packed numbers lose month and day information; sorting and display both break. Dates belong in a date type.

en.tagline: A data type is the format agreement for one piece of information: text, number, date, or an on/off value.
en.visualHtml: Client textAmount numberSigned dateAutosave togglewrong type, broken later

zh.title: 想看「金额最大的几条报价」，下面哪种操作不会减少列表里的记录数？

options.label: 按金额从大到小排序
options.feedback: 排序只调整先后，所有记录都还在，金额最大的排到最上面；想看前几条看前几行。

options.label: 筛选金额大于 10,000 的记录
options.feedback: 筛选会把不符合条件的记录藏起来，列表变短——数量变了，这是筛选不是排序。

options.label: 把金额小的记录删掉
options.feedback: 删除直接减少数据本身，代价是记录没了；看排序不该用删除实现。

zh.tagline: 排序是把列表按某个字段排先后——按日期从新到旧、按金额从大到小，记录一条不少，只是换了位置。
zh.visualHtml: 金额 ↓日期状态点列头换顺序，记录一条不少

en.title: To see "the largest quotes," which operation does NOT reduce the number of records in the list?

options.label: Sort by amount, largest first
options.feedback: Correct. Sorting only reorders—every record stays, the largest ones move to the top.

options.label: Filter to records above 10,000
options.feedback: Filtering hides non-matching records and shortens the list—the count changes. That is filtering, not sorting.

options.label: Delete the small-amount records
options.feedback: Deleting removes the data itself. Viewing order should never be built on deletion.

en.tagline: Sorting puts a list in order by one field—newest first, or largest amount first—without removing a single record.
en.visualHtml: Amount ↓DateStatustap a header to reorder—nothing is removed

zh.title: 会计要拿到这 200 条客户记录、在 Excel 里自己改。下面哪种做法真正把数据交给了她？

options.label: 把记录存成 CSV 文件发给她
options.feedback: 导出把数据整批变成一个文件，拿到的是数据本身，可以用 Excel 或别的工具打开。

options.label: 把网页链接发给同事看
options.feedback: 分享链接只是给别人一个访问入口，数据还在原工具里——没有拿到文件。

options.label: 一次性删掉 200 条旧记录
options.feedback: 批量删除是删除的批量版，数据没了而不是搬走了。

zh.tagline: 导入导出是把数据整批搬进或搬出：导出存成 CSV、Excel 这样的文件，导入把文件变回一条条记录。
zh.visualHtml: 报价列表 · 200 条→报价.csv→Excel 打开数据以文件的形式搬家

en.title: An accountant needs all 200 customer records as a file she can edit in Excel. Which option actually gives her the data?

options.label: Send her the records as a CSV file
options.feedback: Correct. Exporting turns the whole batch into one file you can open in Excel or another tool.

options.label: Sending the web link to a colleague
options.feedback: Sharing a link only grants access; the data stays in the tool and no file changes hands.

options.label: Deleting 200 old records at once
options.feedback: Batch deletion is delete at scale—the data is gone, not moved.

en.tagline: Import and export move data in bulk: export saves records into files like CSV or Excel, import turns a file back into records.
en.visualHtml: Quotes · 200→quotes.csv→Exceldata moves as files

zh.title: 用户开始在输入框里打字，下面哪个会消失？

options.label: 框里的灰色示例文字
options.feedback: 占位文字只是开场的示范，输入一开始就让位。所以它不能代替标签——不然输入之后用户就不知道框里该是什么了。

options.label: 输入框旁边的「邮箱」标签
options.feedback: 标签一直显示在框旁边，不随输入消失——这正是它和占位文字的分工。

options.label: 两个都不消失
options.feedback: 占位文字会在输入开始时消失；如果它没消失，反而是实现有问题的信号。

zh.tagline: 占位文字是输入框里的灰色示例，告诉你该填什么格式；一开始输入就消失。
zh.visualHtml: 邮箱you@example.com开始输入后消失标签一直在 · 占位只开场

en.title: When the user starts typing, which of these disappears?

options.label: The gray example text inside the box
options.feedback: Correct. The placeholder yields the moment typing starts—which is why it cannot replace the label.

options.label: The "Email" label beside the box
options.feedback: The label stays beside the box through typing—that is exactly its job.

options.label: Neither disappears
options.feedback: The placeholder does disappear once typing begins; if it stays, the implementation is off.

en.tagline: A placeholder is the gray example inside an input box showing the expected format; it vanishes the moment you type.
en.visualHtml: Emailyou@example.comvanishes on typinglabel stays · placeholder opens

zh.title: 表格里删错了一条报价记录，下面哪个做法找回它最快、最不容易出错？

options.label: 立刻按 Ctrl+Z 撤销删除
options.feedback: 撤销把刚发生的一步原样退回，删掉的记录按原来的样子回来——比重打快，也不会引入新错误。

options.label: 凭记忆重新新建一条一样的
options.feedback: 重打是新建一条，金额和日期可能记错；撤销恢复的才是原来那条。

options.label: 刷新页面让删除失效
options.feedback: 刷新不会撤销操作，反而可能把撤销历史清掉——这一步做完就真的退不回了。

zh.tagline: 撤销是把刚做的一步操作原样退回去——删错的东西按 Ctrl+Z 就回来，不用重做。
zh.visualHtml: 输入 ✓删除 ✗撤销 ⟲ ✓退回动手之前的样子

en.title: You deleted the wrong quote row. Which way recovers it fastest and most safely?

options.label: Press Ctrl+Z right away to undo the delete
options.feedback: Correct. Undo rolls back the last step exactly as it was—faster than retyping and free of new mistakes.

options.label: Recreate an identical record from memory
options.feedback: Retyping creates a new record and risks misremembering; undo restores the original one.

options.label: Refresh the page to cancel the delete
options.feedback: Refreshing does not undo anything and may wipe the undo history—after that there is no way back.

en.tagline: Undo rolls your last action back exactly as it was—Ctrl+Z brings the wrongly deleted row back, no retyping.
en.visualHtml: Type ✓Delete ✗Undo ⟲ ✓back to the way it was

zh.title: AI 做出来的东西和想的不一样，第一步应该做什么？

options.label: 把要求说得更具体：对象、字段、怎样算完成
options.feedback: AI 是按提示词工作的，结果偏了多半是提示词里缺信息。补上「要什么、不要什么、怎么验收」，下一轮就准了。

options.label: 立刻换一个 AI 工具试试
options.feedback: 换工具解决不了信息缺失：同样的模糊要求，换一个 AI 还是只能猜。先把话说清通常更快。

options.label: 反复说「不对，重做」，等它自己领会
options.feedback: 「不对」没有告诉 AI 哪里不对。每轮重做都在烧时间和额度，不如一句话说清要改哪里。

zh.tagline: 输入给大语言模型以引导其生成特定格式与内容结果的指令与上下文文本。
zh.visualHtml:
你写的做报价列表：客户名、金额、日期、状态
预设的你是前端助手，只改指定文件…
结果顺着提示词长 · 说得具体，贴得近

en.title: The AI's result is not what you wanted. What should you do first?

options.label: Make the request specific: object, fields, and what counts as done
options.feedback: Correct. The AI works from your prompt; off-target results usually mean missing information. Add "what, what not, and how to verify."

options.label: Switch to a different AI tool right away
options.feedback: A different tool still has to guess from the same vague request. Clarifying is almost always faster.

options.label: Keep saying "wrong, redo it" until it gets you
options.feedback: "Wrong" does not say what is wrong. Each redo burns time and quota; one specific sentence beats ten vague ones.

en.tagline: A prompt is the message you send the AI—the problem, requirements, and context all live in it, and it steers what the AI builds.
en.visualHtml:
YoursBuild a quote list: client, amount, date, status
PresetYou are a frontend assistant; touch only named files…
output follows the prompt · specific in, close out

zh.title: AI 问你「首页做成什么样」，你现在只想确定区块位置。下面哪个回答更合适？

options.label: 先画灰色骨架：页头、首屏、卡片、页脚排好位置，颜色之后再说
options.feedback: 线框图阶段只定结构，位置确认了再上视觉，要改的也最少。

options.label: 直接给我做一版带渐变和字体的成品，看完再说
options.feedback: 直接上视觉后，改一个区块位置往往连着改颜色、间距和字体；结构没定时这样改最贵。

options.label: 把所有文字内容写好就行，页面怎么排你看着办
options.feedback: 内容固然要先定，但区块位置也需要你确认——「看着办」容易做出和你想法偏差很大的结构。

zh.tagline: 线框图是用灰块和占位线画出的页面骨架——只定「哪里放什么」，不谈颜色和字体。
zh.visualHtml: 灰色骨架：页头、首屏、三张卡片、页脚

en.title: The AI asks "what should the homepage look like?" and you only want to settle block positions. Which reply fits?

options.label: Draw a gray skeleton first: header, hero, cards, footer in position; colors later
options.feedback: Correct. The wireframe stage fixes structure only; visuals come after positions are confirmed, with the least to redo.

options.label: Build a finished version with gradients and fonts, and we'll react to it
options.feedback: With visuals already applied, moving one block drags colors, spacing, and fonts along—costliest time to restructure.

options.label: Just write all the copy; arrange the page however you like
options.feedback: Content does come first, but block positions need your confirmation too—"however you like" invites big drift.

en.tagline: A wireframe is the page skeleton drawn in gray blocks and placeholder lines—it fixes "what goes where" before any colors or fonts.
en.visualHtml: gray skeleton: header, hero, cards, footer

zh.title: 深色模式上线后有人反馈「正文看着费眼」。下面哪个描述最可能定位到问题？

options.label: 检查正文文字的对比度到没到 4.5:1
options.feedback: 深色模式最常见的翻车就是背景变黑了、文字还是原来那档灰，对比度掉到门槛以下。用比值说话，AI 才知道改到什么程度。

options.label: 把正文字号整体调大两个型号，让字更容易辨认
options.feedback: 字号变大只是让字更大，颜色差别没变的话还是费眼；先查对比度。

options.label: 给文字换成更亮的品牌色，让它在页面上更显眼
options.feedback: 换色不等于达标：亮色在黑底上可能够，在灰底上可能不够，还是要按比值检查。

zh.tagline: 对比度是指文字与背景之间的明暗反差，直接决定内容是否清晰可辨。
zh.visualHtml: 浅灰底上的浅灰字同底深字差别够大才看得清

en.title: After dark mode ships, someone says the body text strains their eyes. Which description most likely pinpoints the problem?

options.label: Check whether body text contrast reaches 4.5:1
options.feedback: Correct. The background turned black while the text kept its gray, dropping below the threshold. The ratio gives the AI a concrete target.

options.label: Bump the body font two sizes larger so words are easier to make out
options.feedback: Larger type stays hard to read if the color difference is unchanged; check contrast first.

options.label: Switch the text to a brighter brand color so it stands out more
options.feedback: A different color is not automatically compliant—bright may pass on black and fail on gray; verify by ratio.

en.tagline: Contrast is the brightness difference between text and background—big enough to read; light gray on light gray is not.
en.visualHtml: light gray on light graydark text, same bgbig enough difference to read

zh.title: 访客反馈首页「找不到重点」。看了页面发现标题、说明、按钮的字号几乎一样。下一步跟 AI 怎么说？

options.label: 按主次分层：主标题明显大于说明，主要按钮用底色突出
options.feedback: 让每层拉开差距（大小、颜色、底色），视线自然顺着「标题→说明→按钮」走，重点自己浮出来。

options.label: 在页面顶部再加一条大横幅写「重点在这里」
options.feedback: 再加一个同样大的元素只会多一个争抢视线的东西，乱上加乱。

options.label: 把所有文字整体缩小，页面就显得不挤了
options.feedback: 全部缩小后彼此的差距没变，依然分不出主次；挤和乱是两个问题。

zh.tagline: 视觉层级是让访客按你想要的顺序看页面——先看主标题，再看说明，最后注意到按钮。
zh.visualHtml: 大标题说明浅一档按钮有底色大小、深浅、底色各管一层

en.title: Visitors say the homepage "has no focus." The title, description, and buttons are nearly the same size. What do you tell the AI?

options.label: Layer by importance: headline clearly larger, description secondary, main button filled
options.feedback: Correct. Widen the gaps (size, color, fill) so the eye travels title → description → button, and the focus emerges on its own.

options.label: Add a big banner at the top saying "the focus is here"
options.feedback: Another same-sized element just joins the fight for attention, adding clutter.

options.label: Shrink all the text so the page feels less crowded
options.feedback: Uniformly smaller text keeps the same ratios—still no order. Crowded and unordered are different problems.

en.tagline: Visual hierarchy makes visitors read the page in your intended order—headline first, description next, button last.
en.visualHtml: Headlinedescription, lighterfilled buttonsize, shade, and fill each own a layer

zh.title: AI 做的官网风格总和你想的不一样，来回改了四轮。下面哪个做法最可能一次对齐方向？

options.label: 拼三张喜欢的网站截图加一张不喜欢的，一起发给 AI
options.feedback: 图比形容词准——喜欢的划定方向，不喜欢的划清边界，AI 照着做偏差最小。方向问题在拼图阶段就能解决，不用等到做完再改。

options.label: 继续用文字描述：「再高级一点，再简洁一点」
options.feedback: 「高级」「简洁」没有共同标准，你和 AI 各猜各的，第五轮还会偏。

options.label: 让 AI 随机出五版配色，挑一个顺眼的
options.feedback: 碰运气出的五版都建立在你没说清的方向上，挑中也只是巧合。

zh.tagline: 情绪板是开工前把参考图、配色和关键词拼在一张板上——先对齐「想要什么感觉」，再动手做页面。
zh.visualHtml: 参考 ✓参考 ✓别学 ✗三张喜欢，一张标叉

en.title: The AI's site style keeps missing what you want after four rounds. Which move most likely aligns it in one shot?

options.label: Paste three screenshots you like plus one you dislike, and send them together
options.feedback: Correct. Likes set the direction, the crossed-out one draws the boundary. Solving direction at the collage stage avoids redoing finished work.

options.label: Keep describing in words: "more premium, more minimal"
options.feedback: "Premium" and "minimal" have no shared definition; round five will drift the same way.

options.label: Have the AI generate five random palettes and pick a good one
options.feedback: All five build on an unstated direction; picking a hit would be luck, not alignment.

en.tagline: A moodboard collects reference images, colors, and keywords on one board—align on "what feeling" before building the page.
en.visualHtml: ref ✓ref ✓avoid ✗three likes, one crossed out

zh.title: AI 交付了页面，你想快速验证无障碍的底线。下面哪个组合覆盖了最常见的问题？

options.label: 图片有文字说明、按钮能用 Tab 到达、文字对比度足够
options.feedback: 这三项分别覆盖看不见图的人、不用鼠标的人和看不清字的人——这三项各管一件事，一起查一遍就能挡住最常见的问题。

options.label: 对比度查过了，页面应该就没问题了
options.feedback: 对比度只照顾「看不清」一种情况；不用鼠标的和用读屏的访客照样可能被挡在门外。

options.label: 只在自己电脑的 Chrome 里点一遍
options.feedback: 同一台设备同一浏览器正是「我这里能用」的陷阱；无障碍要换输入方式和场景测。

zh.tagline: 无障碍是让更多人在更多场景下都能用你的页面——不光靠鼠标、不光靠好视力、屏幕读出来也能懂。
zh.visualHtml: 图片有文字说明按钮能用 Tab 到达对比度足够换掉鼠标和好眼睛，还能用吗

en.title: The AI delivered the page and you want to verify the accessibility floor. Which combination covers the most common problems?

options.label: Images have text alternatives, buttons reachable by Tab, text contrast sufficient
options.feedback: Correct. Each of the three blocks one common barrier, and together they are together they catch the most common problems in one pass.

options.label: Contrast is checked, so the page should be fine
options.feedback: Contrast covers only "hard to see"; keyboard and screen-reader users may still be locked out.

options.label: Just click through it in Chrome on your own computer
options.feedback: Same device, same browser is exactly the "works for me" trap; accessibility needs different inputs and contexts.

en.tagline: Accessibility means more people can use your page in more situations—not only with a mouse, not only with perfect vision, and even read aloud by a screen reader.
en.visualHtml: Images have alt textButtons reachable by TabContrast sufficientswap the mouse and good eyes—still usable?

zh.title: provider: OpenRouter，model: deepseek-v4-flash。请问我们连接的模型提供商是谁？

options.label: OpenRouter
options.feedback: Provider 表示通过哪个服务平台调用，Model 表示这次选择的具体模型，所以这里连接的模型提供商是 OpenRouter。

options.label: deepseek-v4-flash
options.feedback: 这不是 Provider，而是 Model 名称。它说明选择了哪个模型，不能单独说明请求通过哪个服务平台发送。

options.label: 无法判断
options.feedback: 这里已经明确写出 `provider: OpenRouter`，因此可以判断请求通过 OpenRouter 发送。

zh.tagline: Provider 是你通过它访问 AI 模型的服务平台与基础设施实体。
zh.visualHtml:
ProviderOpenRouter
→
Modeldeepseek-v4-flash
通过服务平台调用具体模型

en.title: provider: OpenRouter, model: deepseek-v4-flash. Who is the model provider we connect to?

options.label: OpenRouter
options.feedback: Correct. Provider says which service platform you call, while Model says which model you select. The provider here is OpenRouter.

options.label: deepseek-v4-flash
options.feedback: That is the Model name, not the Provider. It identifies which model is selected, not which service platform receives the request.

options.label: It cannot be determined
options.feedback: The configuration explicitly says `provider: OpenRouter`, so the request goes through OpenRouter.

en.tagline: A platform or infrastructure entity that hosts, runs, and serves large language models through APIs.
en.visualHtml:
ProviderOpenRouter
→
Modeldeepseek-v4-flash
call a model through a service platform

zh.title: 配置 OpenRouter 时，哪一项是合适的 Base URL？

options.label: 填写 `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`，让工具继续补上本次请求的路径
options.feedback: 针对 OpenRouter 这种 OpenAI 兼容的服务，需要包含 /api/v1 路径；但注意并不是所有服务都要写 /v1，例如 Anthropic 的 Base URL 是 `https://api.anthropic.com`，一切以具体服务商文档为准。

options.label: 填写完整的 `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions`
options.feedback: 不对。这包含了具体端点的完整请求路径。Base URL 通常只包含公共前缀，否则工具再次拼接路径时会导致请求地址错误（如双重 completions 路径）。

options.label: 只填写 `https://openrouter.ai`，省略 `/api/v1`
options.feedback: 不对。对于 OpenRouter 这类兼容服务，省略 /api/v1 会导致工具无法匹配正确的接口路径。请务必根据官方文档确定具体前缀，而不是硬套规则。

zh.tagline: Base URL（基准地址）是一组 API 请求共同使用的地址前缀。
zh.visualHtml:
https://openrouter.ai/api/v1+/chat/completions=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions
基础地址 + 请求路径

en.title: Which Base URL is suitable when configuring OpenRouter?

options.label: Use `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` and let the tool add the request path
options.feedback: Correct. For OpenAI-compatible services like OpenRouter, the path prefix /api/v1 is needed; however, not all providers use /v1 (e.g. Anthropic uses `https://api.anthropic.com`). Always check the provider's documentation.

options.label: Use the full `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions`
options.feedback: Incorrect. This includes the full endpoint path. The Base URL should only contain the shared prefix; otherwise, when the tool appends the endpoint path, it will result in a malformed URL.

options.label: Use only `https://openrouter.ai`
options.feedback: This leaves out the path required by the OpenRouter service, so it cannot replace the complete Base URL.

en.tagline: An address prefix shared by a group of API requests, onto which specific endpoint paths are appended.
en.visualHtml:
https://openrouter.ai/api/v1+/chat/completions=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions
base address + request path

zh.title: 一次模型调用经过 API 代理时，正确的请求和返回链路是？

options.label: 个人通过 AI 工具发起请求 → 中转站 → 模型提供商 → 中转站 → 返回给个人
options.feedback: 请求先从个人经 AI 工具发给中转站，再由中转站转给模型提供商；结果也要经过中转站返回个人，所以两段内容都经过中转站。

options.label: 个人通过 AI 工具发起请求 → 模型提供商 → 中转站 → 返回给个人
options.feedback: 不对。这个链路跳过了中转站接收请求的环节；如果配置了 API 代理，请求应先到中转站，再由它转给模型提供商。

options.label: 个人通过 AI 工具发起请求 → 中转站，中转站直接生成模型结果
options.feedback: 不对。中转站只负责接收、转发和返回数据，真正运行模型并生成结果的是模型提供商。

zh.tagline: API 代理是位于客户端和上游 API 之间，代为接收和转发请求与响应的中间服务。
zh.visualHtml:
个人↔中转站↔模型提供商
请求发出，结果沿原路返回

en.title: What is the correct request-and-response path through an API proxy?

options.label: You send a request through the AI tool → proxy relay → model provider → proxy relay → back to you
options.feedback: Correct. The request goes from you through the AI tool to the relay and then to the model provider; the result also passes through the relay on its way back to you.

options.label: You send a request through the AI tool → model provider → proxy relay → back to you
options.feedback: Not quite. This path skips the relay when the request is sent. With an API proxy configured, the request should reach the relay first, which forwards it to the model provider.

options.label: You send a request through the AI tool → proxy relay, and the relay generates the model result
options.feedback: Not quite. The relay receives, forwards, and returns data; the model provider is the part that runs the model and generates the result.

en.tagline: An intermediate service that receives and forwards requests and responses between a client and an upstream API.
en.visualHtml:
You↔proxy relay↔model provider
request out, result back along the same path

zh.title: 接口格式兼容，但模型提示不支持工具调用，哪项判断正确？

options.label: 通信格式兼容不代表底层模型具备工具调用能力
options.feedback: 兼容 API 解决请求怎样包装，工具调用还取决于底层模型的能力。

options.label: 只要接口兼容，底层模型就应当拥有 GPT 的全部能力
options.feedback: 接口协议和模型能力是不同层次；兼容声明不能保证工具调用、多模态或流式表现相同。

options.label: 强行打开一个配置项就能补出模型没有的工具调用能力
options.feedback: 配置只能请求某项能力，不能替底层模型增加理解工具和生成结构化参数的能力。

zh.tagline: 与 OpenAI 接口的请求和响应格式相近，允许兼容客户端平滑切换底层模型服务的一类兼容接口。
zh.visualHtml:
普通对话→messages
工具调用→tools
图片输入→image_url

en.title: The endpoint is compatible, but the model says it does not support tool calls. Which judgment is correct?

options.label: Protocol compatibility does not mean the underlying model supports tool calls
options.feedback: Correct. A compatible API standardizes request packaging; tool calls still depend on the model.

options.label: A compatible endpoint must provide every capability of a GPT model
options.feedback: Protocol and model capability are different layers; compatibility does not guarantee identical tool, multimodal, or streaming behavior.

options.label: A configuration flag can add tool-calling capability that the model does not have
options.feedback: A setting can request a capability, but it cannot give the model the ability to understand tools and emit structured arguments.

en.tagline: A third-party model endpoint conforming to OpenAI request and response formats, allowing compatible clients to switch providers seamlessly.
en.visualHtml:
Chat→messages
Tool calls→tools
Image input→image_url

zh.title: 关于权限模式，哪种说法正确？

options.label: Plan / read-only 主要用于读取和分析，不修改代码；确认方案后再进入执行阶段
options.feedback: Plan / read-only 用于理解上下文和制定计划，代码修改应在确认方案后，根据需要选择合适的访问范围和审批方式。

options.label: Full access 只决定模型能力，不影响 AI 对文件和网络资源的访问范围
options.feedback: 不对。Full access 会扩大或取消沙箱等访问限制，影响 AI 可以访问的文件和网络资源。

options.label: Ask for approval 表示 AI 永远不能修改代码，只能向用户提问
options.feedback: 不对。Ask for approval 表示执行需要批准的动作前先询问；获得批准后，AI 仍可能在允许范围内修改代码。

en.title: Which statement about permission modes is correct?

options.label: Plan / read-only is mainly for reading and analysis without changing code; after confirming the plan, move to the execution phase
options.feedback: Correct. Plan / read-only is for understanding context and preparing a plan. Code changes should happen after confirmation, with access and approval settings chosen for the task.

options.label: Full access only changes model capability and does not affect the AI's access to files or network resources
options.feedback: Not quite. Full access widens or removes sandbox restrictions, which affects the files and network resources the AI can access.

options.label: Ask for approval means the AI can never change code and may only ask the user questions
options.feedback: Not quite. Ask for approval means the AI asks before actions that need approval. After approval, it may still change code within the permitted scope.

en.tagline: A set of control presets defining file system boundaries, network access limits, and user confirmation triggers for an AI agent.

zh.title: 让 AI 调试数据库时，哪种方案同时体现沙箱隔离和最小权限？

options.label: 在沙箱中运行，只挂载必要代码目录并连接测试或假数据
options.feedback: 受限环境和非生产数据共同减少宿主机、真实数据库和凭证暴露的影响。

options.label: 把生产数据库管理员账号放进沙箱，因为容器会自动保护所有数据
options.feedback: 沙箱不能让主动注入的生产凭证变得安全；代码仍可能使用或外传它们。

options.label: 只把权限模式设为 allow，就可以代替环境隔离
options.feedback: allow 是审批策略，不是技术隔离；自动允许命令反而可能扩大宿主机风险。

en.title: Which setup combines sandbox isolation with least privilege when the AI debugs a database?

options.label: Run in a sandbox with only the needed code mounted and a test or mock data connection
options.feedback: Correct. The restricted environment and non-production data reduce exposure of the host, real database, and credentials.

options.label: Pass production database admin credentials into the sandbox because containers protect all data automatically
options.feedback: A sandbox cannot make intentionally injected production credentials safe; code may still use or exfiltrate them.

options.label: Set permission mode to allow and use that instead of environment isolation
options.feedback: Allow is an approval policy, not technical isolation; auto-running commands can increase host risk.

en.tagline: An isolated execution environment restricting the files, network, and system resources accessible by untrusted code or automated tasks.

host files×sandbox boundary×untrusted code

options.label: 把创建订单和扣减库存放进同一事务，失败就回滚并返回失败
options.feedback: 两次数据库修改共享同一个提交边界，扣库存失败时不会留下未完成的订单。

options.label: 先保存订单，库存失败后再另写一条取消订单记录
options.feedback: 这仍然是两次独立写入，在补写取消记录期间可能暴露错误状态，不能提供同一个提交边界。

options.label: 订单写入成功就显示成功，库存失败只记录日志供之后处理
options.feedback: 这样页面会把未完成的订单当作成功显示给用户，而且仅记录日志并不能撤销已经写入的订单。

options.label: Put order creation and inventory deduction in one transaction; roll back and return a failure if needed
options.feedback: Correct. Both database changes share the same commit boundary, so a failed deduction will not leave an incomplete order behind.

options.label: Save the order first, then write a cancellation record if inventory fails
options.feedback: These are still separate writes. Writing a cancellation record later can briefly expose an incorrect state and does not provide a shared commit boundary.

options.label: Show success after the order write and leave the inventory failure in logs
options.feedback: The page would show an incomplete order as successful to the user, and logging the error does not undo the database change.

options.label: 先让两个请求分别读取库存，再各自写入库存减一
options.feedback: 两个请求可能都基于旧值写入，页面看似成功但会产生两张订单或错误库存。

options.label: 在两个用户的页面上都禁用按钮，等待其中一个请求结束
options.feedback: 页面按钮状态不能限制另一个用户或重试请求，真正的并发保护必须在共享数据的一侧完成。

en.title: There is only 1 item in stock, and two requests both read 1. Which change keeps the result correct?

options.label: Combine the inventory condition check and deduction into one indivisible database operation
options.feedback: Correct. Only a request that passes the check completes the deduction; the other fails clearly instead of creating a second sale.

options.label: Let both requests read inventory first, then have each write inventory minus one
options.feedback: Both requests can write based on the stale value, producing two orders or an incorrect inventory result.

options.label: Disable the button on both users' pages and wait for one request to finish
options.feedback: A page button state cannot restrict another user or a retry; concurrency protection must be enforced where the shared data is updated.

options.label: 只把保存按钮后的本地昵称改成新值，让页面先看起来正确

options.label: 把成功响应延迟几秒，再刷新观察旧值是否偶尔消失
options.feedback: 延迟不能证明写入是否完成，也不能找出查询错记录、未提交或写入失败的原因。

options.label: Only update the local nickname after clicking save so the page looks correct first
options.feedback: That changes only the current page; refresh still depends on a real write and proves nothing about the database.

options.label: Delay the success response for a few seconds and see whether refresh sometimes changes
options.feedback: A delay proves neither that writing finished nor whether the read used the wrong record or an uncommitted value.

options.label: 把图片任务交给独立进程，并分别记录两个 PID 和退出状态
options.feedback: 独立进程有自己的运行环境，图片进程退出后可以单独重启并检查 Web 进程是否仍在响应。

options.label: 把图片代码拆成另一个函数，但继续在同一进程里调用
options.feedback: 函数边界不会带来进程级资源隔离，未处理崩溃仍可能让同一进程退出。

options.label: 把同一个进程改名为 image-service，再继续同时处理 Web 请求
options.feedback: 名称不会改变运行边界；要查看实际进程 ID、内存和生命周期。

en.title: Image work uses lots of memory and sometimes crashes inside the web process. Which change creates process isolation?

options.label: Run image work in a separate process and record both PIDs and exit states
options.feedback: Correct. The image process can exit and restart independently while the web process is checked for continued service.

options.label: Move image code to another function but call it in the same process
options.feedback: A function boundary does not isolate process resources or lifecycle.

options.label: Rename the same process image-service while it still handles web requests
options.feedback: A name does not create a runtime boundary; inspect PIDs, memory, and lifecycle.

options.label: 确认共享状态的读写是否有锁、队列或其他同步规则
options.feedback: 同一进程的线程共享内存，并发修改需要明确访问顺序和可观察结果。

options.label: 确认两个线程一定拥有不同的进程 ID 和完全隔离内存
options.feedback: 同一进程中的线程通常共享同一个 PID 对应的内存空间。

options.label: 继续增加线程数量，用更多并发自动消除覆盖问题
options.feedback: 更多竞争者会增加共享状态冲突，不会自动建立同步。

zh.tagline: 进程内部由操作系统调度的最小执行单元；同一进程内的多个线程通常共享内存与系统资源。

options.label: Verify that shared reads and writes use a lock, queue, or another synchronization rule
options.feedback: Correct. Threads in one process share memory, so concurrent mutation needs an explicit order and evidence.

options.label: Verify that each thread has a different process ID and fully isolated memory
options.feedback: Threads in one process normally share its memory and process identity.

options.label: Add more threads so extra concurrency automatically removes overwrites
options.feedback: More competitors do not create synchronization and can increase conflicts.

zh.title: 一个接口要等待三个外部 API，等待期间线程几乎没有计算。哪种改法更符合协程？

options.label: 在等待点挂起当前协程，让执行器先推进其他协程，响应后再恢复
options.feedback: 协程用明确暂停点重叠 I/O 等待，不要求每个任务创建新线程。

options.label: 把异步函数都叫协程，并认定每个协程一定运行在独立线程
options.feedback: 协程可以在同一线程交替运行，不等于创建了新线程。

options.label: 把大量 CPU 计算包进协程，就认定它一定会并行变快
options.feedback: 协程本身不提供 CPU 并行，CPU 密集任务仍要考虑调度器和线程或进程资源。

zh.tagline: 在明确暂停点主动挂起并让出执行权、待条件满足后再恢复执行的轻量级并发单元。

en.title: An endpoint waits for three external APIs and does almost no computation while waiting. Which change uses coroutines appropriately?

options.label: Suspend at waits, let the executor advance other coroutines, then resume on response
options.feedback: Correct. Explicit suspension overlaps I/O waits without requiring a new thread per task.

options.label: Call every async function a coroutine and assume each runs on its own thread
options.feedback: Coroutines can alternate on one thread and do not imply new threads.

options.label: Wrap heavy CPU computation in a coroutine and assume it becomes parallel and faster
options.feedback: Coroutines do not create CPU parallelism; scheduling and thread or process resources still matter.

en.tagline: A coroutine is a lightweight execution unit that can suspend at explicit points and resume later.

zh.title: 用户在商城下单并支付成功后，需要发送确认短信和生成发票。采用消息队列的最主要好处是什么？

options.label: 支付完成后，把短信与开票任务写入队列；接口返回订单结果，后台再分别处理任务
options.feedback: 队列让通知与开票不必占用支付请求，但后台仍要处理失败、重试和最终状态。

options.label: 支付接口必须在队列里等待短信和发票全部执行成功，收到全部回执后才能给前端响应
options.feedback: 不对。这依然是同步阻塞，失去了消息队列异步缓冲和解耦的核心价值。

options.label: 任务只要成功进入消息队列，短信就自动送达用户手机，不再需要任何后台消费者处理
options.feedback: 不对。入队成功只是暂存，实际发送由后台消费者执行，入队不代表最终完成。

zh.tagline: 在发送方与处理方之间暂存待处理消息，让双方不必同时在线或同步等待的通信与解耦机制。
zh.visualHtml: 生产者发送消息队列 [缓冲中]消费消费者

en.title: After paying for an order, SMS confirmation and invoicing are needed. What is the primary benefit of using a message queue?

options.label: After payment completes, the API enqueues SMS and invoicing tasks, returns the order result, and lets workers process them
options.feedback: Correct. The tasks no longer occupy the payment request, while workers still need failure, retry, and final-state handling.

options.label: The checkout API must block until the queue confirms that both SMS delivery and invoice generation have succeeded
options.feedback: Incorrect. That remains synchronous blocking and defeats the purpose of async queueing.

options.label: Once a task enters the message queue, the SMS is considered delivered without requiring any worker to process it
options.feedback: Incorrect. Enqueueing only stores the job; a background consumer must still execute it.

en.tagline: A communication and decoupling mechanism that temporarily stores messages between senders and receivers so neither must wait synchronously.
en.visualHtml: ProducersendMessage Queue [Buffering]consumeConsumer

zh.title: 上传接口已经返回任务 ID，但转码还没结束。页面应该把这次结果显示成什么？

options.label: 显示已入队或处理中，并用任务 ID 查询后续状态
options.feedback: 任务 ID 说明可以追踪这项工作，但入队成功不代表转码结果已经产生。

options.label: 直接显示转码完成，因为任务已经成功写入队列
options.feedback: 写入队列只表示任务已经被接收；消费者何时开始处理、最终是否成功，都要另行确认。

options.label: 让上传请求一直等到转码结束，再返回任务 ID
options.feedback: 这会把耗时处理重新塞回上传请求，失去入队后立即返回的好处，也更容易超时。

zh.tagline: 将待处理任务写入队列暂存，使当前请求能先获得任务凭证并快速返回，再由后台异步执行的操作。
zh.visualHtml: 上传视频→队列：转码任务→任务 ID · queued

en.title: The upload API returned a task ID, but transcoding is not finished. What should the page show?

options.label: Show queued or processing, and use the task ID to check later status
options.feedback: Correct. The task ID makes the work trackable, but enqueueing does not mean transcoding has finished.

options.label: Show completed because the task was successfully written to the queue
options.feedback: Writing to the queue only means the task was accepted. You still need to check when processing starts and whether it succeeds.

options.label: Keep the upload request open until transcoding finishes, then return the task ID
options.feedback: That puts the long operation back inside the upload request, making timeouts more likely.

en.tagline: Enqueue puts work into a queue so a request can receive a task ID before a later processor runs it
en.visualHtml: Upload video→Queue: transcode task→Task ID · queued

zh.title: 同一个支付回调因为超时被发送两次。哪种处理最合适？

options.label: 用稳定事件编号和唯一约束原子地取得处理权，其他请求复用已有结果
options.feedback: 稳定编号识别同一个业务动作，原子领取避免两个并发请求都开始处理，保存结果还能让重试得到一致反馈。

options.label: 让接口尽量快速返回，并要求支付平台不要再次重试
options.feedback: 你不能控制网络丢包和平台重试；没有服务端去重时，重复回调仍可能重复改变订单。

options.label: 只按到达时间判断新旧，把较晚的回调当成新订单处理
options.feedback: 到达时间不是业务身份，重复回调可能在不同时间到达，仍会被错误处理两次。

zh.tagline: 同一个请求重复到达时，预期的业务效果仍只发生一次。

en.title: The same payment callback is sent twice after a timeout. Which handling is appropriate?

options.label: Use a stable event id and unique constraint to claim processing atomically; reuse the result for repeats
options.feedback: Correct. The stable id identifies one business action, the atomic claim prevents two concurrent handlers from starting it, and the saved result gives retries a consistent response.

options.label: Return as fast as possible and ask the payment provider never to retry
options.feedback: You cannot control packet loss or provider retries; without server-side deduplication, the order can still change twice.

options.label: Accept only by arrival time and treat a later callback as a new order
options.feedback: Arrival time is not business identity; the same callback can arrive later and still be processed twice.

en.tagline: A repeated request produces the same intended business effect instead of applying it again

zh.title: 预览接口每调用一次就新增报价记录并发邮件。怎样调整最合理？

options.label: 让预览只计算并返回价格，保存和通知放到用户明确提交的请求里
options.feedback: 预览和提交各自有清楚的触发点，能分别验收没有外部改变和产生一次订单。

options.label: 保留预览时的写入，只把邮件改成后台静默发送
options.feedback: 隐藏邮件没有消除副作用，预览仍在不断写记录，用户也无法判断何时产生订单数据。

options.label: 只检查预览返回的价格正确，不再观察数据库和邮件结果
options.feedback: 价格正确不代表没有写库或发信；必须验证预览没有额外改变，提交才有预期副作用。

zh.tagline: 函数或请求在计算返回自身结果之外，对外部系统状态造成的变更或触发的额外操作。

options.label: Make preview calculate and return the price; save and notify only on explicit submit
options.feedback: Correct. Each action has a clear trigger, so you can verify no change during preview and one order during submission.

options.label: Keep the preview write but send the email silently in the background
options.feedback: Hiding the email does not remove the effect; previews still create records and users cannot tell when order data appeared.

options.label: Check only that the preview price is correct and ignore database or email results
options.feedback: A correct price does not prove that no record or email was created; both preview and submit effects must be checked.

zh.title: 库存只剩 1 件，两个后端实例同时扣减。哪种加锁判断最可靠？

options.label: 使用能保护同一数据库记录的锁，持有者完成后让等待者重新检查库存
options.feedback: 锁的作用范围要覆盖两个竞争者共同访问的资源，等待者取得锁后仍需基于新状态判断。

options.label: 在每个实例各自创建一把进程内锁，就认定两个实例已经互斥
options.feedback: 不同实例的进程内锁彼此不可见，不能自动保护同一数据库记录。

options.label: 两个请求先各自扣减库存，写完以后再取得锁记录结果
options.feedback: 冲突已经发生；锁必须覆盖检查和修改共享资源的临界区。

zh.tagline: 限制多个并发操作同时访问同一共享资源，确保同一时间只有一个执行者能够修改状态的同步机制。

en.title: Only one item remains and two backend instances decrement it concurrently. Which lock decision is reliable?

options.label: Use a lock that protects the same database record, then make the waiter recheck stock
options.feedback: Correct. The lock scope covers the shared resource, and a waiter evaluates the new state after acquiring it.

options.label: Create one in-process lock per instance and assume the instances now exclude each other
options.feedback: Separate in-process locks cannot see each other and do not protect one shared database record.

options.label: Let both requests decrement first, then acquire a lock to record what happened
options.feedback: The conflict has already happened; the lock must cover the check-and-update critical section.

en.tagline: A lock is a concurrency-control mechanism that limits simultaneous access to a shared resource.

zh.title: 优惠券超发只在高并发时偶尔出现。下一步怎样最容易找到竞态证据？

options.label: 用相同输入重复并发运行，记录每次读取和写入的请求标识与时序
options.feedback: 竞态依赖交错时序，重复并发运行和关联日志能还原结果为何偶发变化。

options.label: 只串行运行一次，看到结果正常就认定没有问题
options.feedback: 串行运行绕开了竞争时序，一次正常也不能证明并发下稳定。

options.label: 把超发提示隐藏，让用户重新领取直到成功
options.feedback: 隐藏表象不会改变共享状态或提供时序证据。

zh.tagline: 多个并发操作因执行时序或交错顺序不确定，导致系统出现偶发错误或状态不一致的并发缺陷。

en.title: Coupon overselling happens only occasionally under high concurrency. What best gathers race evidence?

options.label: Repeat the same concurrent run and record request IDs and timing for every read and write
options.feedback: Correct. A race depends on interleaving, so repeated concurrent runs and correlated logs reveal why outcomes vary.

options.label: Run once serially and treat a normal result as proof that no race exists
options.feedback: A serial run avoids the competing timing, and one success cannot prove concurrent stability.

options.label: Hide the oversell message and let users retry until one succeeds
options.feedback: Hiding the symptom neither fixes shared state nor provides timing evidence.

options.label: 查找包含操作者、时间、目标权限、动作和结果的审计记录
options.feedback: 审计记录把一次安全相关操作的关键事实放在同一条可追查证据里。

options.label: 只搜索服务端报错日志，看到没有报错就认定没有权限变更
options.feedback: 权限修改可能完全成功，不一定产生报错；报错日志也通常不会回答是谁主动执行了变更。

options.label: 查看当天请求量曲线，按曲线峰值推断是哪位管理员操作的
options.feedback: 请求量只能显示数量变化，不能关联具体操作者、目标权限和动作结果。

zh.tagline: 按时间顺序记录谁在何时对什么对象执行了什么操作，以及最终成功或被拒绝的结果。

options.label: Use the day's request-volume chart to infer which administrator acted from the peak

zh.title: 活动前的结账负载测试显示，p95 延迟（95% 请求的响应时间不超过这个值）已经超过阈值，错误率也在上升。哪种处理最有用？

options.label: 保留测试场景和指标，定位瓶颈，改善后重复测试并比较结果
options.feedback: 负载测试的价值在于用可重复的负载和阈值发现瓶颈，再用下一轮结果验证改善。

options.label: 只测一次单个请求；它成功就说明活动全量结账不会超时
options.feedback: 单个请求没有施加目标负载，不能说明并发用户下的延迟、吞吐或错误率。

options.label: 把错误请求从统计里排除，只报告成功请求的平均响应时间
options.feedback: 排除失败会掩盖负载下的真实影响；错误率和响应时间都要按同一场景完整分析。

zh.tagline: 在模拟真实业务规模的并发请求下，测量系统延迟、吞吐量和错误率等表现的性能测试方法。

en.title: Before an event, checkout load testing shows 95th-percentile (p95) latency above threshold and rising errors. Which response is most useful?

options.label: Keep the scenario and metrics, locate the bottleneck, improve it, rerun, and compare the results
options.feedback: Correct. Load testing is useful when repeatable load and thresholds expose a bottleneck and the next run verifies the improvement.

options.label: Test one request once; if it succeeds, full-event checkout will not time out
options.feedback: One request applies no target load and cannot show latency, throughput, or errors under concurrency.

options.label: Exclude failed requests and report only the average response time of successful requests
options.feedback: Excluding failures hides the real impact under load; errors and latency must be analyzed for the same complete scenario.

en.tagline: Load testing measures latency, throughput, and errors while a system handles a realistic level of load.

zh.title: 生产者显示发送成功，但队列里的任务越来越多。先检查哪一部分？

options.label: 检查消费者是否在线、是否收到消息、处理是否失败以及是否反馈结果
options.feedback: 生产者成功发送只说明消息进入了队列，堆积还可能来自无人消费或消费处理不过来。

options.label: 让生产者不断重发同一批消息，直到队列数量下降
options.feedback: 重发会增加堆积，不能证明消费者已经收到或处理了消息。

options.label: 直接清空队列，先让监控数字恢复正常
options.feedback: 清空会丢掉尚未处理的任务，绕过了对消费者状态和失败原因的检查。

zh.tagline: 从消息队列中获取待处理消息并执行业务逻辑，处理完成后向队列反馈确认状态的服务实例或后台进程。

en.title: The producer reports success, but the queue keeps growing. What should you inspect first?

options.label: Check whether consumers are online, receiving messages, failing, and reporting results
options.feedback: Correct. Producer success only means the message entered the queue; buildup can come from no consumer or slow processing.

options.label: Have the producer resend the same messages until the queue shrinks
options.feedback: Resending increases buildup and does not show that a consumer received or processed the messages.

options.label: Clear the queue so the monitoring number looks normal again
options.feedback: Clearing can discard unprocessed work and avoids checking the consumer or the failure cause.

en.tagline: A message consumer is an application or instance that receives messages from a queue, handles them according to its rules, and acknowledges their processing status
en.visualHtml: Publisher sends→Message queue→Consumer handles ✓

zh.title: 支付依赖已经连续失败，新的结算请求还在不断等待。熔断器下一步应该怎样做？

options.label: 进入 Open，快速失败或返回降级结果，稍后再以 Half-Open 探测
options.feedback: 打开状态先隔离故障，半开状态用有限探测判断依赖是否恢复。

options.label: 继续增加重试次数，让每个请求都等到支付成功
options.feedback: 无限重试会继续占用自己的资源；熔断器的作用正是停止把故障扩散到调用方。

options.label: 立即回到 Closed，并把所有新请求照常发送给失败依赖
options.feedback: 连续失败时立即关闭会重新放大故障，应该先打开并经过探测。

zh.tagline: 当外部依赖连续失败时主动切断调用并快速返回降级结果，避免自身被拖垮，并在稍后自动探测恢复的保护机制。

en.title: The payment dependency keeps failing while new checkout requests wait. What should the circuit breaker do next?

options.label: Enter Open, fail fast or degrade, then probe later in Half-Open
options.feedback: Correct. Open isolates the failure; Half-Open uses limited probes to learn whether the dependency recovered.

options.label: Keep increasing retries so every request waits for payment success
options.feedback: Unlimited retries consume caller resources; the breaker exists to stop the failure spreading.

options.label: Return to Closed immediately and send every new request to the failing dependency
options.feedback: Closing immediately would amplify the failure again; probe recovery before returning to normal calls.

en.tagline: A circuit breaker cuts off a repeatedly failing dependency, fails fast or degrades, and probes recovery later
en.visualHtml:

zh.title: 图片处理速度低于上传速度，队列长度和内存都在上涨。哪种改法是在使用背压？

options.label: 根据下游处理能力暂停或放慢上游发送，并限制未完成任务数量
options.feedback: 背压把下游过慢的反馈传回上游，让未完成工作量保持在可控范围。

options.label: 只把队列容量调大，让更多任务先堆在内存里
options.feedback: 容量变大只能延后暴露问题，不能让上游感知下游已经处理不过来。

options.label: 无论下游状态如何，永久把所有用户限制为同一个固定速率
options.feedback: 这是固定限流的思路，不是根据下游反馈动态调整工作流。

zh.tagline: 下游处理能力不足时，将减速或暂停信号反向传递给上游以限制任务流入的反馈机制。
zh.visualHtml: 上游：持续上传→背压：放慢 / 暂停←下游：处理变慢

en.title: Image processing is slower than uploads, and queue length and memory are rising. Which change uses backpressure?

options.label: Pause or slow publishing based on downstream capacity, and cap unfinished work
options.feedback: Correct. Backpressure sends the downstream slowdown back upstream and keeps unfinished work bounded.

options.label: Only make the queue larger so more work can accumulate in memory
options.feedback: More capacity delays the symptom but does not tell the upstream that downstream is overloaded.

options.label: Permanently give every user the same fixed rate regardless of downstream state
options.feedback: That is fixed rate limiting, not adapting the flow from downstream feedback.

en.tagline: Backpressure sends a downstream slowdown or pause signal upstream to limit new or unfinished work
en.visualHtml: Upstream: uploads→Backpressure: slow / pause←Downstream: slower

zh.title: 当前调度实例失联了，另一个实例准备运行同一任务。什么条件下可以接管？

options.label: 等原租约过期，再取得新租约和更大的持有代次；写入方原子拒绝旧代次
options.feedback: 到期决定何时可以接管；递增代次由真正接收写入的一方校验，才能挡住恢复后的旧实例。

options.label: 只要原实例没有主动释放，就永久等待它回来
options.feedback: 租约的意义就是让失联持有者最终失去持有权，永久等待会让任务无法恢复。

options.label: 不看租约状态，发现心跳暂时没到就立刻开始执行
options.feedback: 短暂网络延迟不等于租约过期，立即接管可能让两个实例同时执行。

zh.tagline: 带有明确有效期的临时持有权；持有者需定期续约，超时失效后其他节点方可安全接管。
zh.visualHtml: 实例 A · 持有并续租→ 过期实例 B · 接管同一任务只有一个当前持有者

en.title: The current scheduler is unreachable and another instance is ready to run the same job. When may it take over?

options.label: Confirm expiry, acquire a larger fencing token, and have the write target atomically reject stale tokens
options.feedback: Correct. Expiry permits takeover, while the monotonically increasing token lets the write target reject a recovered old holder.

options.label: Wait forever unless the old instance releases the lease itself
options.feedback: A lease lets an unreachable holder lose ownership eventually; waiting forever prevents recovery.

options.label: Ignore lease state and start as soon as one heartbeat is late
options.feedback: A short network delay is not expiry; immediate takeover can run the job twice.

en.tagline: A lease is time-limited ownership that must be renewed and can be taken over after it expires
en.visualHtml: Instance A · owns and renews→ expiresInstance B · takes overone current holder for the job

zh.title: 订单服务已经创建订单，但库存服务网络超时。哪种判断更符合分布式系统的排错方式？

options.label: 按请求标识查看订单和库存两边的结果，区分已完成、超时和可重试步骤
options.feedback: 网络边界允许部分成功，必须把各节点的结果拼起来，才知道订单当前状态和下一步动作。

options.label: 只要订单服务返回成功，就认定库存也一定扣减成功
options.feedback: 不同服务之间的调用可能在网络中断时产生不同结果；一个服务成功不能直接证明另一个服务完成。

options.label: 只检查订单服务的线程数，不查看服务之间的请求和响应
options.feedback: 线程数无法回答库存服务是否收到请求、处理到哪一步或响应是否在网络中丢失。

zh.tagline: 由多个计算节点组成，并通过网络协作完成共同任务的系统。

en.title: The order service created an order, but the inventory service timed out over the network. Which judgment fits a distributed system?

options.label: Use the request ID to inspect both services and separate completed, timed-out, and retryable steps
options.feedback: Correct. A network boundary allows partial success, so the current order state and next action require evidence from each node.

options.label: Because the order service returned success, assume inventory was definitely deducted
options.feedback: Separate service calls can end differently when the network fails; one service's success does not prove another completed.

options.label: Inspect only the order service's thread count without checking the inter-service request and response
options.feedback: Thread count cannot show whether inventory received the request, processed it, or lost the response on the network.

en.tagline: A distributed system uses multiple computing nodes that coordinate over a network to achieve a system goal.

zh.title: 单实例服务正在重启，用户暂时打不开页面。哪种判断和验收最准确？

options.label: 承认重启期间可能短暂不可用，确认服务恢复后持久化数据仍能读到
options.feedback: 单实例的可用性风险集中在唯一副本，但持久化数据是否保留要单独验证。

options.label: 把代码里的单例对象删掉，就能让部署变成多实例并避免中断
options.feedback: 单例模式是代码结构，不能改变运行环境中服务副本的数量或重启行为。

options.label: 只要服务重新显示在线，重启前放在内存里的任务就一定还在
options.feedback: 进程内存通常会随实例停止而消失；恢复在线不能证明内存任务被保存。

en.title: A single-instance service is restarting and users temporarily cannot open the page. Which judgment and verification are accurate?

options.label: Accept a brief restart outage and confirm durable data is readable after recovery
options.feedback: Correct. Availability risk is concentrated in the only replica, while data durability must be verified separately.

options.label: Delete the Singleton object in code to make deployment multi-instance and avoid the interruption
options.feedback: The Singleton pattern is a code structure; it cannot change runtime replica count or restart behavior.

options.label: Once the service is online again, assume every task kept in memory before restart still exists
options.feedback: Process memory normally disappears when the instance stops; recovery does not prove in-memory work was saved.
