zh.title: 多实例服务上线后，用户偶尔被要求重新登录。先检查哪一处？

options.label: 检查请求是否被分到不同实例，以及登录会话是否只保存在某个实例本地
options.feedback: 跳到另一个实例时，本地会话不可见是多实例常见问题；要把会话放到共享位置或采用可验证的无状态方案。

options.label: 继续增加实例数量，实例越多就越能自动共享用户登录状态
options.feedback: 增加副本只改变请求承接数量，不会让各实例自动看到彼此的本地会话。

options.label: 只检查数据库是否有备份，就认为登录问题与实例状态无关
options.feedback: 数据库备份不能证明会话在实例之间可见；登录状态的存放位置仍需单独检查。

en.title: After a multi-instance release, users are occasionally asked to sign in again. What should you inspect first?

options.label: Check whether requests reach different instances and whether the session exists only in one instance's local memory
options.feedback: Correct. A local session is invisible after a request moves to another instance; use shared state or a verifiable stateless approach.

options.label: Add more instances because more replicas automatically share login state
options.feedback: More replicas change request capacity, not whether instances can see each other's local sessions.

options.label: Check only whether the database has backups and conclude instance state is unrelated
options.feedback: Backups do not prove sessions are visible across instances; the location of login state still needs inspection.

zh.title: 用户已付款升级，导出仍被拒绝；日志显示服务端权益还是 Free。应先检查哪里？

options.label: 刷新登录凭证，先检查账号的登录状态
options.feedback: 日志已经定位到权益仍是 Free；刷新身份凭证不能证明权益记录已经更新。

options.label: 核对权益变更通知是否已更新服务端记录
options.feedback: 付款完成与权益生效有同步环节；检查这一环节能解释为什么服务端仍按 Free 拒绝。

options.label: 把前端的套餐标签改成 Pro，再重试导出
options.feedback: 页面标签不能改变服务端记录，导出请求仍会按 Free 权益判断。

en.title: A paid upgrade still cannot export; logs show the server entitlement is Free. What should be checked first?

options.label: Refresh login credentials and inspect the account’s sign-in state
options.feedback: The logs already identify stale entitlements. Renewed identity credentials do not prove that access records were updated.

options.label: Check whether the entitlement notification updated the server record
options.feedback: Payment and effective access are separated by synchronization; inspect that step to explain the Free decision.

options.label: Change the browser plan label to Pro and retry the export
options.feedback: Changing a label does not change the server’s entitlement record.

zh.title: 页面只允许选择已有用户，但其他程序也能写订单。怎样防止订单引用不存在的用户编号？

options.label: 给订单的用户编号配置外键，写入时由数据库检查
options.feedback: 外键使所有写入路径都必须满足这条引用规则，无效用户编号会被数据库拒绝。

options.label: 只更新页面的用户下拉列表，让选项保持最新
options.feedback: 页面筛选不能约束其他程序的写入，数据库里仍可能出现无效引用。

options.label: 定期找出没有对应用户的订单，发现后再清理
options.feedback: 事后清理期间无效订单已经存在，不能保证每次写入都满足关系约束。

zh.title: PR 的 45 个测试都通过，但报告显示覆盖率 68%，要求至少 80%。下一步怎样做？

options.label: 根据报告补上未覆盖路径的测试，再检查新结果
options.feedback: 失败的是覆盖率条件。补测并重新验证，才能证明这次改动满足约定标准。

options.label: 保持代码和测试不变，再运行一次相同检查
options.feedback: 相同测试重复通过，不会自动覆盖原本没有运行的路径。

options.label: 把阈值从 80% 调到 60%，再检查是否通过
options.feedback: 这样改变了准入标准，并未补上报告指出的测试缺口。

zh.tagline: 在合并代码或发布版本前，根据检查结果判断是否允许继续的一组准入条件

en.title: All 45 PR tests pass, but coverage is 68% against a required 80%. What should happen next?

options.label: Add tests for the uncovered paths, then check the new result
options.feedback: Coverage is the failed condition. Adding tests and verifying again shows whether the agreed criteria are met.

options.label: Rerun the same checks without changing the code or tests
options.feedback: Repeating the same tests does not automatically exercise missing paths.

options.label: Lower the threshold to 60%, then check whether it passes
options.feedback: This changes the admission rule without covering the gap identified in the report.

en.tagline: A set of conditions that decide whether code may be merged or a release may proceed

zh.title: 脚本文件名已经随内容变化，但重新打开的网站仍显示旧文字；检查发现页面还引用旧文件。下一步先检查什么？

options.label: 检查入口页面是否更新，以及它的缓存是否仍返回旧引用
options.feedback: 决定性证据是页面还引用旧文件。先让入口引用新资源，再检查实际请求和显示结果。

options.label: 把新文件的哈希从 8 位加长到完整摘要，再发布一次
options.feedback: 当前证据是引用仍旧，不是文件名碰撞。增加摘要长度不会改变页面引用。

options.label: 取消脚本文件的缓存，让浏览器重新请求当前引用
options.feedback: 即使重新下载，当前引用仍指向旧脚本。应先检查入口页面与资源引用。

en.title: The script filename changed with its contents, but revisiting still shows old text. The page still references the old file. What should you inspect first?

options.label: Check whether the entry page and its cache still serve the old reference
options.feedback: The key evidence is the old reference. Update the entry to reference the new asset, then verify the request and displayed result.

options.label: Extend the new filename hash from 8 digits to the full digest and redeploy
options.feedback: The evidence points to an old reference, not a filename collision. A longer digest does not change that reference.

options.label: Disable caching for scripts so the browser fetches the referenced file again
options.feedback: Fetching the same old URL again still requests the old script. Inspect the entry page and its resource references first.

zh.title: 配置中有嵌套的 theme 对象。用 { ...original } 创建草稿后，把 draft.theme.mode 改成 dark。原配置的 theme.mode 会怎样？

options.label: 也会变成 dark，因为两份外层对象仍共用 theme
options.feedback: 浅拷贝创建了新的外层对象，但没有复制内部 theme。改它的 mode 会影响双方读到的结果。

options.label: 保持 light，因为草稿的外层已经是一个新对象
options.feedback: 外层独立只保护第一层的替换；这里修改的是仍被共用的 theme 对象。

options.label: 等到点击取消时，才从 light 变成 dark
options.feedback: 共享对象在执行属性修改时就已变化。取消不是这次变化的触发点。

options.label: It also becomes dark because both outer objects share theme

options.label: It stays light because the draft has a new outer object
options.feedback: A separate outer object isolates top-level replacement. This edit changes the still-shared theme object.

options.label: It changes from light to dark only when Cancel is clicked
options.feedback: The shared object changes when its property is edited. Cancel is not the trigger.
